title: Confucius's wanderings
summary: Born in Lu, Confucius served its court, then spent fourteen years wandering the states in search of a ruler who would use his ideas before coming home to teach and edit the classics.
summary_zh: 孔子生于鲁，曾仕鲁国，后周游列国十四年，求用于诸侯而不得，晚年归鲁授徒、整理典籍。

steps.text: 551 BC: Born at Zouyi near Qufu, capital of the state of Lu; his father, a minor officer, died when he was small.
steps.text_zh: 前551年，生于鲁国陬邑（今曲阜附近），幼年丧父，家境贫寒。

steps.text: 517 BC: Follows the exiled Duke Zhao of Lu to Qi; in Linzi he hears the ancient Shao music and discusses government with Duke Jing.
steps.text_zh: 前517年，鲁昭公出奔，孔子随之到齐国，在临淄闻《韶》乐，与齐景公论政。

steps.text: 500 BC: Now a senior minister of Lu, he guides Duke Ding at the Jiagu conference with Qi and wins back lost Lu lands (the site is disputed).
steps.text_zh: 前500年，已任鲁国司寇，相鲁定公赴夹谷之会，据礼力争，使齐归还侵地（会址有争议）。

steps.text: 497 BC: Disillusioned with Lu's rulers, he leaves home with his disciples; Wey becomes his main base over the next years.
steps.text_zh: 前497年，对鲁国执政失望，率弟子离鲁，先到卫国，此后多年以卫为落脚之地。

steps.text: 492 BC: Passing through Song, he is threatened by the minister Huan Tui and has to slip away in disguise.
steps.text_zh: 前492年，过宋国，宋司马桓魋欲加害，孔子微服离去。

steps.text: 491 BC: Settles for about three years in the small state of Chen (modern Huaiyang), still without a post.
steps.text_zh: 前491年前后，到陈国（今淮阳）居留约三年，仍不得重用。

steps.text: 489 BC: Running out of food between Chen and Cai, the group nearly starves; he then visits Ye in Chu, where the Duke of Ye asks him about government.
steps.text_zh: 前489年，困于陈、蔡之间，绝粮七日；随后至楚国叶邑，叶公问政。

steps.text: 484 BC: Invited home after fourteen years away, he teaches and works on the Odes, Documents and the Spring and Autumn Annals.
steps.text_zh: 前484年，在外十四年后受召返鲁，专心授徒，整理《诗》《书》，修《春秋》。

steps.text: 481 BC: News of a qilin caught on a hunt in the west of Lu grieves him, and by tradition he ends the Spring and Autumn Annals here.
steps.text_zh: 前481年，鲁人西狩获麟，孔子感伤，相传《春秋》即止笔于此。

steps.text: 479 BC: Dies in Qufu, having outlived his favourite disciples Yan Hui and Zilu; he is buried north of the city.
steps.text_zh: 前479年，在颜回、子路相继去世后，卒于曲阜，葬于城北泗水之上。

title: Qu Yuan's exile
summary: A Chu noble and minister, Qu Yuan lost the king's trust, was banished south of the Yangtze, and drowned himself in the Miluo as Qin overran his homeland.
summary_zh: 屈原出身楚国贵族，曾受楚怀王重用，后遭疏远放逐江南，在秦破郢都之际自沉汨罗江。

steps.text: 340 BC: Born into the Chu royal clan, by tradition at Zigui in the Three Gorges.
steps.text_zh: 前340年，生于楚国王族屈氏，相传出生在三峡的秭归。

steps.text: c. 318 BC: As Left Minister under King Huai in the capital Ying, he drafts laws and argues for alliance with Qi against Qin.
steps.text_zh: 约前318年，在郢都任楚怀王左徒，起草宪令，力主联齐抗秦。

steps.text: 311 BC: Already out of favour after Zhang Yi's intrigues, he is sent as envoy to Qi; back home he urges the king to kill Zhang Yi.
steps.text_zh: 前311年，张仪诳楚之后已遭疏远，奉命出使齐国，回国后力谏怀王杀张仪。

steps.text: c. 305 BC: Opposing Chu's turn toward Qin, he is pushed out of court; by tradition this is when he writes the Li Sao.
steps.text_zh: 约前305年，因反对楚国亲秦而被排挤出朝，相传《离骚》作于此时前后。

steps.text: c. 296 BC: Banished south of the Yangtze by King Qingxiang, he wanders the Yuan and Xiang rivers; his poem 'Crossing the River' names Xupu.
steps.text_zh: 约前296年，被顷襄王放逐江南，流落沅水、湘水之间，《涉江》中写到“入溆浦余儃佪兮”。

steps.text: 278 BC: When Qin's general Bai Qi sacks Ying, he drowns himself in the Miluo; the Dragon Boat Festival is said to remember him.
steps.text_zh: 前278年，秦将白起攻破郢都，屈原怀石自沉汨罗江；相传端午节即为纪念他。

title: Zhang Qian's missions west
summary: Sent to find the Yuezhi, Zhang Qian spent thirteen years crossing Xiongnu lands and Central Asia, and his reports opened Han China to the Western Regions.
summary_zh: 张骞奉命寻找大月氏，历经十三年辗转匈奴与中亚，其见闻为汉朝打开了通往西域的道路。

steps.text: 164 BC: Born in Chenggu in the Hanzhong valley.
steps.text_zh: 前164年，生于汉中郡城固。

steps.text: 138 BC: A palace attendant, he volunteers to lead a mission to the Yuezhi, hoping to win them as allies against the Xiongnu.
steps.text_zh: 前138年，以郎官应募出使，前往大月氏，希望联合其夹击匈奴。

steps.text: 138 BC: Crossing Xiongnu-held Hexi, he is captured and held for about ten years; he marries a Xiongnu wife but keeps his envoy's staff.
steps.text_zh: 前138年，途经匈奴控制的河西被俘，羁留约十年，娶妻生子，仍持汉节不失。

steps.text: c. 129 BC: Escaping west, he reaches Dayuan in the Ferghana Valley, whose king sends him on with guides.
steps.text_zh: 约前129年，逃脱西行，抵达大宛，大宛王派人引导他继续前行。

steps.text: 128 BC: Finds the Yuezhi settled by the Oxus, ruling Bactria; content there, they refuse to fight the Xiongnu.
steps.text_zh: 前128年，找到已定居妫水（阿姆河）一带、臣服大夏的大月氏，但对方安于富饶，无意东归报仇。

steps.text: 126 BC: Back in Chang'an after a second capture, with one companion left; his report on Ferghana, Parthia and India changes how the Han see the West.
steps.text_zh: 前126年，途中再度被匈奴扣押后终于归汉，出发时百余人仅剩二人；他对西域诸国的报告开阔了汉朝的视野。

steps.text: 115 BC: Ends a second mission to the Wusun near Issyk-Kul; his deputies fan out to Ferghana, Sogdiana, Parthia and beyond.
steps.text_zh: 前115年，结束第二次出使乌孙（伊塞克湖一带），副使分赴大宛、康居、安息等国。

steps.text: 113 BC: Dies in Chang'an a year after his return; he is buried in his hometown Chenggu.
steps.text_zh: 前113年，归国一年多后卒于长安，归葬故乡城固。

title: Sima Qian's travels
summary: The Grand Historian travelled across the Han empire in his youth, then, after castration for defending Li Ling, finished the Records of the Grand Historian.
summary_zh: 司马迁青年时遍游天下，后因替李陵辩护受宫刑，忍辱完成《史记》。

steps.text: 145 BC: Born at Longmen by the Yellow River, son of the court astrologer Sima Tan.
steps.text_zh: 前145年，生于黄河边的夏阳龙门，父亲司马谈为太史令。

steps.text: 126 BC: At twenty sets out on a grand tour of the south, climbing Kuaiji to see the cave of Yu the Great and sailing the Yuan and Xiang rivers.
steps.text_zh: 前126年，二十岁南游江淮，上会稽探禹穴，又浮沅水、湘水。

steps.text: c. 125 BC: Studies the Confucian traditions in Lu and Qi, watching the old rites at Confucius's home.
steps.text_zh: 约前125年，北涉汶水、泗水，在齐鲁之地讲习学业，观孔子遗风。

steps.text: 111 BC: Sent as an imperial envoy to the newly opened lands south of Ba and Shu, as far as the Qiong, Ze and Kunming peoples.
steps.text_zh: 前111年，奉使西征巴蜀以南，经略邛、笮、昆明等地。

steps.text: 110 BC: Hurries back to find his dying father at Luoyang, who makes him promise to finish the history he had begun.
steps.text_zh: 前110年，赶回在洛阳见到病危的父亲，司马谈临终嘱咐他继承修史之业。

steps.text: 110 BC: Joins Emperor Wu's feng and shan sacrifices at Mount Tai, the ceremony his father had longed to attend.
steps.text_zh: 前110年，随汉武帝至泰山封禅，这正是父亲未能参加的大典。

steps.text: 91 BC: Grand Historian since 108 BC, castrated in 98 BC for defending Li Ling, he finishes the Records of the Grand Historian, as he tells in his Letter to Ren An.
steps.text_zh: 前91年，自前108年任太史令，前98年因替李陵辩护受宫刑，此时基本完成《史记》，并在《报任安书》中自述心志。

steps.text: c. 86 BC: The time and place of his death are unknown; a shrine and tomb in his hometown at Zhichuan have honoured him since ancient times.
steps.text_zh: 约前86年，卒年与卒地均不详；故乡韩城芝川自古建有司马迁祠墓纪念他。

title: Ban Chao in the Western Regions
summary: Ban Chao gave up copying documents for the army and spent three decades winning the oasis states of the Tarim Basin back to Han.
summary_zh: 班超投笔从戎，在西域经营三十年，使塔里木盆地诸国重归汉朝。

steps.text: 32: Born at Pingling near Chang'an, son of the historian Ban Biao and younger brother of Ban Gu.
steps.text_zh: 32年，生于扶风平陵，史学家班彪之子，班固之弟。

steps.text: 62: Moves to Luoyang with his brother and copies documents for a living, until he throws down his brush to seek glory on the frontier.
steps.text_zh: 62年，随兄迁居洛阳，以替官府抄书为生，后感叹“大丈夫当立功异域”，投笔从戎。

steps.text: 73: After fighting the Xiongnu under Dou Gu, he is sent to Shanshan, where he attacks the Xiongnu envoys by night: 'how catch tiger cubs without entering the den?'
steps.text_zh: 73年，随窦固击北匈奴后出使鄯善，夜袭匈奴使团，留下“不入虎穴，焉得虎子”之语。

steps.text: 73: Wins over the king of Khotan, who kills the Xiongnu envoy and submits to Han.
steps.text_zh: 73年，到于阗，迫使于阗王斩杀匈奴使者归附汉朝。

steps.text: 74: Overthrows the Kuchean-imposed king of Shule and makes Kashgar his base for the next two decades.
steps.text_zh: 74年，废黜龟兹所立的疏勒王，此后二十年以疏勒为根据地。

steps.text: 87: With troops from Khotan and other states he defeats Yarkand and its Kuchean allies.
steps.text_zh: 87年，发于阗等国兵击破莎车及龟兹援军。

steps.text: 90: Holds out against a large Kushan army, cuts its supplies, and forces it to withdraw.
steps.text_zh: 90年，贵霜大军来攻，班超坚壁清野，断其粮道，迫使其退兵。

steps.text: 91: Kucha submits and he is made Protector General of the Western Regions, seated at Tuoqian.
steps.text_zh: 91年，龟兹等国归降，班超被任命为西域都护，驻它乾城。

steps.text: 94: Crushes Yanqi, the last holdout; over fifty states now acknowledge Han. In 97 he sends Gan Ying west toward Rome.
steps.text_zh: 94年，发兵平定焉耆，西域五十余国皆归附；97年又派甘英出使大秦。

steps.text: 102: Granted leave after thirty-one years abroad, he returns to Luoyang and dies a month later.
steps.text_zh: 102年，在西域三十一年后获准东归，回到洛阳一个月后病逝。

title: Cao Cao's campaigns
summary: Rising from a local magistrate's post, Cao Cao fought across northern China, controlled the Han emperor, and unified the north before his defeat at Red Cliffs.
summary_zh: 曹操由洛阳北部尉起家，转战中原，挟天子以令诸侯，统一北方，却在赤壁受挫。

steps.text: 155: Born in Qiao (Bozhou), grandson by adoption of the powerful eunuch Cao Teng.
steps.text_zh: 155年，生于沛国谯县（今亳州），祖父为宦官曹腾。

steps.text: 174: As commandant of northern Luoyang he flogs a eunuch's uncle for breaking the curfew and earns a name for firmness.
steps.text_zh: 174年，任洛阳北部尉，棒杀违禁夜行的宦官蹇硕叔父，以执法严明闻名。

steps.text: 189: Flees Dong Zhuo's Luoyang and raises his own troops at Jiwu in Chenliu, joining the coalition against Dong.
steps.text_zh: 189年，逃离董卓控制的洛阳，在陈留己吾起兵，加入讨董联军。

steps.text: 192: Defeats the Yellow Turbans of Qingzhou and enrols the best of them as the Qingzhou Army, his first real power base.
steps.text_zh: 192年，击败入兖州的青州黄巾，收编精锐为“青州兵”，从此有了根基。

steps.text: 196: Brings Emperor Xian to Xu and starts state-run farming colonies; from now on he commands in the emperor's name.
steps.text_zh: 196年，迎汉献帝定都许县，推行屯田，从此“奉天子以令不臣”。

steps.text: 200: Burns Yuan Shao's grain at Wuchao and wins the battle of Guandu against a much larger army.
steps.text_zh: 200年，奇袭乌巢烧毁袁绍粮草，在官渡以少胜多。

steps.text: 204: Takes Yuan's capital Ye and makes it his own base; he later builds the Bronze Sparrow Terrace there.
steps.text_zh: 204年，攻克袁氏根据地邺城，以此为大本营，后在此修筑铜雀台。

steps.text: 207: Crosses the northeastern wilds to crush the Wuhuan at White Wolf Mountain; on the way back he writes 'Viewing the Sea' at Jieshi.
steps.text_zh: 207年，出卢龙塞远征乌桓，大胜于白狼山；归途登碣石作《观沧海》。

steps.text: 208: Having taken Jing Province, he is beaten by Sun Quan and Liu Bei's fleet at Red Cliffs, ending hopes of quick reunification.
steps.text_zh: 208年，南下取荆州后，在赤壁被孙刘联军火攻击败，统一天下的势头受挫。

steps.text: 215: Crosses the Qinling to conquer Zhang Lu's Hanzhong, but loses it to Liu Bei four years later.
steps.text_zh: 215年，越秦岭征张鲁，取汉中；四年后汉中又被刘备夺去。

steps.text: 220: Dies in Luoyang as King of Wei; months later his son Cao Pi ends the Han and founds Wei.
steps.text_zh: 220年，以魏王身份病逝于洛阳，同年其子曹丕代汉称帝。

title: Zhuge Liang's life
summary: Orphaned and uprooted by war, Zhuge Liang farmed at Longzhong until Liu Bei recruited him, then built the Shu Han state and died leading its northern campaigns.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮少年孤苦、避乱南迁，躬耕隆中，后辅佐刘备建立蜀汉，最终病逝于北伐军中。

steps.text: 181: Born at Yangdu in Langya (modern Yinan, Shandong); he loses both parents young.
steps.text_zh: 181年，生于琅琊阳都（今山东沂南），幼年父母双亡。

steps.text: c. 195: Fleeing the wars in the north, he follows his uncle Zhuge Xuan, appointed governor of Yuzhang (Nanchang).
steps.text_zh: 约195年，避战乱随叔父诸葛玄南下，诸葛玄出任豫章太守。

steps.text: 207: After a decade farming near Xiangyang, he is visited three times by Liu Bei and lays out the Longzhong Plan for a three-way division.
steps.text_zh: 207年，在襄阳隆中躬耕十年后，刘备三顾茅庐，他提出三分天下的“隆中对”。

steps.text: 208: Goes to Sun Quan at Chaisang and persuades him to ally with Liu Bei; the alliance defeats Cao Cao at Red Cliffs.
steps.text_zh: 208年，出使柴桑说服孙权联刘抗曹，孙刘联军随后在赤壁大败曹操。

steps.text: 214: Leads troops up the Yangtze to join the siege of Chengdu; once Liu Bei holds Yi Province he runs its government.
steps.text_zh: 214年，率军溯江入蜀，会攻成都；刘备得益州后，由他主持政务。

steps.text: 223: The dying Liu Bei entrusts his son Liu Shan to him at Baidi.
steps.text_zh: 223年，刘备在白帝城病危，托孤于诸葛亮。

steps.text: 225: Campaigns in the far south to pacify the Nanzhong peoples, by legend capturing Meng Huo seven times.
steps.text_zh: 225年，率军南征平定南中，传说曾七擒孟获。

steps.text: 227: Submits the 'Memorial on Sending Out the Army' and moves his headquarters to Hanzhong to attack Wei.
steps.text_zh: 227年，上《出师表》，进驻汉中，准备北伐曹魏。

steps.text: 228: His first northern campaign collapses when Ma Su loses Jieting; he executes Ma Su and demotes himself.
steps.text_zh: 228年，首次北伐因马谡失街亭而失败，他挥泪斩马谡，自请贬降。

steps.text: 231: Besieges Mount Qi again, using his 'wooden oxen' to move grain, and fights Sima Yi until supplies run out.
steps.text_zh: 231年，再出祁山，以木牛运粮，与司马懿对峙，因粮尽退兵。

steps.text: 234: Dies of illness in camp at Wuzhang Plains during his last northern campaign.
steps.text_zh: 234年，最后一次北伐中病逝于五丈原军中。

title: Faxian's pilgrimage
summary: In his sixties, Faxian walked from Chang'an across the Taklamakan and the Pamirs to India, then sailed home by Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia with Buddhist texts.
summary_zh: 法显年过六旬从长安出发，穿越沙漠和葱岭到达天竺，再经狮子国由海路归国，携回大批佛经。

steps.text: 337: Born in Pingyang commandery (around modern Linfen, Shanxi); he is given to the monastery as a child.
steps.text_zh: 337年，生于平阳郡武阳（今山西临汾一带），幼年即出家为沙弥。

steps.text: 399: Troubled that China lacks a complete monastic code, he sets out from Chang'an with fellow monks to find it in India.
steps.text_zh: 399年，因慨叹中土戒律残缺，与同伴从长安出发西行求法。

steps.text: 400: Leaves Dunhuang to cross the 'river of sand', with only dead men's bones to mark the way.
steps.text_zh: 400年，自敦煌出发渡“沙河”，“唯以死人枯骨为标识”。

steps.text: 401: Stays in Khotan, a flourishing Buddhist kingdom, and watches its great image procession.
steps.text_zh: 401年，在佛教兴盛的于阗停留，观看盛大的行像仪式。

steps.text: 402: Crosses the Pamirs and the Indus gorges into Udyana and Gandhara, visiting the great stupa at Purushapura.
steps.text_zh: 402年，翻越葱岭，经印度河峡谷进入乌苌、犍陀罗，礼拜弗楼沙大塔。

steps.text: 405: Settles for three years at Pataliputra to learn Sanskrit and copy the vinaya, after visiting Buddhist holy sites.
steps.text_zh: 405年，巡礼佛陀圣迹后，在巴连弗邑住三年，学梵语、抄写戒律。

steps.text: 410: Sails to Sri Lanka and spends two years at Anuradhapura; a Chinese silk fan in a temple moves him to tears.
steps.text_zh: 410年，乘船至狮子国，在无畏山寺住两年，见商人供奉的晋地白绢扇而潸然泪下。

steps.text: 412: After a stormy voyage by way of Southeast Asia, he lands far off course on the Shandong coast at Mount Lao.
steps.text_zh: 412年，归途经南海诸国，屡遇风暴，最终漂抵青州长广郡牢山（崂山）登岸。

steps.text: 413: In Jiankang he translates scriptures with Buddhabhadra and writes his travel record, the Foguo ji.
steps.text_zh: 413年，到建康道场寺，与佛驮跋陀罗合译经律，撰写《佛国记》。

steps.text: c. 422: Dies at Xin Monastery in Jingzhou, in his mid-eighties.
steps.text_zh: 约422年，圆寂于荆州辛寺，年八十余。

title: Xuanzang's journey to India
summary: Xuanzang left Tang China illegally, spent seventeen years travelling and studying in Central Asia and India, and returned to translate the texts he brought back.
summary_zh: 玄奘私自出关西行，在中亚与印度游学十七年，归国后翻译带回的大量佛经。

steps.text: 602: Born Chen Yi at Goushi near Luoyang; he enters the monastery in Luoyang as a boy.
steps.text_zh: 602年，生于洛阳缑氏（今偃师），俗名陈祎，少年在洛阳出家。

steps.text: 622: Having fled the chaos at the fall of Sui, he receives full ordination in Chengdu and studies with famous teachers.
steps.text_zh: 622年，隋末战乱时避居成都，在此受具足戒，遍访名师。

steps.text: 629: Frustrated by conflicting translations, he slips out of Chang'an westward without the emperor's permission.
steps.text_zh: 629年，因经论译本歧异，未获朝廷批准便私自离开长安西行。

steps.text: 630: King Qu Wentai of Gaochang tries to keep him, then sends him on with letters, gold and an escort.
steps.text_zh: 630年，高昌王麴文泰苦留不成，与他结为兄弟，赠以书信、钱财和随从。

steps.text: 630: Crosses the Tian Shan and meets the Western Turkic khagan near Suyab, who grants him safe passage.
steps.text_zh: 630年，翻越天山，在碎叶附近谒见西突厥可汗，获得通行保护。

steps.text: 631: Reaches Nalanda, India's greatest monastery, and studies Yogacara for five years under the aged master Silabhadra.
steps.text_zh: 631年，抵达那烂陀寺，师从戒贤法师学习瑜伽行派五年。

steps.text: 642: At King Harsha's great assembly at Kanyakubja, he defends his doctrine for eighteen days without being refuted.
steps.text_zh: 642年，在戒日王于曲女城召开的大会上立论，十八天无人能驳，声名大振。

steps.text: 644: On the way home he waits in Khotan for Emperor Taizong's reply to his letter seeking pardon.
steps.text_zh: 644年，归途在于阗上表唐太宗，等待朝廷宽宥。

steps.text: 645: Welcomed back to Chang'an with 657 texts; he dictates the Great Tang Records of the Western Regions and later builds the Big Wild Goose Pagoda.
steps.text_zh: 645年，携经657部回到长安，受到盛大欢迎，口述《大唐西域记》，后建大雁塔藏经。

steps.text: 664: Dies at Yuhua Monastery north of Chang'an soon after finishing his translation of the vast Prajnaparamita sutra.
steps.text_zh: 664年，译完《大般若经》后不久，圆寂于玉华寺。

title: Jianzhen's voyages to Japan
summary: The Yangzhou monk Jianzhen accepted an invitation to Japan, failed five times over twelve years, went blind, and finally reached Nara to found its ordination tradition.
summary_zh: 扬州高僧鉴真应邀东渡日本，十二年间五次失败、双目失明，第六次终抵奈良，开创日本律宗。

steps.text: 688: Born in Yangzhou, the great port at the junction of the Grand Canal and the Yangtze; he becomes a novice at fourteen.
steps.text_zh: 688年，生于大运河与长江交汇的扬州，十四岁出家。

steps.text: 708: Receives full ordination in Chang'an and studies the monastic code in the two capitals.
steps.text_zh: 708年，在长安实际寺受具足戒，在两京研习律学。

steps.text: 742: At Daming Temple the Japanese monks Yoei and Fusho beg him to bring the precepts to Japan, and he decides to go himself.
steps.text_zh: 742年，日本僧人荣叡、普照到大明寺恳请他东渡传戒，鉴真决定亲自前往。

steps.text: 748: His fifth attempt is blown off course for two weeks and lands on the southern tip of Hainan.
steps.text_zh: 748年，第五次东渡遭遇风暴，漂流十四天后到达海南岛南端的振州。

steps.text: 750: Travelling back north through Guangzhou he loses Yoei to illness and, worn by the heat, loses his own sight.
steps.text_zh: 750年，经广州等地北返，途中荣叡病逝，鉴真本人也因劳累和暑热双目失明。

steps.text: 753: Now 65 and blind, he slips aboard a returning Japanese envoy ship for his sixth attempt.
steps.text_zh: 753年，六十五岁且已失明，搭乘日本遣唐使归国船第六次东渡。

steps.text: 753: Lands at Akime on the southern tip of Kyushu at the end of the year.
steps.text_zh: 753年底，在九州南端萨摩国秋妻屋浦登陆。

steps.text: 754: Sets up an ordination platform at Todai-ji and ordains the retired Emperor Shomu.
steps.text_zh: 754年，在奈良东大寺设戒坛，为圣武上皇等人授戒。

steps.text: 763: Dies seated in meditation at Toshodai-ji, the monastery he founded in 759; his portrait statue is still kept there.
steps.text_zh: 763年，在759年创建的唐招提寺结跏趺坐而逝，其坐像至今仍供奉寺中。

title: Li Bai's travels
summary: Born on the Central Asian frontier and raised in Sichuan, Li Bai roamed the Yangtze, served briefly at court, and was caught up in the An Lushan wars before dying on the lower Yangtze.
summary_zh: 李白生于西域、长于蜀中，一生漫游长江南北，曾短暂供奉翰林，又因安史之乱获罪流放，终老当涂。

steps.text: 701: Born in Suyab in Central Asia to a merchant family (by most accounts).
steps.text_zh: 701年，生于西域碎叶城（一说），父亲经商。

steps.text: 705: His family moves to Qinglian in Changlong, Sichuan, where he grows up reading, practising swordplay and visiting Daoist hermits.
steps.text_zh: 705年，随家迁居蜀中昌隆县青莲乡，读书、学剑、访道。

steps.text: 727: After leaving Sichuan down the Yangtze, he marries a granddaughter of a former chancellor and settles at Anlu for about ten years.
steps.text_zh: 727年，出蜀东游后，在安陆娶前宰相许圉师孙女，在此居住约十年。

steps.text: c. 730: Sees off his friend Meng Haoran at the Yellow Crane Tower, one of the best-loved farewell poems in Chinese.
steps.text_zh: 约730年，在黄鹤楼送别孟浩然，写下“故人西辞黄鹤楼”。

steps.text: 742: Summoned to Chang'an by Emperor Xuanzong as a Hanlin poet; court life soon disappoints him.
steps.text_zh: 742年，奉诏入长安供奉翰林，但不久便厌倦宫廷生活。

steps.text: 744: Leaves court and meets the young Du Fu in Luoyang; they travel together through Liang and Song.
steps.text_zh: 744年，赐金放还，在洛阳与杜甫相识，二人同游梁宋。

steps.text: 753: Wanders the south; at Xuancheng he writes of sitting alone with Jingting Mountain.
steps.text_zh: 753年，漫游江南，在宣城写下“相看两不厌，只有敬亭山”。

steps.text: 757: Having joined Prince Yong's fleet from his retreat on Mount Lu, he is jailed at Xunyang when the prince is crushed as a rebel.
steps.text_zh: 757年，自庐山应召入永王李璘幕府，永王兵败后他被投入浔阳狱中。

steps.text: 759: Exiled to distant Yelang, he is pardoned at Baidi and races downriver, writing 'Leaving Baidi at Dawn'.
steps.text_zh: 759年，流放夜郎途中在白帝城遇赦，写下“朝辞白帝彩云间”。

steps.text: 762: Dies at Dangtu while staying with his kinsman Li Yangbing; legend says he drowned trying to embrace the moon.
steps.text_zh: 762年，投奔族叔李阳冰，病逝于当涂；民间传说他醉中捞月溺水而亡。

title: Du Fu's travels
summary: Du Fu sought office in Chang'an for a decade, was swept up in the An Lushan rebellion, and spent his last years drifting through Sichuan and the Yangtze valley.
summary_zh: 杜甫困守长安十年求仕，历经安史之乱，晚年漂泊蜀中与湖湘，最终病逝舟中。

steps.text: 712: Born in Gongxian near Luoyang, grandson of the poet Du Shenyan.
steps.text_zh: 712年，生于河南巩县，祖父为诗人杜审言。

steps.text: c. 736: After failing the exam he travels in Qi and Zhao, and writes 'Gazing at the Mountain' about Mount Tai.
steps.text_zh: 约736年，科举落第后漫游齐赵，作《望岳》：“会当凌绝顶，一览众山小”。

steps.text: 744: Meets Li Bai in Luoyang and travels with him; the friendship marks his poetry for life.
steps.text_zh: 744年，在洛阳结识李白，二人同游，友谊深刻影响了他。

steps.text: 746: Spends ten poor years in Chang'an seeking office, writing of the gap between court luxury and the 'frozen bones on the road'.
steps.text_zh: 746年，入长安求仕，困守十年，写出“朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨”。

steps.text: 757: Escapes from rebel-held Chang'an, where he wrote 'Spring View', to join Emperor Suzong at Fengxiang, and is made Reminder of the Left.
steps.text_zh: 757年，从叛军占据的长安（他在此写下《春望》）逃出，奔赴凤翔行在，授左拾遗。

steps.text: 759: Travelling through war-ravaged Henan, he writes the 'Three Officials' and 'Three Partings'.
steps.text_zh: 759年，在战乱中的河南途中，写下“三吏”“三别”。

steps.text: 759: Gives up his post and takes his family west to Qinzhou, then over the mountains toward Sichuan.
steps.text_zh: 759年，弃官携家西行至秦州，再翻越蜀道南下。

steps.text: 760: Builds his thatched cottage in Chengdu, his calmest years, despite the autumn wind tearing off its roof.
steps.text_zh: 760年，在成都浣花溪畔营建草堂，度过一生中较安定的时光，写有《茅屋为秋风所破歌》。

steps.text: 766: Lives nearly two years at Kuizhou in the Three Gorges, a burst of creativity including 'Climbing High'.
steps.text_zh: 766年，寓居三峡夔州近两年，创作甚丰，有《登高》等名篇。

steps.text: 768: Leaves the Gorges and drifts down to Yueyang, where he writes 'Climbing Yueyang Tower'.
steps.text_zh: 768年，出峡漂泊至岳阳，作《登岳阳楼》。

steps.text: 770: Dies of illness aboard a boat on the Xiang River, by most accounts between Tanzhou and Yuezhou.
steps.text_zh: 770年，病逝于湘江舟中，一说在潭州与岳州之间。

title: Han Yu's career and exiles
summary: Han Yu, champion of 'ancient prose' and Confucian orthodoxy, was twice exiled to the far south for his outspoken memorials but rose to high office.
summary_zh: 韩愈倡导古文、捍卫儒学，因直言两度被贬岭南，晚年仍官至吏部侍郎。

steps.text: 768: Born at Heyang (modern Mengzhou), Henan; orphaned at two, he is raised by his elder brother Han Hui.
steps.text_zh: 768年，生于河阳（今孟州），两岁丧父，由兄长韩会抚养。

steps.text: 777: Follows his brother into exile at Shaozhou in the far south; Han Hui dies there soon after.
steps.text_zh: 777年，随被贬的兄长韩会到岭南韶州，不久韩会病逝。

steps.text: 792: Passes the jinshi exam in Chang'an on his fourth try.
steps.text_zh: 792年，第四次应试，在长安考中进士。

steps.text: 796: Serves on the staff of the military governor at Bianzhou (Kaifeng), and gathers young writers such as Li Ao around him.
steps.text_zh: 796年，入宣武节度使董晋幕府于汴州，李翱等青年从他学文。

steps.text: 803: Demoted to Yangshan in Lingnan after a memorial on drought relief angers the court.
steps.text_zh: 803年，因上疏论天旱人饥触怒权贵，被贬为岭南阳山县令。

steps.text: 817: As adjutant to Pei Du in the Huaixi campaign, he sees Caizhou taken and writes the stele inscription on the victory.
steps.text_zh: 817年，任裴度行军司马参与平定淮西，蔡州攻克后奉命撰《平淮西碑》。

steps.text: 819: His memorial against welcoming a Buddha relic to the palace enrages Emperor Xianzong, and he is nearly put to death.
steps.text_zh: 819年，上《论佛骨表》谏阻迎佛骨入宫，唐宪宗大怒，几乎被处死。

steps.text: 819: Exiled as prefect of Chaozhou; he founds schools and, by legend, drives away the crocodiles with an essay.
steps.text_zh: 819年，被贬潮州刺史，兴办学校，相传作《祭鳄鱼文》驱鳄。

steps.text: 820: Moved to Yuanzhou (Yichun), where he frees bonded servants.
steps.text_zh: 820年，量移袁州刺史，在任赎放被典卖为奴的百姓。

steps.text: 822: Sent alone to the rebel general Wang Tingcou at Zhenzhou, he talks the mutinous army into submission.
steps.text_zh: 822年，奉命宣抚镇州叛将王廷凑，只身入营晓以大义，平息事端。

steps.text: 824: Dies in Chang'an as Vice Minister of Personnel; he is buried in his home region of Heyang.
steps.text_zh: 824年，以吏部侍郎卒于长安，归葬河阳故里。

title: Bai Juyi's travels
summary: Bai Juyi rose through the Tang civil service, wrote plain-spoken poems on social ills, served as governor in the south after exile, and retired to Luoyang.
summary_zh: 白居易仕途起伏，以平易诗风讽喻时弊，贬官江州后出任杭州、苏州刺史，晚年闲居洛阳。

steps.text: 772: Born in Xinzheng, Henan, to a family of minor officials.
steps.text_zh: 772年，生于河南新郑一个小官吏家庭。

steps.text: c. 782: The family moves to Fuli near Xuzhou to escape the regional wars; he grows up there and in Jiangnan.
steps.text_zh: 约782年，为避战乱随家迁居徐州符离，少年时期在此及江南度过。

steps.text: 800: Passes the jinshi exam in Chang'an, among the youngest of his year.
steps.text_zh: 800年，在长安考中进士，是同榜中最年轻的之一。

steps.text: 806: As sheriff of Zhouzhi, near Mawei, he writes the 'Song of Everlasting Regret' about Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.
steps.text_zh: 806年，任盩厔县尉，在马嵬附近写下吟咏唐玄宗与杨贵妃的《长恨歌》。

steps.text: 816: Demoted to Jiangzhou for urging action over a chancellor's murder, he writes the 'Song of the Pipa Player' on the Xunyang river.
steps.text_zh: 816年，因上书请捕刺杀宰相的凶手被贬江州司马，在浔阳江头作《琵琶行》。

steps.text: 819: Moved up the Yangtze to be prefect of Zhongzhou in the Three Gorges region.
steps.text_zh: 819年，调任忠州刺史，溯江入峡。

steps.text: 822: As prefect of Hangzhou he rebuilds the West Lake dike to store water for the fields.
steps.text_zh: 822年，任杭州刺史，修筑西湖堤坝蓄水灌田。

steps.text: 825: Becomes prefect of Suzhou and opens the Shantang canal road to Tiger Hill.
steps.text_zh: 825年，任苏州刺史，开凿山塘河，筑堤通往虎丘。

steps.text: 829: Settles in Luoyang in a series of sinecures, writing and gathering with friends like Liu Yuxi.
steps.text_zh: 829年，以闲职定居洛阳，与刘禹锡等诗友唱和。

steps.text: 846: Dies in Luoyang and is buried on Xiangshan by the Longmen grottoes, where he had called himself the Layman of Xiangshan.
steps.text_zh: 846年，卒于洛阳，葬于龙门香山，他晚年自号“香山居士”。

title: Su Shi's travels
summary: From Sichuan to the capital and then ever farther south, Su Shi's career was a string of postings and exiles that he turned into some of China's greatest poetry.
summary_zh: 从蜀中到汴京，再一路贬向岭南海外，苏轼宦海沉浮，却把每一处贬所都写进了千古诗文。

steps.text: 1037: Born in Meishan, Sichuan, son of the essayist Su Xun and elder brother of Su Zhe.
steps.text_zh: 1037年，生于眉州眉山，父亲是文章家苏洵，弟弟是苏辙。

steps.text: 1057: Passed the jinshi exam in Kaifeng alongside his brother; the examiner Ouyang Xiu hailed his essay.
steps.text_zh: 1057年，与弟弟苏辙同榜考中进士，主考官欧阳修对他的文章大加赞赏。

steps.text: 1061: Took his first post as an assistant administrator in Fengxiang, Shaanxi.
steps.text_zh: 1061年，出任凤翔府签书判官，开始仕宦生涯。

steps.text: 1071: Having clashed with Wang Anshi's reforms, asked to leave the capital and became vice-prefect of Hangzhou, where he wrote many West Lake poems.
steps.text_zh: 1071年，因反对王安石新法，自请外放，任杭州通判，留下大量西湖诗篇。

steps.text: 1074: Governed Mizhou in Shandong; at the Mid-Autumn Festival of 1076 he wrote the famous lyric 'When will the bright moon appear?'
steps.text_zh: 1074年，调任密州知州；1076年中秋在此写下《水调歌头·明月几时有》。

steps.text: 1079: Arrested in Huzhou and brought to the Censorate jail in Kaifeng, charged with mocking the government in his poems — the Crow Terrace Poetry Case.
steps.text_zh: 1079年，在湖州任上被捕，押至京城御史台受审，罪名是作诗讥讽朝政，史称“乌台诗案”。

steps.text: 1082: In exile at Huangzhou since 1080, he farmed the 'Eastern Slope', took the name Dongpo, and wrote the Red Cliff odes.
steps.text_zh: 1082年，自1080年起贬居黄州，躬耕东坡，自号“东坡居士”，写下前后《赤壁赋》。

steps.text: 1089: Returned to Hangzhou as prefect; he dredged West Lake and built the causeway still called the Su Causeway.
steps.text_zh: 1089年，再到杭州任知州，疏浚西湖，筑起后人所称的“苏堤”。

steps.text: 1094: Banished south of the mountains to Huizhou in Guangdong when the reform party returned to power.
steps.text_zh: 1094年，新党重新执政，苏轼被贬到岭南惠州。

steps.text: 1097: Exiled further, across the sea to Danzhou on Hainan Island, where he taught local students for three years.
steps.text_zh: 1097年，再贬海南儋州，在海岛上讲学授徒三年。

steps.text: 1101: Pardoned and heading north, he fell ill and died in Changzhou.
steps.text_zh: 1101年，遇赦北归，途中病倒，卒于常州。

title: Wang Anshi's travels
summary: Wang Anshi learned government in county and prefectural posts across the Yangtze region before leading the New Policies in Kaifeng, then retired to Nanjing.
summary_zh: 王安石在江南州县历练多年，后入京主持变法，罢相后终老江宁。

steps.text: 1021: Born at Linjiang in Jiangxi, where his father was serving; the family came from Linchuan nearby.
steps.text_zh: 1021年，生于父亲任所临江军（今江西樟树），祖籍抚州临川。

steps.text: 1037: The family settled in Jiangning (Nanjing) when his father was posted there; Nanjing became his lifelong home.
steps.text_zh: 1037年，随父亲到江宁任上，从此以江宁为家。

steps.text: 1042: After passing the jinshi exam he took his first post as an assistant administrator in Yangzhou.
steps.text_zh: 1042年，考中进士，出任淮南节度判官，驻扬州。

steps.text: 1047: As county magistrate of Yin, he repaired irrigation works and lent grain to farmers in spring — an early trial of his later reforms.
steps.text_zh: 1047年，任鄞县知县，兴修水利，春荒时贷谷给农民，已见日后新法的雏形。

steps.text: 1051: Served as vice-prefect of Shuzhou in Anhui, declining calls to the capital to keep working in local government.
steps.text_zh: 1051年，任舒州通判，多次推辞入京任职，宁愿留在地方。

steps.text: 1058: In Kaifeng he sent the emperor his 'Ten Thousand Word Memorial' calling for sweeping institutional change.
steps.text_zh: 1058年，在开封向仁宗呈上《言事书》（即“万言书”），力陈改革之必要。

steps.text: 1067: After mourning his mother in Jiangning, he was made its prefect — and the new emperor Shenzong soon summoned him.
steps.text_zh: 1067年，在江宁为母守丧后出任江宁知府，不久被新即位的神宗召入京城。

steps.text: 1069: Appointed to lead state policy, he launched the New Policies: green-sprouts loans, the baojia militia and more.
steps.text_zh: 1069年，拜参知政事，推行青苗法、保甲法等一系列新法。

steps.text: 1086: Retired since 1076 to his Banshan garden outside Nanjing, he died there soon after the new regime repealed his laws.
steps.text_zh: 1086年，自1076年罢相后隐居江宁半山园，新法被废后不久病逝。

title: Fan Zhongyan's travels
summary: An orphan who studied his way into office, Fan Zhongyan built sea dikes, defended the northwest frontier and led the Qingli reforms before ending his days in provincial posts.
summary_zh: 范仲淹幼年孤苦，苦读入仕，修过海堤，守过西北边疆，主持庆历新政，晚年辗转地方。

steps.text: 989: Born in Xuzhou, where his father was a minor official; his father died the next year and his mother remarried into the Zhu family of Shandong.
steps.text_zh: 989年，生于父亲任所徐州；次年父亲去世，母亲改嫁山东长山朱氏。

steps.text: 1011: Studied in poverty at the Yingtian Academy in Shangqiu, famously living on cold porridge; he passed the jinshi exam in 1015.
steps.text_zh: 1011年，到应天府书院苦读，“断齑画粥”的故事即出于此；1015年中进士。

steps.text: 1024: As a salt official on the Taizhou coast he pushed through the rebuilding of a long sea wall, later called 'Lord Fan's Dike'.
steps.text_zh: 1024年，任泰州西溪盐官时主持修筑捍海堰，后人称“范公堤”。

steps.text: 1034: As prefect of Suzhou, his home region, he drained floods and founded the prefectural school.
steps.text_zh: 1034年，出知家乡苏州，疏浚水道治理水患，又创办苏州府学。

steps.text: 1036: Demoted to Raozhou after attacking the chief minister Lü Yijian's patronage system.
steps.text_zh: 1036年，因上疏抨击宰相吕夷简用人不公，被贬饶州。

steps.text: 1040: Sent to the Shaanxi frontier against the Western Xia, he rebuilt forts around Yan'an and trained local troops.
steps.text_zh: 1040年，奉命经略陕西抵御西夏，在延州一带修筑城寨、整训边兵。

steps.text: 1043: Recalled to Kaifeng as vice-chief councillor, he led the short-lived Qingli reforms of the civil service.
steps.text_zh: 1043年，入朝任参知政事，主持庆历新政，整顿吏治，但不久即告失败。

steps.text: 1046: Serving in Dengzhou, he wrote 'On Yueyang Tower' for a friend in Hunan: 'first to worry about the world's worries'.
steps.text_zh: 1046年，在邓州任上应好友滕子京之请写下《岳阳楼记》，提出“先天下之忧而忧”。

steps.text: 1052: Transferred to Yingzhou, he fell ill on the road and died in Xuzhou, the city of his birth.
steps.text_zh: 1052年，改知颍州，赴任途中病逝于徐州，正是他出生之地。

title: Yue Fei's campaigns
summary: A farm boy from Henan who rose to become the Southern Song's most famous general, Yue Fei fought from the Yellow River to Lake Dongting before being recalled and killed in Lin'an.
summary_zh: 河南农家子弟岳飞从军抗金，转战黄河至洞庭，成为南宋名将，最终被召回临安冤死。

steps.text: 1103: Born to a farming family in Tangyin, Henan.
steps.text_zh: 1103年，生于相州汤阴（今河南）一户农家。

steps.text: 1122: Enlisted in Zhending (Hebei) as a volunteer in the Song campaign against the Liao.
steps.text_zh: 1122年，在真定应募从军，参加宋军攻辽之役。

steps.text: 1128: After the Jin sacked Kaifeng, he fought under the veteran commander Zong Ze, who was holding the old capital.
steps.text_zh: 1128年，开封失陷后，在留守东京的宗泽麾下作战，深受器重。

steps.text: 1130: Ambushed the retreating Jin army at Niutou Mountain and recovered Jiankang.
steps.text_zh: 1130年，在牛头山伏击北撤的金军，收复建康。

steps.text: 1134: Led his own army north and took back Xiangyang and five other prefectures from the Jin puppet state of Qi.
steps.text_zh: 1134年，独领一军北上，从伪齐手中收复襄阳等六郡。

steps.text: 1135: Crushed Yang Yao's long-running rebellion on Lake Dongting, securing the Song rear.
steps.text_zh: 1135年，平定盘踞洞庭湖多年的杨幺起事，稳定后方。

steps.text: 1140: Defeated the Jin cavalry at Yancheng and pushed close to Kaifeng, before twelve gold-lacquered orders called him back.
steps.text_zh: 1140年，在郾城大败金军骑兵，兵锋逼近开封，却被朝廷以十二道金牌召回。

steps.text: 1142: Stripped of his command and jailed in Lin'an on Qin Hui's false charges, he was put to death as peace with the Jin was sealed.
steps.text_zh: 1142年，被解除兵权后遭秦桧诬陷下狱，在宋金和议达成之际于临安遇害。

title: Li Qingzhao's journeys
summary: Li Qingzhao's life ran from a scholarly home in Shandong to the capital and then, after the Jin invasion, into years of flight across the south carrying what remained of her husband's collection.
summary_zh: 李清照生于齐鲁书香之家，婚后居汴京、青州；靖康之变后流离江南，守护亡夫的金石收藏。

steps.text: 1084: Born in Zhangqiu near Jinan; her father Li Gefei was a noted scholar-official.
steps.text_zh: 1084年，生于济南章丘，父亲李格非是有名的学者官员。

steps.text: 1101: In the capital she married Zhao Mingcheng, a student at the Imperial Academy who shared her love of antiquities.
steps.text_zh: 1101年，在汴京嫁给太学生赵明诚，夫妇同好金石书画。

steps.text: 1107: After factional purges, the couple withdrew to Qingzhou for about ten years, building their collection of inscriptions.
steps.text_zh: 1107年，因党争牵连，夫妇屏居青州约十年，潜心搜集金石碑刻。

steps.text: 1128: Fleeing the Jin invasion, she joined her husband in Jiankang, where he was prefect; he died there in 1129.
steps.text_zh: 1128年，南渡避乱，到丈夫任职的江宁府会合；次年赵明诚病逝于建康。

steps.text: 1130: Alone, she followed the fleeing court down the Zhejiang coast as far as Wenzhou, losing much of the collection on the way.
steps.text_zh: 1130年，独自追随南逃的朝廷沿浙东一路到温州，收藏在途中散失大半。

steps.text: 1132: In Hangzhou she married Zhang Ruzhou, but within months sued for divorce and was briefly jailed for it.
steps.text_zh: 1132年，在杭州再嫁张汝舟，数月后告发对方并请求离异，自己也因此短暂入狱。

steps.text: 1134: Taking refuge in Jinhua, she wrote the afterword to her late husband's 'Records on Metal and Stone'.
steps.text_zh: 1134年，避难金华，为亡夫的《金石录》写下后序。

steps.text: 1155: She spent her last years in Lin'an and probably died there; the exact date is uncertain.
steps.text_zh: 1155年前后，晚年寓居临安，一般认为卒于此地，确切年份不详。

title: Lu You's travels
summary: Lu You, poet of the lost north, moved between his Shaoxing home, minor posts and a cherished spell on the Sichuan frontier, never seeing the reconquest he longed for.
summary_zh: 陆游一生心系北伐，往返于山阴故里与各地任所，最难忘的是在川陕前线的岁月。

steps.text: 1125: Born, by tradition on a boat on the Huai River, into a scholar family of Shanyin (Shaoxing), just as the Jin invasion began.
steps.text_zh: 1125年，出生于山阴（今绍兴）一个士大夫家庭，据说生在淮河的船上，正值金兵南下之际。

steps.text: 1154: Sat the ministry examination in Lin'an, but was struck off after he had outranked Qin Hui's grandson in an earlier round.
steps.text_zh: 1154年，赴临安参加礼部考试，因此前名次压过秦桧之孙而被黜落。

steps.text: 1158: After Qin Hui's death he finally entered office, as registrar of Ningde county in Fujian.
steps.text_zh: 1158年，秦桧死后才得以入仕，出任福州宁德县主簿。

steps.text: 1170: Sailed up the Yangtze to a post at Kuizhou in the Three Gorges, keeping the travel diary 'Journey into Shu'.
steps.text_zh: 1170年，溯长江入蜀，赴夔州通判任，沿途写成《入蜀记》。

steps.text: 1172: Joined Wang Yan's frontier staff at Nanzheng facing the Jin — the months he later remembered as the best of his life.
steps.text_zh: 1172年，入王炎幕府到南郑前线，这段军旅生活成为他晚年诗中反复追忆的高光时刻。

steps.text: 1173: Spent five years in and around Chengdu, serving under his friend Fan Chengda and taking the name 'Old Man Who Doesn't Care'.
steps.text_zh: 1173年，此后数年在成都一带任职，与范成大交游，自号“放翁”。

steps.text: 1186: Served as prefect of Yanzhou in Zhejiang, where he printed his collected poems.
steps.text_zh: 1186年，任严州知州，在任上刊刻了自己的诗集。

steps.text: 1210: After long retirement in Shanyin he died at 85, leaving the poem 'To My Son' asking to be told when the north was recovered.
steps.text_zh: 1210年，长期闲居山阴后去世，享年八十五岁，临终写下《示儿》：“王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁。”

title: Wen Tianxiang's last stand
summary: Top scholar turned resistance leader, Wen Tianxiang fought for the dying Song from Jiangxi to the Guangdong coast and chose execution in Dadu over serving the Yuan.
summary_zh: 状元出身的文天祥在宋亡之际起兵抗元，从江西转战至广东沿海，被俘后宁死不降，就义于大都。

steps.text: 1236: Born in Luling, Jizhou (Ji'an), Jiangxi.
steps.text_zh: 1236年，生于江西吉州庐陵。

steps.text: 1256: Placed first in the palace examination in Lin'an.
steps.text_zh: 1256年，在临安殿试中被理宗钦点为状元。

steps.text: 1275: As the Mongols advanced, he spent his family fortune raising an army in Ganzhou to defend the capital.
steps.text_zh: 1275年，元军南下，他在赣州散尽家财招募义军，入卫京城。

steps.text: 1276: Detained by the Mongol commander Bayan while negotiating outside Lin'an, he escaped at Zhenjiang and made his way south.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，赴元营谈判时被伯颜扣留，押解北上途中在镇江脱逃南归。

steps.text: 1276: Joined the young emperor's loyalist court in Fuzhou and was sent out to rally resistance.
steps.text_zh: 1276年，到福州投奔新立的端宗朝廷，受命出外招兵抗元。

steps.text: 1278: Surprised by Yuan troops at Wupoling in Haifeng, Guangdong, he was captured.
steps.text_zh: 1278年，在广东海丰五坡岭遭元军突袭被俘。

steps.text: 1279: Taken by sea past Lingding Bay, he wrote his famous poem and then watched from a Yuan ship as the last Song fleet was destroyed at Yamen.
steps.text_zh: 1279年，被押经零丁洋，写下《过零丁洋》，随后在元军船上目睹崖山海战宋军覆没。

steps.text: 1283: After more than three years in a Dadu prison, where he wrote the 'Song of Righteousness', he refused Kublai's offer and was executed.
steps.text_zh: 1283年，在大都囚禁三年多，写下《正气歌》，拒绝忽必烈招降，从容就义。

title: Kublai Khan's journeys
summary: Kublai moved from governing Mongol lands in north China to conquering Dali, besieging the Song, winning a civil war and ruling a new empire from twin capitals at Shangdu and Dadu.
summary_zh: 忽必烈从总领漠南汉地起步，远征大理、南攻鄂州，夺得汗位后以上都、大都两京统治元朝。

steps.text: 1251: When his brother Möngke became Great Khan, Kublai was given charge of the conquered Chinese lands south of the Gobi.
steps.text_zh: 1251年，兄长蒙哥即大汗位，命忽必烈总领漠南汉地军国庶事。

steps.text: 1253: Led a long march through western Sichuan to conquer the Dali Kingdom in Yunnan.
steps.text_zh: 1253年，率军经川西远征，灭大理国。

steps.text: 1256: Had Liu Bingzhong build the city of Kaiping on the steppe edge, later his summer capital Shangdu.
steps.text_zh: 1256年，命刘秉忠在金莲川营建开平城，即日后的上都。

steps.text: 1259: Besieging the Song city of Ezhou on the Yangtze when news came of Möngke's death; he made a truce and hurried north.
steps.text_zh: 1259年，正围攻长江边的鄂州时，传来蒙哥死讯，遂与宋议和北返。

steps.text: 1260: Proclaimed Great Khan at Kaiping, starting a four-year war with his brother Ariq Böke.
steps.text_zh: 1260年，在开平即大汗位，随即与弟弟阿里不哥展开四年争位战争。

steps.text: 1271: Named his dynasty Yuan; the new capital Dadu, under construction since 1267, became the seat of his empire.
steps.text_zh: 1271年，定国号为“元”；1267年开始营建的大都随后成为帝国都城。

steps.text: 1287: At about 72, he personally led the army that crushed the rebellion of the Mongol prince Nayan in the northeast.
steps.text_zh: 1287年，年逾七十仍亲征东北，平定宗王乃颜之乱。

steps.text: 1294: Died in Dadu after a reign of 34 years.
steps.text_zh: 1294年，在位三十四年后病逝于大都。

title: Zheng He's voyages
summary: Taken captive as a boy in Yunnan, Zheng He became a palace eunuch and commanded seven great Ming fleets across the Indian Ocean as far as East Africa.
summary_zh: 郑和幼年在云南被俘入宫，后来统领明朝庞大船队七下西洋，最远到达东非。

steps.text: 1371: Born Ma He into a Muslim family in Kunyang, Yunnan; his father and grandfather had made the pilgrimage to Mecca.
steps.text_zh: 1371年，生于云南昆阳一个回族家庭，本姓马，祖父和父亲都曾朝觐麦加。

steps.text: 1382: Captured as a boy when Ming armies took Yunnan, he was castrated and sent to serve Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, in Beiping.
steps.text_zh: 约1382年，明军平定云南时被俘，入宫为宦官，后分到燕王朱棣府中，随侍北平。

steps.text: 1405: Sailed from Liujiagang near the Yangtze mouth in command of the first treasure fleet, over 200 ships.
steps.text_zh: 1405年，统率两百余艘宝船，从长江口的刘家港首次出发下西洋。

steps.text: 1407: On the way home he defeated the pirate chief Chen Zuyi at Palembang in Sumatra and brought him to Nanjing.
steps.text_zh: 1407年，回程中在苏门答腊旧港击败海盗头目陈祖义，押回南京。

steps.text: 1409: Called at Malacca, recognising its ruler and making it a key base for later voyages.
steps.text_zh: 1409年，到访满剌加，册封其国王，此后这里成为船队的重要中转站。

steps.text: 1411: Fought and captured the Ceylonese king Alakeshvara after being attacked on land in Sri Lanka.
steps.text_zh: 1411年，在锡兰遭当地国王亚烈苦奈儿袭击，反击并将其俘虏。

steps.text: 1414: The fourth voyage pushed past India to Hormuz at the mouth of the Persian Gulf.
steps.text_zh: 1414年，第四次下西洋越过印度，抵达波斯湾口的忽鲁谟斯。

steps.text: 1418: Ships of the fifth voyage reached the East African coast around Malindi; envoys from there later brought a giraffe to China.
steps.text_zh: 1418年前后，第五次航行的船队到达东非麻林一带，当地使者后来把长颈鹿带到了中国。

steps.text: 1425: With the voyages halted, he served as garrison commander of Nanjing and oversaw work on the Porcelain Tower.
steps.text_zh: 1425年，远航暂停，出任南京守备，并督造大报恩寺。

steps.text: 1431: Waiting for the monsoon at Changle in Fujian before the seventh voyage, he set up a stele recording all his voyages.
steps.text_zh: 1431年，第七次出海前在福建长乐候风，立《天妃灵应之记》碑，记述历次航行。

steps.text: 1433: Died on the return leg of the last voyage, probably near Calicut in India.
steps.text_zh: 1433年，在最后一次航行的归途中去世，一说卒于印度古里。

title: Wang Yangming's journeys
summary: Philosopher, official and general, Wang Yangming found his central insight in exile in Guizhou and spent his later years putting down rebellions across south China.
summary_zh: 王阳明集思想家、官员和统帅于一身，在贵州贬所龙场悟道，后半生转战江西、两广。

steps.text: 1472: Born Wang Shouren in Yuyao, Zhejiang.
steps.text_zh: 1472年，生于浙江余姚，本名王守仁。

steps.text: 1499: Passed the jinshi exam in Beijing, where he had spent part of his youth; in 1506 he was flogged at court for defending officials against the eunuch Liu Jin.
steps.text_zh: 1499年，在少年时随父居住过的北京考中进士；1506年上疏援救言官，触怒宦官刘瑾，遭廷杖。

steps.text: 1508: Banished to the remote post station of Longchang in Guizhou, he realised that principle lies within the mind.
steps.text_zh: 1508年，被贬到贵州龙场驿当驿丞，在此顿悟“心即理”。

steps.text: 1510: After Liu Jin's fall he was made magistrate of Luling in Jiangxi.
steps.text_zh: 1510年，刘瑾倒台后，出任江西庐陵知县。

steps.text: 1517: Appointed governor of southern Jiangxi, he cleared out bandit strongholds in the mountains along the Fujian–Guangdong border.
steps.text_zh: 1517年，巡抚南赣，平定闽粤赣交界山区多年的匪患。

steps.text: 1519: Raised troops on his own initiative and crushed the Prince of Ning's rebellion within about forty days.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，自行起兵，约四十天便平定宁王朱宸濠之乱。

steps.text: 1521: Home in Shaoxing, he taught hundreds of students his doctrine of 'extending innate knowledge'.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，回到绍兴家乡讲学，倡导“致良知”，门人众多。

steps.text: 1528: Sent to Guangxi, he settled the Si'en and Tianzhou uprisings and broke the Bajiang rebels at Duanteng Gorge.
steps.text_zh: 1528年，奉命赴广西，招抚思恩、田州，又攻破断藤峡、八寨。

steps.text: 1529: Died aboard his boat at Nan'an in Jiangxi on the way home, saying 'This heart is bright and clear; what more is there to say?'
steps.text_zh: 1529年，归途中病逝于江西南安舟中，遗言“此心光明，亦复何言”。

title: Xu Xiake's travels
summary: Xu Xiake spent some thirty years walking China's mountains and rivers, ending with a four-year journey through the southwest that produced his famous travel diaries.
summary_zh: 徐霞客用三十余年遍游名山大川，最后四年万里西南之行，写成传世的《徐霞客游记》。

steps.text: 1587: Born in Jiangyin, Jiangsu, to a well-off family; he gave up the examinations to travel.
steps.text_zh: 1587年，生于江苏江阴一个殷实人家，后来放弃科举，立志远游。

steps.text: 1613: His travel diaries open with a trip to Mount Tiantai in Zhejiang.
steps.text_zh: 1613年，游浙江天台山，《游天台山日记》成为游记的开篇。

steps.text: 1616: Climbed Huangshan in the snow, then went on to the Wuyi Mountains in Fujian.
steps.text_zh: 1616年，冒雪登黄山，随后又游福建武夷山。

steps.text: 1623: Toured the sacred peaks of central China — Songshan, Huashan and Wudang.
steps.text_zh: 1623年，游中岳嵩山、西岳华山和武当山。

steps.text: 1633: Travelled north to Wutai Shan and the northern Mount Heng in Shanxi.
steps.text_zh: 1633年，北上山西，游五台山和北岳恒山。

steps.text: 1637: On his great southwestern journey, begun late in 1636, he was robbed of almost everything on the Xiang River near Hengyang but kept going.
steps.text_zh: 1637年，前一年冬天开始的西南远游途中，在衡阳附近湘江上遇盗，几乎被抢光，仍坚持前行。

steps.text: 1637: Explored the limestone peaks and caves around Guilin, recording them in careful detail.
steps.text_zh: 1637年，考察桂林一带的石灰岩峰林和溶洞，记录极为详尽。

steps.text: 1638: In Guizhou he wrote the first detailed description of the Huangguoshu waterfall.
steps.text_zh: 1638年，在贵州留下关于黄果树瀑布的最早详细记载。

steps.text: 1639: Received in Lijiang by the Naxi chieftain Mu Zeng, who asked him to edit his writings.
steps.text_zh: 1639年，到丽江受到纳西土司木增的款待，并应邀为其校订文稿。

steps.text: 1639: Reached Tengchong near the Burmese border, the westernmost point of his travels.
steps.text_zh: 1639年，到达靠近缅甸边境的腾冲，这是他一生游历的最西端。

steps.text: 1641: Taken ill in Yunnan, he was carried home in 1640 and died in Jiangyin the next year.
steps.text_zh: 1641年，前一年在云南患病，被人抬送回乡，此时卒于江阴家中。

title: Lin Zexu's journeys
summary: Lin Zexu rose through posts across China, confronted the opium trade at Canton, and served out his exile developing the far northwest before dying on a last mission south.
summary_zh: 林则徐宦游大半个中国，在广东禁烟抗英，被贬新疆后仍兴修水利，最后在南下途中病逝。

steps.text: 1785: Born in Fuzhou, Fujian, to a poor scholar's family.
steps.text_zh: 1785年，生于福建福州一个清贫的读书人家庭。

steps.text: 1811: Passed the jinshi exam and entered the Hanlin Academy in Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1811年，考中进士，入翰林院。

steps.text: 1832: As governor of Jiangsu he worked on flood relief and water control in the lower Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 1832年，任江苏巡抚，在江南办理赈灾和水利。

steps.text: 1837: As governor-general of Hubei and Hunan he ran a vigorous anti-opium campaign, which led the emperor to choose him for Canton.
steps.text_zh: 1837年，任湖广总督，在两湖大力禁烟，成效显著，因而被道光帝选派广东。

steps.text: 1839: As imperial commissioner in Canton he seized over a million kilograms of British opium and destroyed it on the beach at Humen.
steps.text_zh: 1839年，以钦差大臣身份到广州，收缴英商鸦片两百多万斤，在虎门海滩当众销毁。

steps.text: 1841: Dismissed after the Opium War broke out, he was diverted on his way into exile to help close a Yellow River breach at Kaifeng.
steps.text_zh: 1841年，鸦片战争爆发后被革职，发配途中被派往开封协助堵塞黄河决口。

steps.text: 1842: Arrived in exile at Ili in Xinjiang, where he promoted irrigation and land reclamation.
steps.text_zh: 1842年，到达新疆伊犁戍所，在当地倡导兴修水利、开垦荒地。

steps.text: 1845: Surveyed new farmland across southern Xinjiang, taking an interest in the karez underground channels of Turpan.
steps.text_zh: 1845年，奉命到南疆各地勘察垦地，留意吐鲁番的坎儿井。

steps.text: 1847: Pardoned and restored to high office, he served as governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
steps.text_zh: 1847年，获赦重新起用，出任云贵总督。

steps.text: 1850: Called back to fight the Taiping rising in Guangxi, he died on the road at Puning in eastern Guangdong.
steps.text_zh: 1850年，奉命前往广西镇压太平军，行至广东普宁时病逝。

title: Kang Youwei's journeys
summary: Kang Youwei went from Cantonese scholar to leader of the 1898 reforms, then spent sixteen years in exile around the world before returning to a republic he never accepted.
summary_zh: 康有为由岭南学者成为戊戌变法的领袖，变法失败后流亡海外十六年，回国后始终不认同共和。

steps.text: 1858: Born in Nanhai county near Guangzhou to a scholar-official family.
steps.text_zh: 1858年，生于广东南海县一个官宦读书人家。

steps.text: 1879: A visit to British-ruled Hong Kong showed him an orderly Western-style city and set him reading about the West.
steps.text_zh: 1879年，游历香港，见识西式城市管理井然有序，开始留心西学。

steps.text: 1891: Opened the Wanmu Caotang school in Guangzhou, where Liang Qichao became his student.
steps.text_zh: 1891年，在广州开设万木草堂讲学，梁启超即在此拜他为师。

steps.text: 1895: In Beijing for the exams when the Treaty of Shimonoseki was signed, he led over a thousand candidates in a petition against it.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，在北京应试时恰逢《马关条约》签订，联合千余名举人上书反对，史称“公车上书”。

steps.text: 1895: Set up a branch of the Self-Strengthening Society in Shanghai to spread reform ideas.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，在上海设立强学会分会，宣传变法。

steps.text: 1898: Summoned by the Guangxu Emperor, he drove the Hundred Days' Reform until Cixi's coup forced him to flee.
steps.text_zh: 1898年，受光绪帝召见，主导百日维新；慈禧发动政变后被迫出逃。

steps.text: 1898: Escaped via Hong Kong to Japan, beginning sixteen years of exile.
steps.text_zh: 1898年，经香港逃往日本，开始长达十六年的流亡。

steps.text: 1899: In Victoria, Canada, he founded the Protect the Emperor Society among overseas Chinese.
steps.text_zh: 1899年，在加拿大维多利亚创立保皇会，在海外华人中募款。

steps.text: 1913: After touring much of the world, he came home on his mother's death and settled in Shanghai.
steps.text_zh: 1913年，游历世界多国后，因母亲去世归国，定居上海。

steps.text: 1917: Took part in Zhang Xun's twelve-day attempt to restore the Qing emperor in Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，参与张勋在北京发动的复辟，仅十二天便告失败。

steps.text: 1927: Died in Qingdao, where he had spent his last years.
steps.text_zh: 1927年，卒于晚年居住的青岛。

title: Sun Yat-sen's journeys
summary: Sun Yat-sen spent much of his life abroad raising money and support for revolution, returning to lead the new Republic and later to rebuild his movement from Guangzhou.
summary_zh: 孙中山大半生奔走海外，为革命筹款联络，辛亥后回国就任临时大总统，晚年在广州重整革命。

steps.text: 1866: Born in Cuiheng village, Xiangshan county (now Zhongshan), Guangdong.
steps.text_zh: 1866年，生于广东香山县翠亨村（今属中山）。

steps.text: 1879: Joined his elder brother in Hawaii and studied at Iolani School in Honolulu.
steps.text_zh: 1879年，到夏威夷投奔兄长孙眉，入檀香山意奥兰尼学校读书。

steps.text: 1887: Studied at the Hong Kong College of Medicine for Chinese, graduating in 1892.
steps.text_zh: 1887年，入香港西医书院学医，1892年毕业。

steps.text: 1895: Having founded the Revive China Society in Honolulu the year before, he plotted an uprising in Guangzhou; it was discovered and he fled abroad.
steps.text_zh: 1895年，前一年在檀香山创立兴中会，此时策划广州起义，事泄失败，流亡海外。

steps.text: 1896: Kidnapped and held at the Qing legation in London; his release after press outcry made him famous.
steps.text_zh: 1896年，在伦敦被清朝公使馆诱捕囚禁，经舆论营救获释，从此声名远播。

steps.text: 1905: Founded the Tongmenghui in Tokyo, uniting revolutionary groups under his Three Principles of the People.
steps.text_zh: 1905年，在东京成立中国同盟会，提出三民主义。

steps.text: 1911: Was fundraising in the United States and read of the Wuchang Uprising in a Denver newspaper.
steps.text_zh: 1911年，在美国筹款，于丹佛从报纸上得知武昌起义的消息。

steps.text: 1912: Sworn in at Nanjing as provisional president of the Republic of China, then yielded the post to Yuan Shikai.
steps.text_zh: 1912年，在南京就任中华民国临时大总统，不久让位于袁世凯。

steps.text: 1917: Set up a rival military government in Guangzhou to defend the constitution against the Beiyang regime.
steps.text_zh: 1917年，在广州组织护法军政府，与北洋政府对抗。

steps.text: 1922: Driven from Guangzhou by Chen Jiongming's revolt, he moved to Shanghai and in 1923 agreed on Soviet aid with Adolph Joffe.
steps.text_zh: 1922年，陈炯明叛变后离开广州到上海，次年与苏俄代表越飞发表联合宣言。

steps.text: 1924: Back in Guangzhou, he reorganised the Kuomintang in alliance with the Communists and founded the Whampoa Military Academy.
steps.text_zh: 1924年，回到广州改组国民党，实行国共合作，创办黄埔军校。

steps.text: 1925: Travelled north for talks on reunification and died of cancer in Beijing.
steps.text_zh: 1925年，北上共商国是，因肝癌病逝于北京。

title: Hannibal's campaigns and exile
summary: From Carthage to Spain, over the Alps into Italy, back to defeat at Zama and a long exile in the eastern Mediterranean.
summary_zh: 生于迦太基，经西班牙翻越阿尔卑斯山转战意大利，回师兵败扎马，晚年流亡地中海东部。

steps.text: 247 BC: Born in Carthage, son of the general Hamilcar Barca, near the end of the First Punic War.
steps.text_zh: 前247年，生于迦太基，父亲是名将哈米尔卡·巴卡，时值第一次布匿战争末期。

steps.text: 237 BC: Sailed with his father to Iberia, landing at Gades; by tradition he had sworn eternal enmity to Rome before leaving.
steps.text_zh: 前237年，随父渡海到伊比利亚，在加的斯登陆。传说临行前他曾发誓永远与罗马为敌。

steps.text: 221 BC: After his brother-in-law Hasdrubal was assassinated, the army at New Carthage chose him, aged about 26, as commander in Spain.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，姐夫哈斯德鲁巴遇刺，新迦太基的军队推举年约二十六岁的他为西班牙统帅。

steps.text: 219 BC: Besieged and took Saguntum, a city allied to Rome; Rome declared war, opening the Second Punic War.
steps.text_zh: 前219年，围攻并攻下罗马的盟城萨贡托，罗马随即宣战，第二次布匿战争爆发。

steps.text: 218 BC: Marched from Spain across the Pyrenees and the Rhône and crossed the Alps with his army and elephants, losing many men to cold and ambush.
steps.text_zh: 前218年，自西班牙出兵，越过比利牛斯山和罗讷河，率大军和战象翻越阿尔卑斯山，途中因严寒和伏击折损大半。

steps.text: 217 BC: Ambushed a Roman army on the shore of Lake Trasimene and destroyed it, killing the consul Flaminius.
steps.text_zh: 前217年，在特拉西梅诺湖畔设伏，全歼一支罗马军队，执政官弗拉米尼乌斯战死。

steps.text: 216 BC: Encircled and annihilated a much larger Roman army at Cannae, the masterpiece of his career; yet Rome refused to make peace.
steps.text_zh: 前216年，在坎尼以少胜多，合围歼灭罗马大军，成为他一生的杰作，但罗马仍拒绝议和。

steps.text: 202 BC: Recalled to Africa after fifteen years in Italy, he was defeated by Scipio at Zama, and Carthage sued for peace.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，在意大利转战十五年后被召回非洲，于扎马败给西庇阿，迦太基被迫求和。

steps.text: 195 BC: After reforming Carthage's government as chief magistrate, he fled Roman pressure and joined the Seleucid king Antiochus III at Ephesus as an adviser.
steps.text_zh: 前195年，他出任迦太基执政官推行改革，后因罗马施压出逃，投奔塞琉古国王安条克三世，在以弗所充当谋士。

steps.text: 183 BC: After years of wandering, he was sheltering with the king of Bithynia when Rome demanded his surrender; he took poison rather than be handed over.
steps.text_zh: 前183年，几经辗转后寄身比提尼亚国王处，罗马索要其人，他服毒自尽，不愿落入敌手。

title: Julius Caesar's campaigns
summary: From Rome to Rhodes, Spain, Gaul and Britain, across the Rubicon into civil war from Greece to Egypt and Africa, and back to Rome to die.
summary_zh: 从罗马出发，历经罗得岛、西班牙、高卢和不列颠，渡过卢比孔河发动内战，转战希腊、埃及、北非，最终死于罗马。

steps.text: 100 BC: Born in Rome into the old but not wealthy patrician family of the Julii.
steps.text_zh: 前100年，生于罗马，出身古老但并不富裕的尤利乌斯贵族家族。

steps.text: 75 BC: Sailing to Rhodes to study rhetoric, he was captured by pirates; once ransomed, he hunted them down and had them crucified.
steps.text_zh: 前75年，前往罗得岛学习修辞，途中被海盗劫持。赎回后他组织船队追捕海盗，将其钉死在十字架上。

steps.place_zh: 远西班牙行省科尔杜巴
steps.text: 61 BC: Governed Further Spain, campaigning in Lusitania and winning the wealth and military reputation he needed.
steps.text_zh: 前61年，出任远西班牙行省总督，征讨卢西塔尼亚，积累了财富和军功。

steps.text: 60 BC: Back in Rome, he joined Pompey and Crassus in the informal First Triumvirate and won the consulship for 59 BC.
steps.text_zh: 前60年，回到罗马，与庞培、克拉苏结成“前三头同盟”，并当选次年执政官。

steps.text: 55 BC: In the middle of his Gallic Wars he bridged the Rhine and led the first Roman landing in Britain, returning again in 54 BC.
steps.text_zh: 前55年，高卢战争期间，他架桥渡过莱茵河，又率罗马军队首次登陆不列颠，次年再度进军。

steps.text: 52 BC: Besieged Vercingetorix at Alesia and beat off a huge relief army, breaking the last great Gallic revolt.
steps.text_zh: 前52年，在阿莱西亚围困维钦托利，并击退前来解围的高卢大军，平定了高卢最后一次大起义。

steps.text: 49 BC: Ordered to give up his army, he crossed the Rubicon into Italy — "the die is cast" — and began civil war against Pompey and the Senate.
steps.text_zh: 前49年，元老院令他交出兵权，他率军渡过卢比孔河进入意大利，留下“骰子已经掷下”一语，内战由此开始。

steps.text: 48 BC: Defeated Pompey's larger army at Pharsalus in Thessaly.
steps.text_zh: 前48年，在色萨利的法萨卢斯击败兵力占优的庞培。

steps.text: 48 BC: Pursued Pompey to Egypt, found him already murdered, and stayed to back Cleopatra, surviving a months-long siege in Alexandria.
steps.text_zh: 前48年，追击庞培至埃及，庞培已遭杀害。他留下来扶持克利奥帕特拉，在亚历山大港被围数月才脱困。

steps.text: 47 BC: Crushed Pharnaces of Pontus at Zela in a lightning campaign, reporting "I came, I saw, I conquered".
steps.text_zh: 前47年，在泽拉速战速决，击败本都国王法纳西斯，留下“我来，我见，我征服”的名句。

steps.text: 46 BC: Defeated the Pompeian forces in Africa at Thapsus; Cato took his own life at Utica.
steps.text_zh: 前46年，在北非塔普苏斯击败庞培余部，小加图随后在乌提卡自杀。

steps.text: 44 BC: Now dictator for life, he was stabbed to death by senators led by Brutus and Cassius on the Ides of March.
steps.text_zh: 前44年，已成为终身独裁官的恺撒在三月十五日被布鲁图、卡西乌斯等元老刺杀。

title: Paul the Apostle's journeys
summary: A tentmaker from Tarsus who turned from persecuting Christians to carrying the faith across Asia Minor and Greece, ending his life in Rome.
summary_zh: 出身大数的织帐篷人，从迫害基督徒转为传教士，足迹遍及小亚细亚与希腊，最后死于罗马。

steps.text: 5: Born, by tradition around this year, in Tarsus in Cilicia to a Jewish family holding Roman citizenship.
steps.text_zh: 5年，据传约于此年生于基利家的大数，出身拥有罗马公民权的犹太家庭。

steps.text: 33: Trained as a Pharisee in Jerusalem under Gamaliel, he took part in persecuting the early followers of Jesus (date approximate).
steps.text_zh: 33年前后，在耶路撒冷师从迦玛列，成为法利赛人，并参与迫害早期耶稣门徒（年代为约数）。

steps.text: 34: On the road to Damascus he had the vision of the risen Jesus that converted him; he began preaching there and had to escape over the city wall in a basket (date probably 33–36).
steps.text_zh: 34年前后，在前往大马士革的路上见到复活的耶稣异象而皈依，随即在城中传道，后被人用筐从城墙缒下逃走（一说33至36年间）。

steps.text: 47: From Antioch, where followers were first called Christians, he set out with Barnabas on his first missionary journey through Cyprus and Asia Minor.
steps.text_zh: 47年前后，从门徒最早被称为“基督徒”的安提阿出发，与巴拿巴开始第一次传教旅行，经塞浦路斯深入小亚细亚。

steps.text: 49: On his second journey he crossed into Macedonia and founded at Philippi the first Christian community in Europe.
steps.text_zh: 49年前后，第二次传教旅行中渡海到马其顿，在腓立比建立了欧洲第一个基督徒团体。

steps.text: 50: After preaching in Athens he spent about eighteen months at Corinth working as a tentmaker; around here he wrote his earliest surviving letters.
steps.text_zh: 50年前后，在雅典讲道后到哥林多住了约一年半，靠织帐篷为生，现存最早的书信大约写于此时。

steps.text: 54: Based for about three years in Ephesus on his third journey, he wrote to the Corinthians and others; a riot of silversmiths drove him out.
steps.text_zh: 54年前后，第三次传教旅行以以弗所为基地住了约三年，写下致哥林多人书等书信，后因银匠骚乱离去。

steps.text: 57: Bringing a collection for the poor to Jerusalem, he was mobbed in the Temple and arrested; as a Roman citizen he appealed to the emperor.
steps.text_zh: 57年前后，携各地捐款回到耶路撒冷，在圣殿遭围攻后被捕，他以罗马公民身份要求上诉皇帝。

steps.text: 59: Shipped to Rome as a prisoner, he was wrecked on Malta and wintered there (date approximate).
steps.text_zh: 59年前后，作为囚犯被押往罗马，途中船只在马耳他触礁，他在岛上过冬（年代为约数）。

steps.text: 60: Reached Rome and lived two years under house arrest, preaching freely to visitors.
steps.text_zh: 60年前后，抵达罗马，在软禁中住了两年，仍向来访者传道。

steps.text: 65: By tradition beheaded under Nero at Aquae Salviae (Tre Fontane) outside Rome, sometime in the mid-60s.
steps.text_zh: 65年前后，据传在尼禄治下于罗马城外的三泉被斩首，确切年份不详。

title: Muhammad's life journey
summary: A Meccan merchant who became the Prophet of Islam, migrated to Medina, fought his way back to Mecca and united most of Arabia.
summary_zh: 麦加商人成为伊斯兰教先知，迁徙麦地那，最终重返麦加，统一了阿拉伯半岛大部。

steps.text: 570: Born in Mecca into the Banu Hashim clan of Quraysh; orphaned young, he was raised by his grandfather and then his uncle Abu Talib.
steps.text_zh: 570年，生于麦加古莱什部落哈希姆家族，幼年父母双亡，先后由祖父和伯父阿布·塔利卜抚养。

steps.text: 582: By tradition he travelled with Abu Talib's caravan to Syria as a boy, where the monk Bahira recognised him at Bosra; later he led caravans north for Khadija, whom he married.
steps.text_zh: 582年前后，传说少年时随伯父的商队到叙利亚，在布斯拉被修士巴希拉认出非凡；后来他为赫蒂彻经商北上，并与她成婚。

steps.text: 610: While meditating in the cave of Hira above Mecca he received his first revelation, the beginning of the Quran.
steps.text_zh: 610年，在麦加城外希拉山洞中静修时得到第一次启示，《古兰经》由此开始。

steps.text: 619: After Khadija and Abu Talib died, he sought support in Ta'if and was driven out with stones.
steps.text_zh: 619年前后，赫蒂彻和阿布·塔利卜相继去世，他到塔伊夫寻求支持，却被人用石头赶出城。

steps.text: 622: Escaping a plot in Mecca, he migrated with his followers to Yathrib, renamed Medina; this Hijra became year one of the Islamic calendar.
steps.text_zh: 622年，躲过麦加的暗杀图谋，带领信众迁往叶斯里卜（后称麦地那）。这次“希吉拉”成为伊斯兰历纪元。

steps.text: 624: His small force defeated a larger Meccan army at Badr, the first great victory of the Muslim community.
steps.text_zh: 624年，在白德尔以少胜多击败麦加军队，这是穆斯林社群的第一次大胜。

steps.text: 625: The Meccans struck back at Uhud, just north of Medina; the Muslims were beaten and he was wounded.
steps.text_zh: 625年，麦加人在麦地那北面的伍侯德山反击，穆斯林失利，他本人也受了伤。

steps.text: 628: Turned back from a pilgrimage to Mecca, he agreed the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, a truce that let Islam spread across Arabia.
steps.text_zh: 628年，前往麦加朝觐受阻，在侯代比亚与古莱什人订立和约，伊斯兰教借此停战之机在半岛迅速传播。

steps.text: 630: Entered Mecca almost without a fight, cleared the idols from the Kaaba and pardoned most of his former enemies.
steps.text_zh: 630年，几乎兵不血刃进入麦加，清除天房中的偶像，赦免了大多数昔日的敌人。

steps.text: 630: Led a large expedition north to Tabuk against the Byzantine frontier; no battle came, but northern tribes submitted.
steps.text_zh: 630年，亲率大军北上塔布克，对拜占庭边境用兵，虽未交战，北方诸部纷纷归附。

steps.text: 632: Made his only full pilgrimage and gave the Farewell Sermon at Mount Arafat.
steps.text_zh: 632年，完成一生唯一一次完整的朝觐，在阿拉法特山发表“辞朝演说”。

steps.text: 632: Fell ill after returning to Medina and died there; he was buried in his house beside the mosque.
steps.text_zh: 632年，回到麦地那后染病去世，葬于清真寺旁的居所内。

title: Saladin's life journey
summary: A Kurdish officer's son who rose to rule Egypt and Syria, crushed the Crusaders at Hattin, retook Jerusalem and held off the Third Crusade.
summary_zh: 库尔德军官之子，崛起统治埃及与叙利亚，哈丁一战大败十字军，收复耶路撒冷，又顶住了第三次十字军东征。

steps.text: 1137: Born in Tikrit on the Tigris to a Kurdish family; his father Ayyub was the castle's commander.
steps.text_zh: 1137年，生于底格里斯河畔的提克里特，库尔德人，父亲阿尤布是城堡守将。

steps.text: 1139: His family, forced out of Tikrit, served Zengi, and his father became governor of Baalbek, where Saladin spent his early childhood.
steps.text_zh: 1139年，家族被迫离开提克里特，转投赞吉麾下，父亲出任巴勒贝克总督，萨拉丁在此度过童年。

steps.text: 1154: When Nur ad-Din took Damascus, Saladin's father became governor there and the young man entered Nur ad-Din's service.
steps.text_zh: 1154年，努尔丁取得大马士革，萨拉丁的父亲出任城守，他本人也开始为努尔丁效力。

steps.text: 1164: Went to Egypt with his uncle Shirkuh on the first of three Syrian expeditions, enduring a siege at Bilbeis.
steps.text_zh: 1164年，随叔父希尔库赫首次远征埃及，在比勒拜斯经受围城。

steps.text: 1167: Held Alexandria through a long siege by Crusaders and Fatimid troops, his first independent command.
steps.text_zh: 1167年，坚守亚历山大港，抵挡十字军和法蒂玛军队的长期围攻，这是他第一次独当一面。

steps.text: 1171: Vizier of Egypt since 1169, he ended the Fatimid caliphate and made himself master of Egypt, founding the Ayyubid line.
steps.text_zh: 1171年，他在1169年已任埃及宰相，此时废除法蒂玛哈里发，独掌埃及，开创阿尤布王朝。

steps.text: 1174: After Nur ad-Din died, he marched to Damascus and took it, starting a long effort to unite Syria with Egypt.
steps.text_zh: 1174年，努尔丁去世，他进军大马士革并取得该城，开始统一叙利亚与埃及的长期努力。

steps.text: 1187: Destroyed the army of the Kingdom of Jerusalem at Hattin and captured King Guy.
steps.text_zh: 1187年，在哈丁全歼耶路撒冷王国军队，俘虏国王居伊。

steps.text: 1187: Took Jerusalem after a short siege and let most inhabitants ransom themselves, in contrast to the massacre of 1099.
steps.text_zh: 1187年，短暂围城后收复耶路撒冷，允许大部分居民赎身离开，与1099年十字军的屠城形成对照。

steps.text: 1191: Failed to relieve Acre, which fell to Richard the Lionheart and Philip of France after a two-year siege.
steps.text_zh: 1191年，未能解阿卡之围，该城在被围两年后落入狮心王理查和法王腓力之手。

steps.text: 1191: Beaten by Richard at Arsuf, but he kept Jerusalem; the Treaty of Jaffa the next year ended the Third Crusade.
steps.text_zh: 1191年，在阿尔苏夫败于理查，但守住了耶路撒冷，次年《雅法条约》结束了第三次十字军东征。

steps.text: 1193: Died of fever in Damascus, having given away so much that little was left to pay for his funeral; he lies beside the Umayyad Mosque.
steps.text_zh: 1193年，在大马士革病逝，生前散财无数，身后几乎无钱办丧事，葬于倭马亚清真寺旁。

title: Mansa Musa's pilgrimage
summary: The ruler of Mali whose lavish pilgrimage across the Sahara to Mecca made his empire famous from Cairo to Europe.
summary_zh: 马里帝国君主，横越撒哈拉前往麦加朝觐，挥金如土，使马里之名从开罗传到欧洲。

steps.text: 1312: Became mansa of Mali around this year, ruling from its capital, probably at Niani, over the gold-rich lands of the upper Niger.
steps.text_zh: 1312年前后，即位为马里曼萨，都城一说在尼亚尼，统治尼日尔河上游的产金之地。

steps.text: 1324: Set out for Mecca with a vast retinue and camel-loads of gold, probably crossing the Sahara by way of Walata and the Tuat oases.
steps.text_zh: 1324年，率庞大随从、驮着大批黄金出发朝觐，一说经瓦拉塔和图瓦特绿洲穿越撒哈拉。

steps.text: 1324: Stayed about three months in Cairo, met the Mamluk sultan, and spent and gave away so much gold that its value there fell for years.
steps.text_zh: 1324年，在开罗停留约三个月，会见马穆鲁克苏丹，大量花费和赏赐黄金，致使当地金价多年低迷。

steps.text: 1324: Performed the hajj at Mecca and recruited scholars and an architect to come back with him to Mali.
steps.text_zh: 1324年，在麦加完成朝觐，并招揽学者和建筑师随他回马里。

steps.text: 1325: On the way home he had run short and borrowed from Cairo merchants at high interest.
steps.text_zh: 1325年，归途中钱财用尽，只好在开罗向商人高息借贷。

steps.text: 1325: By tradition he passed through Gao, newly under Mali's rule, and took two Songhai princes back with him as hostages.
steps.text_zh: 1325年，据说归途经过刚归属马里的加奥，带走两位桑海王子作为人质。

steps.text: 1327: Had the Andalusian poet-architect al-Sahili build the Djinguereber Mosque in Timbuktu, which grew into a centre of Islamic learning.
steps.text_zh: 1327年，命安达卢斯诗人兼建筑师萨赫利在廷巴克图修建津加里贝尔清真寺，此城后来成为伊斯兰学术重镇。

steps.text: 1337: Died, probably in his capital, around this year (some sources say 1332); a few decades later he appeared on the Catalan Atlas holding a gold nugget.
steps.text_zh: 1337年前后，可能卒于都城（一说1332年）。数十年后，加泰罗尼亚地图上画着他手持金块的形象。

title: Columbus's voyages
summary: A Genoese sailor who sailed west for Spain, reached the Caribbean in 1492 and made four voyages across the Atlantic.
summary_zh: 热那亚水手，为西班牙西航，1492年抵达加勒比海，此后四次横渡大西洋。

steps.text: 1451: Born in Genoa, son of a wool weaver; he went to sea as a youth.
steps.text_zh: 1451年，生于热那亚一个织工家庭，少年时便出海谋生。

steps.text: 1476: Washed ashore in Portugal after his convoy was attacked off Cape St Vincent, he settled in Lisbon, sailed Portuguese routes and developed his plan to reach Asia by sailing west.
steps.text_zh: 1476年，所在船队在圣维森特角外遇袭，他漂上葡萄牙海岸，定居里斯本，随葡萄牙船只出航，逐步形成西航到亚洲的计划。

steps.text: 1492: After years of rejections in Portugal and Spain, he won Ferdinand and Isabella's backing at Santa Fe, just after the fall of Granada.
steps.text_zh: 1492年，在葡萄牙和西班牙屡遭拒绝后，终于在格拉纳达陷落后不久于圣菲得到斐迪南和伊莎贝拉的支持。

steps.text: 1492: Sailed from Palos on 3 August with the Santa María, the Pinta and the Niña.
steps.text_zh: 1492年8月3日，率圣玛利亚号、平塔号和尼尼亚号从帕洛斯启航。

steps.text: 1492: Made landfall on 12 October on an island the Lucayans called Guanahani, probably today's San Salvador, believing he had reached the Indies.
steps.text_zh: 1492年10月12日，登上卢卡亚人称为瓜纳哈尼的小岛（一般认为即今圣萨尔瓦多岛），自以为到了印度群岛。

steps.place_zh: 伊斯帕尼奥拉岛拉纳维达德
steps.text: 1492: The Santa María ran aground off Hispaniola on Christmas Day; he left 39 men at La Navidad, the first European settlement in the Americas, and sailed home.
steps.text_zh: 1492年圣诞节，圣玛利亚号在伊斯帕尼奥拉岛外搁浅，他留下39人建立拉纳维达德，即欧洲人在美洲的第一个据点，随后返航。

steps.text: 1493: Received in triumph by the monarchs at Barcelona and named Admiral of the Ocean Sea.
steps.text_zh: 1493年，在巴塞罗那受到国王与女王的隆重接见，获封“大洋海军上将”。

steps.place_zh: 伊斯帕尼奥拉岛伊莎贝拉城
steps.text: 1494: On his second voyage, with 17 ships and settlers, he found La Navidad destroyed and founded La Isabela; his harsh rule bred revolt.
steps.text_zh: 1494年，第二次航行率17艘船和大批移民前来，发现拉纳维达德已毁，另建伊莎贝拉城，统治严苛，引发反叛。

steps.text: 1498: On his third voyage he reached the South American mainland at the Gulf of Paria and saw the Orinoco's huge outflow.
steps.text_zh: 1498年，第三次航行抵达帕里亚湾，首次踏上南美大陆，见到奥里诺科河的巨大入海水流。

steps.text: 1500: A royal investigator arrested him at Santo Domingo for misgovernment and sent him back to Spain in chains.
steps.text_zh: 1500年，王室特派官员以施政不当为由在圣多明各将他逮捕，戴着镣铐押回西班牙。

steps.text: 1503: His fourth voyage ended with worm-eaten ships beached on Jamaica, where he was stranded for a year.
steps.text_zh: 1503年，第四次航行船只被蛀坏，搁浅在牙买加，他在岛上困守一年。

steps.text: 1506: Died in Valladolid, still pressing the crown for the titles and income he had been promised.
steps.text_zh: 1506年，在巴利亚多利德去世，临终仍在向王室争取当年许诺的头衔和收益。

title: Magellan's voyages
summary: A Portuguese soldier in India and Malacca who sailed for Spain, found the strait to the Pacific and was killed in the Philippines.
summary_zh: 曾在印度和马六甲作战的葡萄牙军人，转投西班牙，找到通往太平洋的海峡，最终死在菲律宾。

steps.text: 1480: Born into a minor noble family in northern Portugal, by tradition at Sabrosa (Porto is also claimed); he served as a page at the royal court.
steps.text_zh: 1480年，生于葡萄牙北部的小贵族家庭，一说生于萨布罗萨（一说波尔图），少年时入宫当侍从。

steps.text: 1505: Sailed from Lisbon with Francisco de Almeida's great fleet to India, beginning eight years in the East.
steps.text_zh: 1505年，随阿尔梅达的大舰队从里斯本出发前往印度，开始在东方八年的生涯。

steps.text: 1509: Fought at the naval battle of Diu, where the Portuguese crushed an Egyptian-Gujarati fleet and won control of the Indian Ocean.
steps.text_zh: 1509年，参加第乌海战，葡萄牙击溃马穆鲁克与古吉拉特联合舰队，夺得印度洋制海权。

steps.text: 1511: Took part in Albuquerque's conquest of Malacca, gateway to the Spice Islands.
steps.text_zh: 1511年，参加阿尔布克尔克攻占马六甲之战，这里是通往香料群岛的门户。

steps.text: 1513: Fighting in Morocco at Azemmour he was wounded and left with a limp; falling out of favour, he was refused advancement by King Manuel.
steps.text_zh: 1513年，在摩洛哥阿宰穆尔作战负伤，从此跛足；后失宠，曼努埃尔国王拒绝提拔他。

steps.text: 1517: Moved to Seville and offered Spain's young king Charles a western route to the Spice Islands, which won royal backing in 1518.
steps.text_zh: 1517年，移居塞维利亚，向西班牙少年国王查理提出向西航行到香料群岛的计划，次年获得王室支持。

steps.text: 1519: Sailed from Sanlúcar on 20 September with five ships and about 270 men.
steps.text_zh: 1519年9月20日，率五艘船约270人从圣卢卡尔启航。

steps.text: 1520: Wintering on the Patagonian coast, he crushed a mutiny by his Spanish captains, executing one and marooning another.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，在巴塔哥尼亚海岸过冬时镇压西班牙船长们的叛乱，处决一人，将另一人放逐荒岸。

steps.text: 1520: Threaded the strait now named for him in 38 days and entered the ocean he called the Pacific.
steps.text_zh: 1520年，用38天穿过后来以他命名的海峡，驶入他称为“太平洋”的大洋。

steps.text: 1521: After more than three months crossing the Pacific, with crews dying of scurvy and hunger, he reached Guam in March.
steps.text_zh: 1521年3月，横渡太平洋三个多月，船员因坏血病和饥饿大批死去，终于抵达关岛。

steps.text: 1521: In the Philippines he converted the ruler of Cebu, then was killed on 27 April fighting Lapulapu on Mactan; one ship completed the circumnavigation in 1522.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，在菲律宾使宿务首领受洗，4月27日在马克坦岛与拉普拉普作战时阵亡。船队仅剩一艘于1522年完成环球航行。

title: Martin Luther's life journey
summary: A miner's son from Saxony who became a friar and professor, launched the Reformation from Wittenberg and translated the Bible into German.
summary_zh: 萨克森矿主之子，成为修士和教授，在维滕贝格发起宗教改革，并把《圣经》译成德语。

steps.text: 1483: Born in Eisleben, son of a copper-mining entrepreneur.
steps.text_zh: 1483年，生于艾斯莱本，父亲经营铜矿。

steps.text: 1484: The family moved to nearby Mansfeld, where he grew up and went to school.
steps.text_zh: 1484年，举家迁往附近的曼斯费尔德，他在那里长大并上学。

steps.text: 1498: After a year at school in Magdeburg, he studied in Eisenach, earning his keep partly by singing.
steps.text_zh: 1498年，在马格德堡读书一年后转到爱森纳赫求学，部分靠唱诗维持生活。

steps.text: 1501: Entered the University of Erfurt to study law; in 1505, after vowing in a thunderstorm to become a monk, he joined the Augustinian friars there.
steps.text_zh: 1501年，入埃尔福特大学，准备学法律。1505年遇雷雨，发誓出家，随后进入当地奥古斯丁会修道院。

steps.text: 1510: Walked to Rome on business for his order and was dismayed by the worldliness he found there.
steps.text_zh: 1510年，因修会事务徒步前往罗马，对教廷的世俗奢靡大失所望。

steps.text: 1517: A professor of theology at Wittenberg since 1512, he published his Ninety-five Theses against indulgences on 31 October, setting off the Reformation.
steps.text_zh: 1517年，他自1512年起在维滕贝格大学任神学教授，10月31日发表《九十五条论纲》抨击赎罪券，宗教改革由此开端。

steps.text: 1518: Questioned in Augsburg by the papal legate Cardinal Cajetan, he refused to recant and slipped out of the city at night.
steps.text_zh: 1518年，在奥格斯堡受教皇特使卡耶坦枢机审问，拒不收回观点，夜里悄悄出城。

steps.text: 1519: In the Leipzig Disputation with Johann Eck he denied the supreme authority of the pope and of church councils.
steps.text_zh: 1519年，在莱比锡与埃克公开辩论，否认教皇和公会议的最高权威。

steps.text: 1521: Before Emperor Charles V at the Diet of Worms he again refused to recant, and was declared an outlaw.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，在沃尔姆斯帝国议会上当着查理五世的面再次拒绝认错，随后被宣布为帝国罪犯。

steps.text: 1521: Hidden by Elector Frederick in the Wartburg as "Junker Jörg", he translated the New Testament into German in about eleven weeks.
steps.text_zh: 1521年，被选侯腓特烈秘密藏在瓦尔特堡，化名“容克·约尔格”，用约十一周把《新约》译成德语。

steps.text: 1530: Still an outlaw and unable to attend the Diet of Augsburg, he followed it from Coburg Fortress, advising Melanchthon by letter.
steps.text_zh: 1530年，因仍是帝国罪犯无法出席奥格斯堡议会，他在科堡要塞通过书信指导梅兰希通。

steps.text: 1546: Died in Eisleben, the town of his birth, while there to settle a dispute among the counts of Mansfeld; he was buried in Wittenberg.
steps.text_zh: 1546年，回故乡艾斯莱本调解曼斯费尔德伯爵间的纠纷，病逝于此，葬于维滕贝格。

title: Napoleon's campaigns and exiles
summary: A Corsican artillery officer who conquered much of Europe as emperor of the French, then lost it in Russia and at Waterloo and died in exile on Saint Helena.
summary_zh: 科西嘉炮兵军官成为法国皇帝，征服欧洲大部，兵败俄国和滑铁卢后，死于圣赫勒拿岛流放地。

steps.text: 1769: Born in Ajaccio, Corsica, a year after the island passed from Genoa to France.
steps.text_zh: 1769年，生于科西嘉岛阿雅克肖，此前一年该岛刚从热那亚转归法国。

steps.text: 1779: Sent to military school at Brienne, a poor Corsican boy among French nobles; he went on to the École Militaire in Paris.
steps.text_zh: 1779年，进入布列讷军校，在法国贵族子弟中是个贫寒的科西嘉少年，后升入巴黎军官学校。

steps.text: 1793: His artillery plan drove the British out of Toulon and made him a brigadier general at 24.
steps.text_zh: 1793年，他的炮兵方案把英军赶出土伦，24岁便升为准将。

steps.text: 1796: Commanding the Army of Italy, he beat the Austrians in a string of battles, including Lodi and Arcole, and made himself a national hero.
steps.text_zh: 1796年，统率意大利军团，在洛迪、阿尔科莱等战役连败奥军，成为法国的英雄。

steps.text: 1798: Invaded Egypt and won the Battle of the Pyramids, but Nelson destroyed his fleet; the next year he failed before Acre and slipped back to France.
steps.text_zh: 1798年，远征埃及，赢得金字塔战役，但舰队被纳尔逊摧毁；次年攻阿卡不下，秘密潜回法国。

steps.text: 1799: Seized power in the coup of 18 Brumaire and became First Consul.
steps.text_zh: 1799年，发动雾月政变，出任第一执政。

steps.text: 1804: Issued the Civil Code and crowned himself Emperor of the French in Notre-Dame.
steps.text_zh: 1804年，颁布《民法典》，并在巴黎圣母院自行加冕为法兰西皇帝。

steps.text: 1805: Crushed the Austrian and Russian armies at Austerlitz, his most celebrated victory.
steps.text_zh: 1805年，在奥斯特利茨大败奥俄联军，这是他最负盛名的胜仗。

steps.text: 1812: Invaded Russia, won a bloody battle at Borodino and entered a burning Moscow, but the retreat in winter destroyed the Grande Armée.
steps.text_zh: 1812年，入侵俄国，在博罗季诺血战获胜后进入燃烧的莫斯科，冬季撤退中大军几乎覆灭。

steps.text: 1814: Forced to abdicate after the allies took Paris, he was exiled to the island of Elba, which he escaped ten months later.
steps.text_zh: 1814年，反法联军攻入巴黎，他被迫退位，流放厄尔巴岛，十个月后逃回法国。

steps.text: 1815: After the Hundred Days back in power, he was defeated by Wellington and Blücher at Waterloo.
steps.text_zh: 1815年，“百日王朝”之后，在滑铁卢被威灵顿和布吕歇尔击败。

steps.text: 1821: Died at Longwood on Saint Helena, the remote South Atlantic island where the British had held him since 1815.
steps.text_zh: 1821年，死于南大西洋孤岛圣赫勒拿的朗伍德，他自1815年起被英国人囚禁于此。

title: Charles Darwin's journey
summary: A doctor's son who sailed round the world on HMS Beagle, then spent forty quiet years in Kent working out evolution by natural selection.
summary_zh: 医生之子，乘“小猎犬号”环游世界，此后在肯特乡间潜心四十年，提出自然选择的进化论。

steps.text: 1809: Born in Shrewsbury, son of a wealthy doctor and grandson of Erasmus Darwin and Josiah Wedgwood.
steps.text_zh: 1809年，生于什鲁斯伯里，父亲是富裕的医生，祖父是伊拉斯谟斯·达尔文，外祖父是韦奇伍德。

steps.text: 1825: Studied medicine at Edinburgh but hated surgery; he learned taxidermy and marine biology instead.
steps.text_zh: 1825年，到爱丁堡学医，却厌恶外科手术，转而学习标本制作和海洋生物。

steps.text: 1828: Went to Cambridge to prepare for the Church, where he collected beetles and befriended the botanist John Henslow.
steps.text_zh: 1828年，入剑桥准备做牧师，热衷采集甲虫，并与植物学家亨斯洛结为师友。

steps.text: 1831: On Henslow's recommendation he sailed from Plymouth on 27 December as a gentleman naturalist on HMS Beagle.
steps.text_zh: 1831年12月27日，经亨斯洛推荐，以博物学家身份乘“小猎犬号”从普利茅斯启航。

steps.text: 1832: Dug up fossils of giant extinct mammals near Bahía Blanca, and began to wonder why they resembled living South American animals.
steps.text_zh: 1832年，在布兰卡港附近挖出巨型已灭绝哺乳动物的化石，开始思索它们为何与南美现存动物相似。

steps.text: 1832: Reached Tierra del Fuego, where the Beagle returned three Fuegians taken to England on an earlier voyage.
steps.text_zh: 1832年，抵达火地岛，“小猎犬号”送回了上次航行带到英国的三名火地人。

steps.text: 1835: From Valparaíso he crossed the high Andes to Mendoza and back, finding fossil shells and trees high in the mountains — evidence the land had risen.
steps.text_zh: 1835年，从瓦尔帕莱索出发翻越安第斯山到门多萨再折返，在高山上发现贝壳和树木化石，证明陆地曾经抬升。

steps.text: 1835: Spent five weeks in the Galápagos, collecting mockingbirds, finches and tortoises that differed from island to island.
steps.text_zh: 1835年，在加拉帕戈斯群岛停留五周，采集了各岛互有差异的嘲鸫、雀鸟和象龟。

steps.text: 1836: Visited Sydney and the Blue Mountains, puzzling over Australia's strange animals, before crossing the Indian Ocean and returning to England in October.
steps.text_zh: 1836年，到访悉尼和蓝山，对澳大利亚奇特的动物大惑不解，随后横渡印度洋，10月回到英国。

steps.text: 1842: Settled with his wife Emma at Down House in Kent, his home and workplace for the rest of his life; that year he sketched his theory in pencil.
steps.text_zh: 1842年，与妻子艾玛定居肯特郡唐宅，此后终生在此生活和研究，同年用铅笔写下理论纲要。

steps.text: 1859: Spurred by Alfred Russel Wallace's similar idea, he published On the Origin of Species in London; the first printing sold out at once.
steps.text_zh: 1859年，受华莱士提出相似理论的刺激，在伦敦出版《物种起源》，首印随即售罄。

steps.text: 1882: Died at Down House and was buried in Westminster Abbey, near Isaac Newton.
steps.text_zh: 1882年，在唐宅去世，葬于威斯敏斯特教堂，与牛顿相邻。

title: David Livingstone's travels
summary: A Scottish mill-boy turned missionary doctor who crossed Africa coast to coast, explored the Zambezi and the great lakes, and died searching for the Nile's source.
summary_zh: 苏格兰纺织童工出身的传教医生，横穿非洲大陆，探察赞比西河与东非大湖，最终在寻找尼罗河源头途中去世。

steps.text: 1813: Born in Blantyre near Glasgow; from age ten he worked in a cotton mill and studied at night, later training in medicine and theology.
steps.text_zh: 1813年，生于格拉斯哥附近的布兰太尔，十岁起在棉纺厂做工，夜里自学，后来学医和神学。

steps.text: 1841: Arrived as a London Missionary Society doctor at Robert Moffat's mission at Kuruman, whose daughter Mary he later married.
steps.text_zh: 1841年，作为伦敦传道会医生来到莫法特主持的库鲁曼传教站，后来娶了莫法特的女儿玛丽。

steps.text: 1849: Crossed the Kalahari with William Oswell and reached Lake Ngami, his first notable journey of exploration.
steps.text_zh: 1849年，与奥斯韦尔穿越卡拉哈里沙漠抵达恩加米湖，这是他第一次引人注目的探险。

steps.text: 1854: Having travelled up the Zambezi from Makololo country, he reached the Atlantic at Luanda, sick and exhausted.
steps.text_zh: 1854年，从马科洛洛人地区溯赞比西河西行，抵达大西洋岸的罗安达，已经病得精疲力竭。

steps.text: 1855: Heading back east, he became the first European to see Mosi-oa-Tunya, which he named Victoria Falls.
steps.text_zh: 1855年，东返途中成为首个见到“莫西奥图尼亚”瀑布的欧洲人，并将其命名为维多利亚瀑布。

steps.text: 1856: Reached the Indian Ocean at Quelimane, completing the first documented crossing of southern Africa by a European, and returned to fame in Britain.
steps.text_zh: 1856年，抵达印度洋岸的克利马内，完成有记录以来欧洲人首次横穿南部非洲，回国后声名大噪。

steps.text: 1859: Leading a government expedition up the Zambezi and Shire rivers, he reached Lake Nyasa (Malawi) and saw the slave trade at first hand.
steps.text_zh: 1859年，率英国政府的赞比西探险队沿赞比西河和希雷河上溯，抵达尼亚萨湖（马拉维湖），亲眼目睹奴隶贸易。

steps.text: 1862: His wife Mary died of fever at Shupanga on the Zambezi; the troubled expedition was recalled the next year.
steps.text_zh: 1862年，妻子玛丽在赞比西河畔的舒潘加死于热病，屡遭挫折的探险队次年被召回。

steps.text: 1866: Set out from Zanzibar on his last expedition to find the source of the Nile.
steps.text_zh: 1866年，从桑给巴尔出发，开始寻找尼罗河源头的最后一次探险。

steps.text: 1871: Reached the Lualaba at Nyangwe, where he witnessed Arab-Swahili slavers massacre hundreds of people at the market; his account helped end the Zanzibar slave trade.
steps.text_zh: 1871年，抵达卢阿拉巴河畔的尼扬圭，目睹奴隶贩子在集市上屠杀数百人，他的记述推动了桑给巴尔奴隶贸易的终结。
