steps.text_zh: 前251年，离开赵国回到秦都咸阳，此后父亲异人继位为庄襄王。

steps.text: 246 BC: Becomes King of Qin at thirteen; the chancellor Lü Buwei runs the government.
steps.text_zh: 前246年，十三岁即秦王位，国政由相国吕不韦主持。

steps.text: 238 BC: Holds his coming-of-age capping ceremony at the old capital Yong and crushes Lao Ai's revolt.
steps.text_zh: 前238年，在旧都雍城行冠礼，亲政，平定嫪毐之乱。

steps.text: 227 BC: Survives Jing Ke's dagger, hidden in a rolled-up map, in his own audience hall.
steps.text_zh: 前227年，荆轲借献图之机行刺，“图穷匕见”，秦王绕柱而走，幸免于难。

steps.text: 221 BC: Completes the conquest of the six states and takes the title Huangdi, First Emperor.
steps.text_zh: 前221年，灭齐，六国尽归于秦，自称“始皇帝”。

steps.text: 219 BC: On his second tour performs the feng sacrifice on the summit of Mount Tai.
steps.text_zh: 前219年，第二次出巡，登泰山行封禅大典。

steps.text: 219 BC: Stays three months at Langya by the sea, sets up an inscribed stele and sends Xu Fu to seek the immortals.
steps.text_zh: 前219年，在琅琊台留居三月，刻石颂德，并派徐福入海求仙。

steps.text: 218 BC: On his third tour, an assassin hired by Zhang Liang hurls an iron hammer but smashes the wrong carriage.
steps.text_zh: 前218年，第三次东巡，在博浪沙遭张良所募力士以铁椎狙击，误中副车。

steps.text: 215 BC: Tours the northern coast to Jieshi, carves an inscription and sends Meng Tian north against the Xiongnu.
steps.text_zh: 前215年，东巡至碣石，刻碣石门辞；随后派蒙恬北击匈奴。

steps.text: 210 BC: On his last tour sacrifices to Yu the Great at Kuaiji and erects the Kuaiji stele.
steps.text_zh: 前210年，最后一次出巡，至会稽祭大禹，立会稽刻石。

steps.text: 210 BC: Falls ill and dies at Shaqiu; Zhao Gao and Li Si hide his death and forge his will.
steps.text_zh: 前210年，病逝于沙丘平台，赵高、李斯秘不发丧，篡改遗诏。

title: Liu Bang's life
summary: A village official from Pei, Liu Bang rose against Qin, was first into Guanzhong, outlasted Xiang Yu in a four-year war and founded the Han dynasty.
summary_zh: 刘邦本是沛县亭长，秦末起兵，率先入关中，与项羽争天下四年，终于建立汉朝。

steps.text: 256 BC: Born to a farming family at Zhongyang village in Feng, Pei county (by the traditional date).
steps.text_zh: 前256年，生于沛县丰邑中阳里一户农家（一说生于前247年）。

steps.text: 209 BC: After freeing the convicts he was escorting to Mount Li, he is chosen leader by the men of Pei and rises against Qin.
steps.text_zh: 前209年，押送刑徒途中纵放众人，后被沛县父老推为“沛公”，起兵反秦。

steps.text: 207 BC: While Xiang Yu fights at Julu, he breaks through Wu Pass and enters Guanzhong from the south.
steps.text_zh: 前207年，趁项羽鏖战巨鹿，攻破武关，从南路入关中。

steps.text: 206 BC: Accepts the surrender of the last Qin ruler, seals the treasuries and proclaims a three-article covenant.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，秦王子婴出降，刘邦封存府库，与关中父老约法三章。

steps.text: 206 BC: Survives the Feast at Hongmen with Xiang Yu, slipping away on the pretext of visiting the latrine.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，赴项羽鸿门宴，险遭不测，借如厕脱身。

steps.text: 206 BC: Made King of Han and sent to remote Hanzhong; he burns the plank roads behind him and soon strikes back.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，被封为汉王，就国南郑，烧绝栈道以示无东归之意，不久即还定三秦。

steps.text: 205 BC: Takes Xiang Yu's capital with a huge coalition army, only to be routed by Xiang Yu's 30,000 cavalry.
steps.text_zh: 前205年，率诸侯联军攻占彭城，旋被项羽三万精骑击溃，几乎被擒。

steps.text: 204 BC: Holds the Xingyang-Chenggao line for years, escaping a siege when a general impersonates him.
steps.text_zh: 前204年，与项羽长期相持于荥阳、成皋一线，被围时由纪信假扮其身诈降，得以脱身。

steps.text: 202 BC: Surrounds Xiang Yu at Gaixia with Han Xin and Peng Yue, ending the Chu-Han war.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，会合韩信、彭越诸军围项羽于垓下，楚汉战争结束。

steps.text: 202 BC: Proclaims himself emperor on the north bank of the Si river near Dingtao.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，在定陶汜水之阳即皇帝位，建立汉朝。

steps.text: 200 BC: Leads an army against the Xiongnu and is trapped for seven days on Baideng hill before negotiating his way out.
steps.text_zh: 前200年，亲征匈奴，被冒顿单于围困于白登山七日，用陈平之计方得脱围。

steps.text: 195 BC: Dies in Chang'an's Changle Palace from an arrow wound received while putting down Ying Bu.
steps.text_zh: 前195年，平定英布时中流矢，伤重驾崩于长安长乐宫。

title: Xiang Yu's campaigns
summary: Scion of a Chu noble family, Xiang Yu destroyed the Qin army at Julu and divided the empire, but lost the struggle with Liu Bang and took his own life on the Yangtze.
summary_zh: 项羽出身楚国将门，巨鹿一战摧毁秦军主力，分封天下自号西楚霸王，最终败于刘邦，自刎乌江。

steps.text: 232 BC: Born into the family of Chu's great generals; his grandfather Xiang Yan had died fighting Qin.
steps.text_zh: 前232年，生于下相，出身楚国名将世家，祖父项燕抗秦战死。

steps.text: 209 BC: Having once said of the passing First Emperor 'he can be replaced', he and his uncle Xiang Liang kill the governor and raise 8,000 men.
steps.text_zh: 前209年，曾见始皇出巡，说“彼可取而代也”；此年随叔父项梁在吴中杀郡守起兵，得江东子弟八千。

steps.text: 208 BC: Xiang Liang installs a grandson of the old Chu king as King Huai to rally the rebels.
steps.text_zh: 前208年，项梁在盱眙拥立楚怀王之孙熊心为楚怀王，号召诸军。

steps.text: 207 BC: Smashes his boats and cooking pots, crosses the Zhang river and destroys the main Qin army at Julu.
steps.text_zh: 前207年，破釜沉舟，渡漳水决战，大破秦军于巨鹿，威震诸侯。

steps.text: 206 BC: Hosts Liu Bang at the Feast at Hongmen but lets him leave alive.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，设鸿门宴款待刘邦，终未下手，放其离去。

steps.text: 206 BC: Burns Xianyang, kills the last Qin ruler and carves the empire into eighteen kingdoms.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，火烧咸阳宫室，杀子婴，分封十八诸侯王，自立为西楚霸王。

steps.text: 205 BC: Rushes back from Qi to his capital and shatters Liu Bang's coalition with 30,000 horsemen.
steps.text_zh: 前205年，从齐地回师，以三万精骑在彭城大破刘邦五十六万联军。

steps.text: 203 BC: Short of food, agrees to split the empire along the Hong Canal and returns Liu Bang's family.
steps.text_zh: 前203年，粮尽兵疲，与刘邦约定以鸿沟为界中分天下，归还刘邦家眷。

steps.text: 202 BC: Surrounded at Gaixia, hears Chu songs on all sides and bids farewell to Lady Yu.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，被困垓下，四面楚歌，作《垓下歌》与虞姬诀别。

steps.text: 202 BC: Refuses the boatman's offer to carry him back east of the river and cuts his own throat.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，至乌江，不肯渡江，说“无颜见江东父老”，自刎而死。

title: Han Xin's campaigns
summary: From a humiliated youth in Huaiyin, Han Xin became Liu Bang's great general, conquering the north and east in a string of famous victories before being executed in Chang'an.
summary_zh: 韩信少年时在淮阴受胯下之辱，后成为刘邦大将，平定北方与齐地，屡出奇兵，最终却被诛于长安。

steps.text: c. 210 BC: A poor young man in Huaiyin, he is fed by a washerwoman and crawls between a bully's legs rather than fight.
steps.text_zh: 约前210年，在淮阴家贫无依，受漂母一饭之恩，又忍受“胯下之辱”。

steps.text: 206 BC: Leaves Xiang Yu for Liu Bang; after Xiao He chases him down by moonlight he is made grand general.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，弃楚投汉，不受重用而出走，萧何月下追回，刘邦拜其为大将。

steps.text: 206 BC: Leads the Han army secretly out through Chencang to retake Guanzhong.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，率汉军“暗度陈仓”，还定三秦。

steps.text: 205 BC: Feints at the Linjin ford, then crosses the Yellow River at Xiayang on wooden jars and captures the King of Wei.
steps.text_zh: 前205年，佯攻临晋渡口，却以木罂缻从夏阳偷渡黄河，俘魏王豹。

steps.text: 204 BC: Fights with his back to the river at Jingxing, destroying Zhao's army of 200,000.
steps.text_zh: 前204年，在井陉口背水列阵，大破二十万赵军。

steps.text: 203 BC: Drowns the Chu relief army by releasing dammed water on the Wei River and becomes King of Qi.
steps.text_zh: 前203年，在潍水壅沙决水，大破楚将龙且，随后受封齐王。

steps.text: 202 BC: Commands the main Han force that surrounds and defeats Xiang Yu.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，统率汉军主力合围项羽于垓下。

steps.text: 202 BC: Transferred to be King of Chu at Xiapi; returns to Huaiyin to reward the washerwoman.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，改封楚王，都下邳；衣锦还乡，以千金报答漂母。

steps.text: 201 BC: Arrested at Chen when Liu Bang stages a sham tour of Yunmeng; demoted to Marquis of Huaiyin.
steps.text_zh: 前201年，刘邦伪游云梦，在陈县将其擒拿，贬为淮阴侯。

steps.text: 196 BC: Lured into the Changle Palace by Empress Lü and Xiao He and executed.
steps.text_zh: 前196年，被吕后与萧何诱入长乐宫，斩于钟室，夷三族。

title: Zhang Liang's life
summary: A noble of the fallen state of Han who tried to assassinate the First Emperor, Zhang Liang became Liu Bang's chief strategist and later withdrew from politics.
summary_zh: 张良出身韩国贵族，曾谋刺秦始皇，后为刘邦首席谋士，“运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外”，晚年隐退修道。

steps.text: 230 BC: Qin destroys his homeland of Han, which his family had served as chancellors for five reigns.
steps.text_zh: 前230年，秦灭韩，张家五世相韩，他散尽家财求刺客为韩复仇。

steps.text: 218 BC: His hired strongman hurls a 120-jin iron hammer at the First Emperor's convoy but hits the wrong carriage.
steps.text_zh: 前218年，募力士以百二十斤铁椎狙击秦始皇于博浪沙，误中副车。

steps.text: c. 217 BC: Hiding in Xiapi, he meets an old man on a bridge who gives him the Art of War of Taigong (by tradition).
steps.text_zh: 约前217年，亡匿下邳，传说在圯桥遇黄石公，得授《太公兵法》。

steps.text: 208 BC: Meets Liu Bang at Liu while trying to join the rebels, and attaches himself to him.
steps.text_zh: 前208年，在留县遇刘邦，从此追随，屡献奇策。

steps.text: 207 BC: Advises bribing the Qin commanders and then attacking, opening the road into Guanzhong.
steps.text_zh: 前207年，建议以利诱秦将再乘懈击之，助刘邦入武关、破峣关，直取关中。

steps.text: 206 BC: Arranges Liu Bang's escape from the Feast at Hongmen and stays behind to present gifts.
steps.text_zh: 前206年，在鸿门宴上周旋，安排刘邦脱身，自己留下献礼谢罪。

steps.text: 204 BC: Talks Liu Bang out of restoring the six states, using chopsticks to count off the reasons.
steps.text_zh: 前204年，在荥阳“借箸代筹”，劝阻刘邦复立六国之后。

steps.text: 202 BC: Backs Lou Jing's advice to make the capital in Guanzhong rather than Luoyang; enfeoffed as Marquis of Liu.
steps.text_zh: 前202年，在洛阳力主定都关中；受封留侯。

steps.text: 195 BC: His plan to bring the Four Elders of Mount Shang to court saves the crown prince's position.
steps.text_zh: 前195年，献计请来商山四皓辅佐太子，保住了太子地位。

steps.text: 186 BC: Withdraws from affairs to practise Daoist abstinence and dies in 186 BC; tradition places his retreat at Mount Zibai.
steps.text_zh: 前186年，晚年辟谷学道，不问政事，前186年去世；相传隐居于紫柏山。

title: Emperor Wu's life
summary: Han's longest-reigning emperor drove back the Xiongnu, opened the Western Regions and toured his realm widely, before ending his reign with a famous edict of self-reproach.
summary_zh: 汉武帝在位五十四年，北击匈奴、开通西域、独尊儒术，屡次巡游封禅，晚年下轮台诏罪己。

steps.text: 156 BC: Born in Chang'an as Liu Che, a son of Emperor Jing.
steps.text_zh: 前156年，生于长安，名刘彻，汉景帝之子。

steps.text: 141 BC: Succeeds his father at fifteen; soon promotes Confucian scholars and sends Zhang Qian west.
steps.text_zh: 前141年，十五岁即位，此后尊儒兴学，派张骞出使西域。

steps.text: 110 BC: Leads 180,000 cavalry on a show of force to the northern frontier at Shuofang, challenging the Shanyu.
steps.text_zh: 前110年，亲率十八万骑巡边至朔方，耀兵北境，遣使向单于挑战。

steps.text: 110 BC: Performs the feng and shan sacrifices at Mount Tai, the first since the First Emperor.
steps.text_zh: 前110年，东巡至泰山，行封禅大礼。

steps.text: 109 BC: Personally oversees the closing of the Huzi breach in the Yellow River, which had flooded for twenty years.
steps.text_zh: 前109年，亲临瓠子决口，令群臣负薪填堵，作《瓠子歌》。

steps.text: 106 BC: On a southern tour sails down the Yangtze from Xunyang, shooting a river dragon (jiao) along the way.
steps.text_zh: 前106年，南巡，自浔阳浮江而下，亲射蛟于江中。

steps.text: 91 BC: While ill at Ganquan he hears of the witchcraft affair in Chang'an, which ends in the deaths of the crown prince and empress.
steps.text_zh: 前91年，在甘泉宫养病，长安爆发巫蛊之祸，太子刘据与卫皇后先后自尽。

steps.text: 89 BC: Issues the Luntai Edict renouncing further expansion and turning back to agriculture.
steps.text_zh: 前89年，下《轮台罪己诏》，停止对外用兵，转而休养生息。

steps.text: 87 BC: Dies at Wuzuo Palace, entrusting the boy emperor to Huo Guang.
steps.text_zh: 前87年，崩于五柞宫，遗命霍光辅佐幼主。

title: Wei Qing's campaigns
summary: Born to a servant in a princess's household, Wei Qing rose with his sister the empress to become grand general, leading seven campaigns against the Xiongnu.
summary_zh: 卫青生于平阳公主家奴之家，因姐姐卫子夫入宫而发迹，官至大将军，七击匈奴，未尝败北。

steps.text: c. 140 BC: Born to a servant of the Pingyang household; as a boy he herds sheep for his father's family.
steps.text_zh: 约前140年，生于平阳侯家，母为家奴，少年时为父家牧羊，受尽冷遇。

steps.text: 139 BC: His sister Wei Zifu enters the palace; he is kidnapped by the empress's mother but rescued, and given palace office.
steps.text_zh: 前139年，姐姐卫子夫入宫得宠，他被陈皇后之母绑架，幸为友人救出，随后被任为建章监、侍中。

steps.text: 129 BC: On his first campaign strikes deep to the Xiongnu ritual centre of Longcheng, the only one of four generals to win.
steps.text_zh: 前129年，首次出征，直捣匈奴祭天圣地龙城，是四路汉军中唯一获胜者。

steps.text: 127 BC: Recovers the Ordos 'land south of the river' and Shuofang commandery is founded.
steps.text_zh: 前127年，收复河南地，汉设朔方郡，被封为长平侯。

steps.place_zh: 高阙塞外（今内蒙古乌拉特）
steps.text: 124 BC: Surprises the Wise King of the Right in a night raid and is made grand general in the field.
steps.text_zh: 前124年，出高阙夜袭右贤王，俘获甚众，被拜为大将军。

steps.place_zh: 定襄（今内蒙古和林格尔）
steps.text: 123 BC: Twice leads armies out of Dingxiang; his young nephew Huo Qubing wins his first fame.
steps.text_zh: 前123年，两次率军出定襄北击匈奴，外甥霍去病初露锋芒。

steps.text: 119 BC: Crosses the Gobi and defeats the Shanyu in a battle fought in a sandstorm.
steps.text_zh: 前119年，率军横穿大漠，在风沙中与单于主力决战，单于溃逃。

steps.text: 106 BC: Dies in Chang'an and is buried near Emperor Wu's Maoling in a tomb shaped like Mount Lushan.
steps.text_zh: 前106年，卒于长安，陪葬茂陵，墓冢形如庐山（一说阴山）。

title: Huo Qubing's campaigns
summary: Wei Qing's nephew, Huo Qubing led lightning cavalry raids that seized the Hexi Corridor and reached deep into Mongolia, dying at twenty-three.
summary_zh: 霍去病是卫青外甥，以长途奔袭著称，夺取河西走廊、封狼居胥，二十三岁英年早逝。

steps.text: 140 BC: Born the illegitimate son of a petty official and Wei Qing's sister.
steps.text_zh: 前140年，生于平阳，为平阳县吏霍仲孺与卫少儿的私生子。

steps.place_zh: 定襄（今内蒙古和林格尔）
steps.text: 123 BC: At seventeen rides out from Dingxiang with 800 horsemen, wins first honours and is made Marquis Champion of the Army.
steps.text_zh: 前123年，十七岁随卫青出定襄，率八百骑深入敌后，斩获甚众，封冠军侯。

steps.text: 121 BC: In a spring campaign sweeps through the Hexi Corridor past the Yanzhi Mountains.
steps.text_zh: 前121年，春季出陇西，转战六日，越过焉支山千余里。

steps.text: 121 BC: In summer swings round by Juyan Lake to strike the Qilian Mountains, crippling the Xiongnu in Hexi.
steps.text_zh: 前121年，夏季经居延泽南下，至祁连山，重创河西匈奴。

steps.text: 121 BC: Accepts the surrender of the King of Hunye, quelling a mutiny in his camp by riding in to cut down the rebels.
steps.text_zh: 前121年，受浑邪王之降，驰入其营斩杀欲逃者，河西从此归汉。

steps.place_zh: 狼居胥山（今蒙古国境内）
steps.text: 119 BC: Strikes 2,000 li north of the Gobi and performs a sacrifice on Mount Langjuxu.
steps.text_zh: 前119年，出代郡北进两千余里，大破左贤王，“封狼居胥”。

steps.text: 117 BC: Dies at twenty-three; his tomb at Maoling is shaped like the Qilian Mountains.
steps.text_zh: 前117年，病逝，年仅二十三岁；茂陵旁的墓冢筑成祁连山形状。

title: Li Guang's campaigns
summary: The 'Flying General' of the northern frontier fought the Xiongnu for over forty years and became a legend for his archery, yet never won a fief and took his own life after losing his way in the Gobi.
summary_zh: “飞将军”李广戍边四十余年，善射闻名，屡立战功却终身未能封侯，最后在漠北之战中迷路失期，愤而自刎。

steps.text: 166 BC: A young man of a frontier family of archers in Chengji, he enlists when the Xiongnu invade.
steps.text_zh: 前166年，出身陇西成纪世代善射之家，匈奴大举入侵，以良家子从军。

steps.text: 166 BC: Fights the Xiongnu who have broken through Xiao Pass, killing many and becoming a palace guard.
steps.text_zh: 前166年，抗击攻入萧关的匈奴，杀敌颇多，被任为郎、武骑常侍。

steps.text: 154 BC: In the Rebellion of the Seven States seizes the enemy standard at Changyi under Zhou Yafu.
steps.text_zh: 前154年，七国之乱中随周亚夫作战，在昌邑城下夺取叛军军旗。

steps.text: c. 144 BC: As governor of Shang, he bluffs a large Xiongnu force by dismounting his hundred riders as if they were bait.
steps.text_zh: 约前144年，任上郡太守，以百骑遇匈奴大军，下马解鞍佯作诱兵，敌疑而退。

steps.text: 129 BC: Leads a column out of Yanmen, is wounded and captured, but snatches a horse and bow and escapes.
steps.text_zh: 前129年，出雁门击匈奴，兵败受伤被俘，途中夺马夺弓逃回，被贬为庶人。

steps.place_zh: 右北平（今河北卢龙一带）
steps.text: 128 BC: Governor of Youbeiping; the Xiongnu call him the Flying General, and he sinks an arrow into a rock he takes for a tiger.
steps.text_zh: 前128年，任右北平太守，匈奴称“飞将军”，数年不敢来犯；射石没镞的故事即出于此。

steps.place_zh: 漠北（今内蒙古、蒙古国之间的大漠）
steps.text: 119 BC: In the Mobei campaign his column loses its way in the desert; rather than face the court he cuts his throat.
steps.text_zh: 前119年，漠北之战中东路迷失道路，未能按期会师，不愿受刀笔吏之辱，引刀自刎。

title: Su Wu's journey
summary: Sent as an envoy to the Xiongnu, Su Wu refused to surrender and herded sheep by Lake Baikal for nineteen years before returning to Chang'an as a model of loyalty.
summary_zh: 苏武出使匈奴被扣，坚贞不屈，在北海牧羊十九年，持节不失，终于回到长安，成为忠节的象征。

steps.text: 140 BC: Born in Duling near Chang'an, son of the general Su Jian.
steps.text_zh: 前140年，生于长安附近的杜陵，父亲为卫青部将苏建。

steps.text: 100 BC: Sets out as Emperor Wu's envoy, carrying the imperial staff, to escort Xiongnu envoys home.
steps.text_zh: 前100年，奉汉武帝之命，持节出使匈奴，送还被扣的匈奴使者。

steps.text: 100 BC: Caught up in a plot by his deputy; refuses to surrender and stabs himself rather than submit.
steps.text_zh: 前100年，副使卷入谋反事件，苏武拒不投降，引刀自刺，几乎丧命。

steps.text: 100 BC: Exiled to the North Sea to herd rams and told he may go home when they bear lambs; he lives on wild rodents and grass seeds.
steps.text_zh: 前100年，被流放北海牧公羊，“羝乳乃得归”，掘野鼠、食草实度日，持节不离。

steps.text: c. 85 BC: His old friend Li Ling, now a Xiongnu noble, visits to urge surrender; Su Wu refuses.
steps.text_zh: 约前85年，老友李陵已降匈奴，奉单于之命前来劝降，苏武坚辞不从。

steps.text: 81 BC: After nineteen years he returns to Chang'an under a peace deal, his hair and beard white.
steps.text_zh: 前81年，汉匈和亲，在被扣十九年后终于回到长安，须发尽白。

steps.text: 81 BC: Ordered to report to Emperor Wu's tomb with a sacrifice, since the emperor who sent him has died.
steps.text_zh: 前81年，奉诏以太牢之礼拜谒汉武帝陵园，复命于先帝。

steps.text: 60 BC: Dies in Chang'an at over eighty; later honoured among the eleven ministers in the Qilin Pavilion.
steps.text_zh: 前60年，卒于长安，年八十余，后被列为麒麟阁十一功臣之一。

title: Wang Zhaojun's journey
summary: A palace lady from the Three Gorges, Wang Zhaojun married the Xiongnu Shanyu and spent the rest of her life on the steppe, a symbol of peace between Han and Xiongnu. Her dates are uncertain.
summary_zh: 王昭君出身长江三峡，以宫女身份远嫁匈奴呼韩邪单于，终老塞外，成为汉匈和亲的象征。其生卒年不详。

steps.text: c. 50 BC: Born at Baoping village in Zigui, Nan commandery, in the Three Gorges.
steps.text_zh: 约前50年，生于南郡秭归宝坪村（今湖北兴山），地处长江三峡。

steps.text: c. 36 BC: Chosen as a palace lady for Emperor Yuan's harem, but never summoned to see him.
steps.text_zh: 约前36年，被选入汉元帝后宫为宫女，数年未得召见。

steps.text: 33 BC: When Shanyu Huhanye comes to court seeking a Han bride, she volunteers; her beauty astonishes the emperor at the farewell.
steps.text_zh: 前33年，呼韩邪单于入朝求亲，她主动请行；辞行时光彩照人，令元帝震惊。

steps.place_zh: 塞外（今内蒙古呼和浩特一带）
steps.text: 33 BC: Leaves the frontier with the Shanyu and is titled Ninghu Yanzhi, 'the queen who brings peace to the Hu'.
steps.text_zh: 前33年，随单于出塞，号“宁胡阏氏”，汉匈边境数十年无战事。

steps.text: c. 32 BC: Lives at the Shanyu's court north of the Gobi and bears Huhanye a son, Yituzhiyashi.
steps.text_zh: 约前32年，随单于居漠北王庭，为呼韩邪生下一子伊屠智牙师。

steps.text: 31 BC: When Huhanye dies she asks to return home, but is ordered to follow Xiongnu custom and marry his successor.
steps.text_zh: 前31年，呼韩邪去世，她上书求归，汉成帝令其“从胡俗”，遂改嫁复株累单于，又生二女。

steps.place_zh: 青冢（今内蒙古呼和浩特）
steps.text: c. 15 BC: Dies on the steppe (date uncertain); tradition places her tomb, the 'Green Mound', south of Hohhot.
steps.text_zh: 约前15年，卒于塞外（年份不详），相传葬于今呼和浩特南的“青冢”。

title: Emperor Guangwu's life
summary: A distant Han relative farming in Nanyang, Liu Xiu rose against Wang Mang, won the decisive battle of Kunyang, rebuilt the Han empire from Hebei and ruled it from Luoyang.
summary_zh: 刘秀本是南阳的汉室远支，起兵反莽，昆阳一战成名，经营河北后称帝，定都洛阳，重建东汉。

steps.text: 5 BC: Born in the county office at Jiyang, where his father is magistrate.
steps.text_zh: 前5年，生于济阳县衙，其父刘钦时任济阳县令。

steps.text: c. 14: Studies the Book of Documents at the Imperial Academy in Wang Mang's capital.
steps.text_zh: 约14年，在长安太学受业，研习《尚书》。

steps.text: 22: Joins his elder brother Liu Yan in raising the Chongling army against Wang Mang.
steps.text_zh: 22年，与兄长刘縯在舂陵起兵反莽。

steps.text: 23: With a few thousand men breaks Wang Mang's army of 420,000 at Kunyang.
steps.text_zh: 23年，以数千兵马大破王莽四十二万大军于昆阳。

steps.text: 23: After the Gengshi Emperor kills his brother, he goes to Wan to apologise and hides his grief.
steps.text_zh: 23年，兄长刘縯被更始帝所杀，他赴宛城谢罪，不敢为兄服丧，强忍悲痛。

steps.text: 24: Sent to pacify Hebei, he takes Handan and destroys the pretender Wang Lang.
steps.text_zh: 24年，受命持节巡行河北，攻破邯郸，诛灭王郎。

steps.text: 25: Proclaims himself emperor at the Qianqiu Pavilion south of Hao.
steps.text_zh: 25年，在鄗城南千秋亭即皇帝位，改元建武。

steps.text: 25: Enters Luoyang and makes it his capital, founding the Eastern Han.
steps.text_zh: 25年，入洛阳，定都于此，史称东汉。

steps.text: 32: Personally campaigns against Wei Ao, studying Ma Yuan's model of the terrain heaped in rice.
steps.text_zh: 32年，亲征隗嚣，马援“聚米为山谷”为其分析地形。

steps.text: 56: Performs the feng and shan sacrifices at Mount Tai.
steps.text_zh: 56年，东巡泰山，行封禅之礼。

steps.text: 57: Dies in Luoyang's Southern Palace; shortly before, he grants a gold seal to an envoy from Wa (Japan).
steps.text_zh: 57年，崩于洛阳南宫；同年接见倭奴国使者，赐“汉委奴国王”金印。

title: Ma Yuan's campaigns
summary: A frontier rancher turned general, Ma Yuan served the warlord Wei Ao before joining Emperor Guangwu and fought from the Qiang borderlands to Vietnam, vowing to die wrapped in a horse's hide.
summary_zh: 马援早年在边地畜牧致富，先依隗嚣，后归光武帝，转战西羌、交趾，立志“马革裹尸”，最终病死军中。

steps.text: 14 BC: Born at Maoling in Fufeng, from a family of officials.
steps.text_zh: 前14年，生于扶风茂陵，出身官宦之家。

steps.text: c. 15: After freeing a prisoner he was escorting, he flees to Beidi and grows rich herding: 'the poorer, the firmer; the older, the stronger.'
steps.text_zh: 约15年，因私放囚犯逃亡北地，畜牧致富，常说“穷当益坚，老当益壮”。

steps.text: c. 25: Joins the warlord Wei Ao in Tianshui as a trusted adviser.
steps.text_zh: 约25年，投奔据守天水的隗嚣，受其信任。

steps.text: c. 26: Sent to the rival emperor Gongsun Shu, he dismisses him as 'a frog at the bottom of a well'.
steps.text_zh: 约26年，奉隗嚣之命出使成都见公孙述，讥其为“井底之蛙”。

steps.text: 28: Visits Guangwu in Luoyang and is won over by his openness.
steps.text_zh: 28年，出使洛阳见刘秀，为其坦诚气度所折服，后转投光武帝。

steps.text: 32: Heaps rice into a relief map of the Long mountains to plan Guangwu's campaign against Wei Ao.
steps.text_zh: 32年，随光武帝西征隗嚣，“聚米为山谷”，指画形势。

steps.text: 35: As governor of Longxi defeats the Qiang and resettles the frontier.
steps.text_zh: 35年，任陇西太守，大破先零羌，安定边郡。

steps.text: 43: Crushes the revolt of the Trung sisters and sets up bronze pillars to mark the frontier (by tradition).
steps.text_zh: 43年，平定交趾征氏姐妹起事，相传立铜柱为界。

steps.text: 44: Returns in triumph, declaring a man should die on the frontier and be carried home wrapped in a horse's hide.
steps.text_zh: 44年，凯旋洛阳，表示男儿当死于边野，“以马革裹尸还葬耳”。

steps.text: 49: Campaigning in his sixties against the Wuxi tribes, he dies of disease at Hutou in the summer heat.
steps.text_zh: 49年，以六十余岁高龄征五溪蛮，军困壶头，病逝军中。

title: Zhang Heng's life
summary: Poet, astronomer and engineer, Zhang Heng built a water-driven armillary sphere and the first seismoscope while serving at the Eastern Han court in Luoyang.
summary_zh: 张衡是东汉文学家、天文学家与发明家，任太史令期间制作水运浑天仪和候风地动仪。

steps.place_zh: 南阳西鄂（今河南南阳石桥镇）
steps.text: 78: Born in Xi'e county, Nanyang, into a once-prominent family.
steps.text_zh: 78年，生于南阳郡西鄂县，祖上为蜀郡太守。

steps.text: c. 94: Travels to the old capital region of Sanfu to study.
steps.text_zh: 约94年，游学三辅，考察长安一带的山川旧迹。

steps.text: c. 95: Studies at the Imperial Academy in Luoyang, where he befriends Cui Yuan.
steps.text_zh: 约95年，入洛阳太学，与崔瑗等人结为好友。

steps.text: 100: Serves as secretary to the governor of Nanyang and spends years writing the Rhapsody on the Two Capitals.
steps.text_zh: 100年，任南阳太守鲍德的主簿，用十年时间写成《二京赋》。

steps.place_zh: 南阳西鄂（今河南南阳石桥镇）
steps.text: c. 108: Returns home and studies Yang Xiong's Taixuan and mathematics.
steps.text_zh: 约108年，辞官回乡，钻研扬雄《太玄经》与历算。

steps.text: 117: As Grand Astrologer builds a water-driven armillary sphere.
steps.text_zh: 117年，任太史令，制成水运浑天仪。

steps.text: 132: Builds the seismoscope that detects distant earthquakes.
steps.text_zh: 132年，制成候风地动仪，可测远方地震方位。

steps.text: 136: Posted as chancellor of Hejian, where he curbs the local strongmen.
steps.text_zh: 136年，出任河间相，整治豪强，政绩卓著。

steps.text: 139: Recalled as a court secretary, he dies in Luoyang; he is buried back home in Xi'e.
steps.text_zh: 139年，回朝任尚书，卒于洛阳，归葬故乡西鄂。

title: Liu Bei's life
summary: A straw-sandal seller claiming Han royal descent, Liu Bei wandered between warlords for twenty years before founding Shu Han in Sichuan, dying after his defeat at Yiling.
summary_zh: 刘备自称汉室宗亲，早年织席贩履，辗转依附各路诸侯二十余年，后据有益州建立蜀汉，夷陵兵败后病逝白帝城。

steps.text: 161: Born in Zhuo, a poor descendant of a Han prince; he and his mother weave mats and sell sandals.
steps.text_zh: 161年，生于涿郡涿县，家道中落，与母亲贩履织席为业。

steps.text: c. 185: After fighting the Yellow Turbans he is made sheriff of Anxi, then quits after flogging an inspector.
steps.text_zh: 约185年，起兵讨黄巾有功，任安喜县尉，后鞭打督邮，弃官而去。

steps.text: 194: Inherits Xu Province from the dying Tao Qian, but soon loses it to Lü Bu.
steps.text_zh: 194年，陶谦病逝，刘备接掌徐州，不久被吕布夺去。

steps.text: 199: Shelters with Cao Cao, who tells him 'the only heroes in the world are you and I'; he joins the girdle-edict plot and flees.
steps.text_zh: 199年，依附曹操，“青梅煮酒论英雄”；暗中参与衣带诏之谋，后借机出走。

steps.text: 201: Takes refuge with Liu Biao in Jing Province and garrisons Xinye.
steps.text_zh: 201年，投奔荆州刘表，屯驻新野。

steps.text: 207: Visits Zhuge Liang three times and hears his Longzhong Plan.
steps.text_zh: 207年，三顾茅庐，诸葛亮提出“隆中对”。

steps.text: 208: Overtaken by Cao Cao's cavalry at Changban while fleeing south with refugees.
steps.text_zh: 208年，携民南撤，在长坂坡被曹军追及，几乎全军覆没。

steps.text: 208: Allied with Sun Quan, defeats Cao Cao's fleet at Red Cliffs.
steps.text_zh: 208年，联合孙权在赤壁大破曹军。

steps.text: 214: Takes Chengdu from Liu Zhang and becomes master of Yi Province.
steps.text_zh: 214年，围成都，刘璋出降，刘备取得益州。

steps.text: 219: After victory at Mount Dingjun takes Hanzhong and proclaims himself King of Hanzhong.
steps.text_zh: 219年，定军山之战后夺取汉中，在沔阳自立为汉中王。

steps.text: 222: Invading Wu to avenge Guan Yu, his army is burned out by Lu Xun at Yiling.
steps.text_zh: 222年，为报关羽之仇东征孙吴，在夷陵被陆逊火攻大败。

steps.text: 223: Dies at Baidi after entrusting his son and the state to Zhuge Liang.
steps.text_zh: 223年，在白帝城托孤于诸葛亮，随后病逝。

title: Guan Yu's campaigns
summary: A fugitive from Hedong who became Liu Bei's sworn brother and greatest general, Guan Yu held Jing Province for Shu until a Wu surprise attack destroyed him in 220.
summary_zh: 关羽本是河东亡命之人，追随刘备，情同兄弟，后镇守荆州，威震华夏，终因东吴偷袭败走麦城而死。

steps.text: 184: A fugitive from Xie in Hedong, he joins Liu Bei in Zhuo with Zhang Fei; the three are 'as close as brothers'.
steps.text_zh: 184年，从河东解县亡命涿郡，与张飞一同追随刘备，“恩若兄弟”。

steps.text: 199: Holds Xiapi as acting governor after Liu Bei kills Cao Cao's inspector of Xu Province.
steps.text_zh: 199年，刘备袭杀徐州刺史车胄，命关羽守下邳，行太守事。

steps.text: 200: Captured and treated generously by Cao Cao, he repays him by killing Yuan Shao's general Yan Liang at Baima, then leaves to rejoin Liu Bei.
steps.text_zh: 200年，兵败被曹操所获，礼遇甚厚；在白马刺杀颜良以报曹操，随后封金挂印，归奔刘备。

steps.text: 208: Leads Liu Bei's fleet down the Han river to Xiakou, saving the army after Changban.
steps.text_zh: 208年，长坂之败后，率水军沿汉水而下至夏口，接应刘备。

steps.text: 214: Left in command of Jing Province when Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang go west into Sichuan.
steps.text_zh: 214年，刘备、诸葛亮入蜀后，留守江陵，总督荆州事务。

steps.text: 215: Meets Lu Su in the 'single sword' parley; the dispute over Jing is settled along the Xiang river.
steps.text_zh: 215年，与鲁肃在益阳“单刀赴会”，孙刘以湘水为界划分荆州。

steps.text: 219: Floods Yu Jin's seven armies and besieges Fancheng; his fame 'shakes China'.
steps.text_zh: 219年，水淹七军，擒于禁、斩庞德，围樊城，“威震华夏”。

steps.text: 219: With Jiangling lost to Lü Meng's surprise attack, his army melts away and he retreats to Maicheng.
steps.text_zh: 219年，吕蒙白衣渡江袭取江陵，军心瓦解，败走麦城。

steps.text: 220: Captured by Wu troops while breaking out and executed; Sun Quan sends his head to Cao Cao.
steps.text_zh: 220年，突围途中被吴将擒获，遇害于临沮；孙权将其首级送交曹操。

title: Sima Yi's life
summary: A reluctant recruit of Cao Cao, Sima Yi became Wei's leading general against Shu and Liaodong and, in old age, seized power in a coup that paved the way for the Jin dynasty.
summary_zh: 司马懿早年被曹操强征出仕，后为曹魏重臣，抵御诸葛亮、平定辽东，晚年发动高平陵之变，为西晋奠基。

steps.text: 179: Born into a leading official family of Wen county.
steps.text_zh: 179年，生于河内温县的世家大族。

steps.text: 208: After feigning paralysis to avoid service, he is forced to join Cao Cao's staff.
steps.text_zh: 208年，此前装病拒绝征召，此年被曹操强令出仕，任文学掾。

steps.text: 215: Accompanies Cao Cao to Hanzhong and urges him to press on into Shu.
steps.text_zh: 215年，随曹操征张鲁取汉中，建议乘胜入蜀，未被采纳。

steps.text: 220: A trusted adviser of Cao Pi, he supports the abdication of the last Han emperor.
steps.text_zh: 220年，作为曹丕亲信，支持其代汉称帝。

steps.text: 228: Marches 1,200 li in eight days to crush Meng Da's planned defection.
steps.text_zh: 228年，八日行军一千二百里，突袭新城，擒斩欲叛的孟达。

steps.text: 231: Takes command against Zhuge Liang's northern expedition at Mount Qi.
steps.text_zh: 231年，率军抵御诸葛亮北伐，在祁山对峙。

steps.text: 234: Refuses battle at Wuzhang Plains until Zhuge Liang dies in camp.
steps.text_zh: 234年，在五丈原坚守不战，直至诸葛亮病逝军中。

steps.text: 238: Conquers Gongsun Yuan in Liaodong after a siege through the summer rains.
steps.text_zh: 238年，远征辽东，冒雨围攻襄平，灭公孙渊。

steps.text: 249: While the regent Cao Shuang is at the Gaoping tombs, seizes Luoyang in a coup.
steps.text_zh: 249年，趁曹爽陪皇帝谒高平陵，发动政变，夺取大权。

steps.text: 251: Suppresses Wang Ling's plot at Shouchun.
steps.text_zh: 251年，率军南下寿春，平定王凌之叛。

steps.text: 251: Dies in Luoyang a few months later.
steps.text_zh: 251年，数月后病逝于洛阳。

title: Lu Xun's life
summary: Scion of a great Wu clan, Lu Xun planned the capture of Jing Province and destroyed Liu Bei's army at Yiling, guarding Wu's western front for two decades.
summary_zh: 陆逊出身吴郡陆氏，参与袭取荆州，夷陵之战火烧刘备连营，此后镇守武昌二十余年，官至丞相。

steps.text: 183: Born into the Lu clan of Wu commandery.
steps.text_zh: 183年，生于吴郡吴县陆氏。

steps.text: 194: Living with his grand-uncle, the governor of Lujiang, when Sun Ce besieges the city; he is sent home to Wu.
steps.text_zh: 194年，随从祖庐江太守陆康居舒县；孙策围攻庐江前被送回吴郡。

steps.text: c. 205: Serving Sun Quan, he is made commandant of Haichang, opening granaries in famine and suppressing bandits.
steps.text_zh: 约205年，入孙权幕府，出任海昌屯田都尉，开仓赈灾、平定山越。

steps.text: 219: Replacing Lü Meng at Lukou, he flatters Guan Yu into dropping his guard before the attack on Jing.
steps.text_zh: 219年，代吕蒙镇陆口，致书关羽卑辞示弱，配合吕蒙袭取荆州。

steps.text: 222: Waits out Liu Bei's invasion, then burns his line of camps at Yiling.
steps.text_zh: 222年，坚守不战，待蜀军疲惫后火烧连营，大破刘备。

steps.text: 228: Lures the Wei general Cao Xiu into a trap at Shiting.
steps.text_zh: 228年，诱魏将曹休深入，在石亭大败魏军。

steps.text: 229: When Sun Quan moves the capital to Jianye, Lu Xun is left at Wuchang to guide the crown prince.
steps.text_zh: 229年，孙权迁都建业，留陆逊镇守武昌，辅佐太子。

steps.text: 234: Leads a feint toward Xiangyang and withdraws coolly when the plan leaks.
steps.text_zh: 234年，率军进逼襄阳，计划泄露后从容撤军，魏军不敢追。

steps.text: 245: Now chancellor, he dies of grief after Sun Quan rebukes him over the succession dispute.
steps.text_zh: 245年，已任丞相，因卷入二宫之争屡遭孙权责问，愤恚而卒。

title: Jiang Wei's campaigns
summary: A Wei officer who defected to Zhuge Liang, Jiang Wei carried on his northern expeditions for decades and died trying to restore Shu after its surrender.
summary_zh: 姜维本为魏将，归降诸葛亮后继承其遗志，多次北伐中原；蜀汉亡后谋划复国，死于钟会之乱。

steps.text: 202: Born in Ji county, Tianshui; his father died fighting the Qiang.
steps.text_zh: 202年，生于天水冀县，父亲战死于羌乱。

steps.text: 228: Shut out by his suspicious superiors during Zhuge Liang's first northern expedition, he goes over to Shu.
steps.text_zh: 228年，诸葛亮首次北伐，姜维遭上司猜疑被拒于城外，遂归降蜀汉。

steps.text: 234: With Zhuge Liang at his death in camp, then helps lead the army home.
steps.text_zh: 234年，随诸葛亮驻军五丈原，诸葛亮病逝后护军撤回。

steps.text: 255: Wins his greatest victory west of the Tao river, killing tens of thousands of Wei troops.
steps.text_zh: 255年，在洮西大破魏雍州刺史王经，魏军死者数万。

steps.text: 256: Defeated by Deng Ai at Duangu, he takes the blame and is demoted.
steps.text_zh: 256年，在段谷被邓艾击败，损失惨重，自请贬职。

steps.text: 262: To avoid the eunuch Huang Hao's intrigues at court, he withdraws to farm at Tazhong.
steps.text_zh: 262年，为避宦官黄皓之谗，率军往沓中屯田。

steps.text: 263: Holds the pass at Jiange against Zhong Hui, until Deng Ai's march through Yinping outflanks him.
steps.text_zh: 263年，据守剑阁抵御钟会大军，邓艾偷渡阴平后，奉后主之命投降。

steps.text: 264: Urges Zhong Hui to revolt in a bid to restore Shu, and is killed in the mutiny.
steps.text_zh: 264年，劝钟会反魏以图复国，事败在兵变中被杀。

title: Deng Ai's campaigns
summary: A stuttering herdsman turned Wei general, Deng Ai developed military farming in Huainan, held the west against Jiang Wei, and conquered Shu with a daring mountain march before being killed in its aftermath.
summary_zh: 邓艾出身寒微，口吃，屯田两淮有功，后镇守陇右抵御姜维，偷渡阴平灭蜀，却在功成后被诬陷杀害。

steps.place_zh: 义阳棘阳（今河南新野东北）
steps.text: 197: Born at Jiyang in Yiyang; his father dies when he is young.
steps.text_zh: 197年，生于义阳棘阳，幼年丧父。

steps.text: c. 208: After Cao Cao takes Jing Province, he is moved to Runan and herds cattle for a military farm.
steps.text_zh: 约208年，曹操取荆州后被迁往汝南，为屯田民放牛。

steps.text: 241: Proposes canals and soldier-farms across the Huai region in his essay on Ji river.
steps.text_zh: 241年，著《济河论》，主持两淮屯田，开凿河渠。

steps.text: 255: Relieves Didao after Jiang Wei's victory at Taoxi and takes command in the west.
steps.text_zh: 255年，姜维洮西大捷后，邓艾领兵解狄道之围，从此镇守陇右。

steps.text: 256: Anticipates Jiang Wei's attack and routs him at Duangu.
steps.text_zh: 256年，料敌先机，在段谷大破姜维。

steps.place_zh: 阴平道（今四川青川摩天岭）
steps.text: 263: Leads his men 700 li through roadless mountains, rolling down the cliffs wrapped in felt.
steps.text_zh: 263年，率军自阴平行无人之地七百余里，在摩天岭以毡裹身滚下山崖。

steps.text: 263: Destroys the last Shu army under Zhuge Zhan.
steps.text_zh: 263年，在绵竹击败诸葛瞻，蜀军最后的主力覆灭。

steps.text: 263: Accepts the surrender of Liu Shan; Shu Han falls.
steps.text_zh: 263年，刘禅出城投降，蜀汉灭亡。

steps.text: 264: Accused of rebellion by Zhong Hui, he is arrested and later killed near Mianzhu.
steps.text_zh: 264年，遭钟会诬告谋反，被押解途中，于绵竹以西遇害。

title: Wang Xizhi's life
summary: Born into the great Wang clan of Langya, Wang Xizhi crossed the Yangtze as a child with the refugee court, served on the middle Yangtze, and spent his last years among the hills of Kuaiji, where he wrote the Orchid Pavilion Preface.
summary_zh: 王羲之出身琅琊王氏，幼年随晋室南渡，曾在长江中游任职，晚年寄情会稽山水，留下《兰亭集序》。

steps.text: 303: Born at Linyi into the Langya Wang clan, one of the most powerful families of the Jin.
steps.text_zh: 303年，生于琅琊临沂，出身东晋第一等高门琅琊王氏。

steps.text: c. 307: As the north falls into chaos, his family follows Sima Rui and his uncle Wang Dao south across the Yangtze.
steps.text_zh: 约307年，北方大乱，随家族跟从司马睿、伯父王导南渡，定居建邺。

steps.text: c. 318: Studies calligraphy with Lady Wei; later chosen as son-in-law by Xi Jian for lying at ease on the eastern couch.
steps.text_zh: 约318年，在建康随卫夫人学书；后因“坦腹东床”被郗鉴选为女婿。

steps.text: c. 334: Joins the staff of Yu Liang at Wuchang, rising to chief aide.
steps.text_zh: 约334年，入征西将军庾亮幕府，后任长史，驻武昌。

steps.text: c. 341: After Yu Liang's death he becomes Inspector of Jiangzhou.
steps.text_zh: 约341年，庾亮死后出任江州刺史。

steps.text: 351: Appointed General of the Right and Governor of Kuaiji — hence 'Wang the General of the Right'.
steps.text_zh: 351年，任右军将军、会稽内史，世称“王右军”。

steps.text: 353: Hosts the spring purification party at the Orchid Pavilion and writes its preface, the most famous work of Chinese calligraphy.
steps.text_zh: 353年，与谢安等名士修禊兰亭，写下“天下第一行书”《兰亭集序》。

steps.text: 355: Resigns in disgust with a rival official and swears at his parents' tomb never to serve again.
steps.text_zh: 355年，因与王述不和辞官，在父母墓前发誓不再出仕。

steps.text: 361: Dies at his retreat at Jinting in Shan county, after years of roaming the hills and seeking Daoist herbs.
steps.text_zh: 361年，晚年遍游山水、采药求仙，卒于剡县金庭。

title: Tao Yuanming's life
summary: Tao Yuanming drifted in and out of minor posts under warlords on the Yangtze before quitting office for good in 405 and farming near Mount Lu, becoming China's model poet of the recluse life.
summary_zh: 陶渊明几度出仕于长江沿线的军阀幕府，405年辞彭泽令后彻底归隐庐山脚下躬耕，成为田园诗的典范。

steps.text: 365: Born at Chaisang near Mount Lu, great-grandson of the Jin general Tao Kan, into a family that had come down in the world.
steps.text_zh: 365年，生于浔阳柴桑，曾祖为东晋名将陶侃，家道已中落。

steps.text: 393: Takes his first post as an education officer of Jiangzhou, but soon resigns.
steps.text_zh: 393年，初任江州祭酒，不堪吏职，不久辞归。

steps.text: c. 400: Serves on the staff of the warlord Huan Xuan at Jiangling, travelling to the capital on errands.
steps.text_zh: 约400年，入荆州刺史桓玄幕府，曾奉使往返京城。

steps.text: 404: Becomes an adjutant to the Zhenjun general at Jingkou — by most accounts Liu Yu, who had just overthrown Huan Xuan.
steps.text_zh: 404年，任镇军参军于京口，一说其主为刚起兵讨桓玄的刘裕。

steps.text: 405: Magistrate of Pengze for about eighty days; refusing to 'bow for five pecks of rice', he resigns.
steps.text_zh: 405年，任彭泽令八十余日，“不为五斗米折腰”，挂印而去。

steps.place_zh: 庐山脚下故里（今江西九江）
steps.text: 405: Goes home writing 'Return Home!' and takes up farming for the rest of his life.
steps.text_zh: 405年，作《归去来兮辞》，回乡躬耕，从此不再出仕。

steps.text: 410: After his house burns down in 408, he moves to Nancun near Xunyang, among congenial neighbours.
steps.text_zh: 410年，旧宅于408年失火后，移居寻阳南村，与邻人诗酒往还。

steps.text: 427: Dies in poverty at home, having written his own elegy.
steps.text_zh: 427年，贫病中卒于家，生前自作《挽歌诗》《自祭文》。

title: Zu Ti's northern campaign
summary: Zu Ti led his clansmen south when the north fell, then crossed back over the Yangtze with a tiny force and recovered almost all the land south of the Yellow River before dying at his front line.
summary_zh: 西晋末北方沦陷，祖逖率宗族南迁，又以寡兵渡江北伐，收复黄河以南大片土地，最终卒于前线雍丘。

steps.text: 266: Born into a gentry family of Fanyang.
steps.text_zh: 266年，生于范阳遒县士族之家。

steps.text: c. 291: As a registrar of Sizhou with his friend Liu Kun, he rises at cockcrow to practise swordplay.
steps.text_zh: 约291年，与刘琨同为司州主簿，闻鸡起舞，相约报国。

steps.text: 311: As Luoyang falls, he leads several hundred families of kin and neighbours south to the Huai and Si rivers.
steps.text_zh: 311年，永嘉之乱，率亲党数百家南迁，避地淮泗。

steps.text: 313: Given a title but almost no troops, he crosses the Yangtze north, striking his oar mid-stream and vowing to retake the north.
steps.text_zh: 313年，受命北伐，仅得千人粮、三千匹布，渡江时中流击楫，誓清中原。

steps.text: 313: Camps at Huaiyin, casting weapons and recruiting over two thousand men.
steps.text_zh: 313年，屯淮阴，起冶铸兵，募得二千余人。

steps.text: c. 317: Takes Qiao after hard fighting with local strongmen and Later Zhao forces.
steps.text_zh: 约317年，苦战坞主与后赵援军，攻取谯城。

steps.text: 320: Faces Shi Le's general Tao Bao across the old city; tricks him with sacks of 'grain' filled with earth and drives him off.
steps.text_zh: 320年，与后赵将桃豹对峙于蓬陂，以土囊伪装米粮，挫其军心，迫其退走。

steps.text: 321: Holding the land south of the Yellow River, he dies of illness at Yongqiu, embittered by the court's distrust.
steps.text_zh: 321年，黄河以南尽为晋土，却遭朝廷猜忌，忧愤病卒于雍丘。

title: Xie An's life
summary: Xie An lingered for decades as a celebrated recluse in the hills of Kuaiji, entered office at forty, outmanoeuvred Huan Wen and steered the Eastern Jin to victory at the Fei River.
summary_zh: 谢安早年高卧会稽东山，四十岁方出仕，以从容气度挫败桓温篡位之谋，又主持淝水之战，保全东晋。

steps.text: 320: Born into the Xie clan of Chen commandery, which had moved south with the Jin court.
steps.text_zh: 320年，生于陈郡谢氏，家族已随晋室南渡，居建康。

steps.text: c. 341: Refuses office and lives at leisure on Dongshan, roaming with Wang Xizhi and other literati.
steps.text_zh: 约341年，屡征不就，隐居会稽东山，与王羲之等名士游山玩水。

steps.text: 353: Takes part in Wang Xizhi's famous gathering at the Orchid Pavilion.
steps.text_zh: 353年，参加兰亭修禊之会，赋诗唱和。

steps.text: 360: Aged forty he finally takes office as Huan Wen's marshal — 'rising again from Dongshan'.
steps.text_zh: 360年，年届四十，出任桓温征西司马，是为“东山再起”。

steps.text: c. 362: Governor of Wuxing, then called to court.
steps.text_zh: 约362年，出任吴兴太守，后入朝为官。

steps.text: 373: Meets Huan Wen, who has come to the capital with troops, with perfect composure, and stalls his bid for the throne until Huan dies.
steps.text_zh: 373年，桓温率兵入朝，谢安于新亭从容相见，拖延其加九锡之请，直至桓温病死。

steps.text: 383: Directs the defence against Fu Jian; when news of the Fei River victory arrives he keeps playing weiqi.
steps.text_zh: 383年，坐镇建康调度淝水之战，捷报至，仍对弈如故。

steps.text: 385: Edged out by Sima Daozi, he leaves the capital to command from Bu Qiu near Guangling.
steps.text_zh: 385年，受司马道子排挤，出镇广陵，筑新城于步丘。

steps.text: 385: Falls ill, returns to the capital and dies.
steps.text_zh: 385年，染病还都，卒于建康。

title: Huan Wen's campaigns
summary: From his base on the middle Yangtze, Huan Wen conquered Sichuan and led three northern expeditions, then turned on the court, deposing an emperor before dying short of the throne.
summary_zh: 桓温以荆州为根基，西灭成汉，三度北伐，晚年专擅朝政、废立皇帝，终未篡位而卒。

steps.text: 312: Born into the Huan clan of Longkang in Qiao commandery.
steps.text_zh: 312年，生于谯国龙亢桓氏。

steps.text: 329: At eighteen avenges his father, killed in Su Jun's rebellion, by slaying the sons of the man responsible.
steps.text_zh: 329年，父桓彝死于苏峻之乱，年仅十八的桓温手刃仇人江播之子，名动一时。

steps.text: 345: Made Inspector of Jingzhou, controlling the middle Yangtze from Jiangling.
steps.text_zh: 345年，出任荆州刺史，坐镇江陵，掌长江上游重兵。

steps.text: 347: Strikes deep into Sichuan and destroys the Cheng-Han state.
steps.text_zh: 347年，溯江入蜀，攻破成都，灭成汉。

steps.text: 354: First northern expedition reaches Bashang outside Chang'an, where Wang Meng chats with him picking lice; he withdraws for lack of grain.
steps.text_zh: 354年，第一次北伐，进抵长安城外灞上，王猛扪虱而谈；因粮尽撤军。

steps.text: 356: Second expedition recaptures Luoyang and repairs the Jin imperial tombs.
steps.text_zh: 356年，第二次北伐，收复洛阳，修复西晋诸帝陵。

steps.text: c. 365: Moves his headquarters to Gushu, close to the capital.
steps.text_zh: 约365年，移镇姑孰，逼近京师。

steps.text: 369: Third expedition against Former Yan stalls at Fangtou and ends in a disastrous retreat.
steps.text_zh: 369年，第三次北伐前燕，兵至枋头，粮道断绝，退兵时大败。

steps.text: 371: To restore his prestige he deposes Emperor Fei and enthrones Emperor Jianwen.
steps.text_zh: 371年，为重树威望，废晋帝司马奕，立简文帝。

steps.text: 373: Still angling for the Nine Bestowals, stalled by Xie An, he dies at Gushu.
steps.text_zh: 373年，求加九锡未果，被谢安等拖延，病卒于姑孰。

title: Kumarajiva's journey
summary: Born in Kucha, Kumarajiva studied in Kashmir and Kashgar, was carried east as a war captive, and spent his last years in Chang'an translating the Buddhist scriptures that shaped Chinese Buddhism.
summary_zh: 鸠摩罗什生于龟兹，求学罽宾、疏勒，后作为战俘被带往凉州，晚年在长安主持译经，奠定汉传佛教经典的基础。

steps.text: 344: Born in Kucha to an Indian father and a Kuchean princess.
steps.text_zh: 344年，生于龟兹，父为天竺人，母为龟兹王妹。

steps.text: 353: Taken by his mother to Kashmir to study Hinayana scriptures.
steps.text_zh: 353年，九岁随母赴罽宾，从名师学习小乘经典。

steps.text: c. 355: On the way home stays in Kashgar and turns to Mahayana teaching.
steps.text_zh: 约355年，归途中停留疏勒，转学大乘。

steps.text: 384: Now a famous teacher in Kucha, he is captured when the Former Qin general Lü Guang takes the city.
steps.text_zh: 384年，已名闻西域，前秦大将吕光攻破龟兹，将其掳走。

steps.text: 386: Lü Guang sets up his own Later Liang state at Guzang and keeps Kumarajiva there for some sixteen years, where he learns Chinese.
steps.text_zh: 386年，吕光据姑臧建后凉，罗什被羁留凉州十余年，学通汉语。

steps.text: 401: Brought to Chang'an by the Later Qin ruler Yao Xing and honoured as National Preceptor.
steps.text_zh: 401年，后秦姚兴迎入长安，待以国师之礼。

steps.text: c. 406: With hundreds of monks translates the Lotus Sutra, the Diamond Sutra, the Treatise on the Great Perfection of Wisdom and more.
steps.text_zh: 约406年，在逍遥园等处率数百僧人译出《法华经》《金刚经》《大智度论》等经论。

steps.place_zh: 草堂寺（今陕西西安鄠邑区）
steps.text: 413: Dies in Chang'an (by some accounts 409); his relic stupa stands at Caotang Temple.
steps.text_zh: 413年，卒于长安（一说409年），舍利塔今存草堂寺。

title: Liu Yu's campaigns
summary: A poor soldier from Jingkou, Liu Yu rose by crushing the Sun En rebels, toppled the usurper Huan Xuan, reconquered Shandong and Chang'an, and ended the Jin by founding the Song dynasty.
summary_zh: 刘裕出身京口寒门，以镇压孙恩起家，起兵推翻桓玄，北灭南燕、后秦，最终代晋建宋。

steps.text: 363: Born at Jingkou to a poor family; his mother dies at his birth.
steps.text_zh: 363年，生于京口，家贫，母亲产后即亡。

steps.text: 399: As an officer of the Beifu army under Liu Laozhi he makes his name fighting Sun En's rebels.
steps.text_zh: 399年，从北府将刘牢之东征孙恩，屡立战功，崭露头角。

steps.text: 404: Raises troops at Jingkou against Huan Xuan, takes Jiankang and restores the Jin emperor.
steps.text_zh: 404年，于京口起兵讨伐篡位的桓玄，攻入建康，恢复晋室。

steps.text: 410: Takes Guanggu after a long siege and destroys Southern Yan.
steps.text_zh: 410年，围攻广固数月破城，灭南燕。

steps.text: 412: Moves west against his rival Liu Yi, who is defeated and kills himself near Jiangling.
steps.text_zh: 412年，西讨政敌刘毅，刘毅兵败自尽，荆州归于刘裕。

steps.place_zh: 黄河滑台一带（今河南滑县）
steps.text: 417: Sailing up the Yellow River, his army breaks Northern Wei cavalry with the crescent-shaped 'queyue' formation.
steps.text_zh: 417年，率水军溯黄河西进，以却月阵大破北魏骑兵。

steps.text: 417: Enters Chang'an and destroys Later Qin — the first southern recapture of the old capital in a century.
steps.text_zh: 417年，攻入长安，灭后秦，百年来南方首次收复旧都。

steps.text: 418: Hurrying home to secure power, he is made Duke and then King of Song at Pengcheng; Chang'an is soon lost.
steps.text_zh: 418年，急于回朝夺权，在彭城受封宋公、宋王，长安旋即失守。

steps.text: 420: Takes the throne from the Jin and founds the Liu Song dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 420年，受晋禅，建立宋朝。

steps.text: 422: Dies after barely two years on the throne.
steps.text_zh: 422年，在位仅两年余，病逝于建康。

title: Emperor Xiaowen's life
summary: Raised at Pingcheng under his formidable grandmother, Emperor Xiaowen moved the Northern Wei capital to Luoyang, pushed his Xianbei elite to adopt Chinese ways, and died campaigning against the south.
summary_zh: 孝文帝在平城由冯太后抚养长大，亲政后迁都洛阳，推行汉化改革，最终死于南征途中。

steps.text: 467: Born at Pingcheng, the Northern Wei capital, as Tuoba Hong.
steps.text_zh: 467年，生于北魏都城平城，名拓跋宏。

steps.text: 471: Aged four, he is placed on the throne when his father abdicates; Empress Dowager Feng runs the state.
steps.text_zh: 471年，父献文帝禅位，四岁即位，由冯太后主政。

steps.text: 490: Grandmother Feng dies, after pushing through the equal-field system, and is buried at Yonggu tomb on Fangshan; he begins ruling alone.
steps.text_zh: 490年，推行均田制的冯太后去世，葬于方山永固陵，孝文帝开始亲政。

steps.text: 493: Leads his army south 'to attack Qi', then halts in the autumn rains at Luoyang and declares it the new capital.
steps.text_zh: 493年，以南伐为名率军南下，秋雨中驻跸洛阳，借势定议迁都。

steps.text: 495: Visits Lu and sacrifices to Confucius, honouring his descendants.
steps.text_zh: 495年，巡幸鲁城，亲祀孔子，封孔子后裔。

steps.text: 495: Bans Xianbei dress and the Xianbei language at court, and later takes the surname Yuan.
steps.text_zh: 495年，在洛阳禁胡服、断北语，次年改姓元氏。

steps.text: 497: Campaigns against Southern Qi and takes Wancheng and Xinye.
steps.text_zh: 497年，亲征南齐，攻取宛城、新野等地。

steps.place_zh: 谷塘原（今河南邓州一带）
steps.text: 499: Falls ill on campaign and dies at Gutangyuan, aged only thirty-three by Chinese reckoning.
steps.text_zh: 499年，南征途中病重，崩于谷塘原，年仅三十三岁。

title: Li Daoyuan's travels
summary: A Northern Wei official who served across north China, Li Daoyuan turned his travels into the Commentary on the Water Classic before being murdered on a mission to Guanzhong.
summary_zh: 郦道元宦游北方各地，将亲历见闻写入《水经注》，最终在出使关中途中遇害。

steps.text: c. 470: Born into an official family of Fanyang.
steps.text_zh: 约470年，生于范阳涿县官宦之家。

steps.text: c. 480: Spends his boyhood in Qingzhou where his father is Inspector, exploring its rivers.
steps.text_zh: 约480年，随任青州刺史的父亲郦范居青州，少年时常游览当地山水。

steps.text: 494: As a court secretary he accompanies Emperor Xiaowen on a northern tour of the frontier.
steps.text_zh: 494年，任尚书郎，随孝文帝北巡边塞。

steps.place_zh: 冀州信都（今河北衡水冀州）
steps.text: c. 504: Serves as chief aide in Jizhou, earning a reputation for harshness.
steps.text_zh: 约504年，任冀州长史，以执法严苛著称。

steps.text: c. 507: Governor of Luyang, where he founds schools.
steps.text_zh: 约507年，任鲁阳太守，兴办学校。

steps.text: c. 512: Inspector of Dongjingzhou; dismissed after complaints from local tribes.
steps.text_zh: 约512年，任东荆州刺史，因蛮民控诉其严酷被免官。

steps.text: c. 515: Out of office in Luoyang, he compiles the Commentary on the Water Classic, describing over 1,000 rivers.
steps.text_zh: 约515年，免官闲居洛阳，撰成《水经注》，记述大小水道一千余条。

steps.text: 525: Leads troops against the rebel Yuan Faseng at Pengcheng.
steps.text_zh: 525年，持节督军讨伐据彭城叛降南梁的元法僧。

steps.place_zh: 阴盘驿（今陕西西安临潼）
steps.text: 527: Sent to Guanzhong, he is besieged and killed with his sons at Yinpan post station by the rebel Xiao Baoyin.
steps.text_zh: 527年，奉命出使关中，在阴盘驿被叛将萧宝夤部围杀，与二子同死。

title: Yu Xin's life
summary: The brightest poet of the Liang court, Yu Xin was trapped in the north as an envoy when Jiangling fell, and spent his last decades honoured but homesick in Chang'an.
summary_zh: 庾信是梁朝宫廷最负盛名的诗人，出使西魏时江陵陷落，从此羁留北方，晚年在长安位高而思乡，写下《哀江南赋》。

steps.text: 513: Born into the Yu clan of Xinye, settled at Jiangling (by some accounts born in Jiankang).
steps.text_zh: 513年，出生于南阳新野庾氏，家居江陵（一说生于建康）。

steps.text: c. 527: Serves in Crown Prince Xiao Gang's household; with Xu Ling he creates the ornate 'Xu-Yu style'.
steps.text_zh: 约527年，入东宫侍奉太子萧纲，与徐陵并称“徐庾体”。

steps.text: c. 545: Sent as envoy to the Eastern Wei, where his writing is admired.
steps.text_zh: 约545年，出使东魏邺城，文章为北人所称。

steps.text: 548: Hou Jing's rebels reach the capital; Yu Xin's guard at the Zhuque Bridge breaks and he flees.
steps.text_zh: 548年，侯景叛军兵临建康，庾信守朱雀航，兵溃出逃。

steps.text: 552: Joins Emperor Yuan's court at Jiangling.
steps.text_zh: 552年，投奔江陵梁元帝，任御史中丞。

steps.text: 554: Sent as envoy to Western Wei; while he is in Chang'an Jiangling falls, and he is never allowed home.
steps.text_zh: 554年，奉命出使西魏，抵长安后江陵陷落，从此羁留北方。

steps.text: c. 565: Serves the Northern Zhou as governor of Hongnong.
steps.text_zh: 约565年，仕北周，出任弘农郡守。

steps.text: 581: Dies in Chang'an, having poured his longing for the south into the Lament for the South (c. 578).
steps.text_zh: 581年，卒于长安；晚年作《哀江南赋》（约578年），寄托故国之思。

title: Bodhidharma's journey
summary: By tradition a South Indian prince turned monk, Bodhidharma came to China by sea, met Emperor Wu of Liang, crossed the Yangtze on a reed and sat facing a wall near Shaolin; most of his story is legend.
summary_zh: 相传菩提达摩为南天竺王子，渡海来华，见梁武帝不契，一苇渡江，在少林面壁九年，被尊为禅宗初祖；其生平多出传说。

steps.place_zh: 南天竺（今印度甘吉布勒姆）
steps.text: c. 470: By later tradition the third son of a South Indian king, who becomes a disciple of Prajnatara.
steps.text_zh: 约470年，相传为南天竺香至王第三子，出家师从般若多罗。

steps.text: c. 479: Arrives by sea in the south of Liu Song territory (by other accounts in 520 or 527).
steps.text_zh: 约479年，泛海抵达刘宋南越之地（一说520年或527年至广州）。

steps.text: c. 516: According to Yang Xuanzhi, a western monk named Bodhidharma praises the newly built Yongning pagoda, chanting namo for days.
steps.text_zh: 约516年，据《洛阳伽蓝记》，西域沙门菩提达摩见新建的永宁寺塔，赞叹不已，合掌连日。

steps.text: 520: In the famous legend he tells Emperor Wu of Liang that his temple-building earns 'no merit' (some date it 527).
steps.text_zh: 520年，相传在建康见梁武帝，答以造寺度僧“并无功德”，话不投机（一说527年）。

steps.text: 520: Crosses the Yangtze northward, by legend on a single reed.
steps.text_zh: 520年，相传折一苇渡江北去。

steps.place_zh: 嵩山少林寺（今河南登封）
steps.text: c. 521: Settles near Shaolin and sits facing a cave wall for nine years; Huike becomes his disciple.
steps.text_zh: 约521年，止于嵩山少林寺，面壁九年，传法慧可。

steps.place_zh: 熊耳山（今河南三门峡陕州区）
steps.text: 536: Dies, by tradition poisoned, and is buried at the Xiong'er Mountains, where Kongxiang Temple keeps his memory.
steps.text_zh: 536年，相传遇毒而逝，葬于熊耳山，今空相寺即其葬地。

title: Chen Qingzhi's campaigns
summary: A low-born attendant who never rode or shot well, Chen Qingzhi led 7,000 Liang troops across the north in 529 and briefly seated a puppet emperor in Luoyang.
summary_zh: 陈庆之出身寒微，不善骑射，却在529年率七千白袍军北上，连战连捷，一度攻入洛阳。

steps.text: 484: Born to a humble family of Yixing.
steps.text_zh: 484年，生于义兴国山寒门之家。

steps.text: c. 502: Becomes Xiao Yan's attendant and all-night weiqi partner as he founds the Liang.
steps.text_zh: 约502年，随侍萧衍，常通宵陪其下棋，深得信任。

steps.text: 525: Escorts Prince Xiao Zong to take over Pengcheng after the Wei governor defects.
steps.text_zh: 525年，北魏元法僧以彭城降梁，陈庆之护送豫章王萧综入镇。

steps.text: 527: Breaks the Wei army at Guoyang, his first great victory.
steps.text_zh: 527年，涡阳之战大破魏军，一战成名。

steps.text: 529: Escorting the Wei prince Yuan Hao north with 7,000 men in white robes, he takes Suiyang.
steps.text_zh: 529年，率七千白袍军护送北魏北海王元颢北上，攻克睢阳。

steps.text: 529: Storms Xingyang and routs the Wei relief army.
steps.text_zh: 529年，攻拔荥阳，大破魏军援兵。

steps.text: 529: Enters Luoyang and seats Yuan Hao on the throne — 'great generals avoid the white robes'.
steps.text_zh: 529年，攻入洛阳，扶元颢称帝，“名师大将莫自牢，千兵万马避白袍”。

steps.text: 529: Erzhu Rong retakes Luoyang; his army is lost in floods at Mount Song and he escapes home disguised as a monk.
steps.text_zh: 529年，尔朱荣反攻洛阳，白袍军在嵩高水溃散，陈庆之剃发扮作僧人潜回建康。

steps.text: 539: After years governing the northern frontier from Yiyang, where he defeated Hou Jing in 536, he dies in office.
steps.text_zh: 539年，任南、北司二州刺史镇守义阳多年，曾大破侯景，卒于任上。

title: Yan Zhitui's life
summary: Yan Zhitui saw three states fall around him — Liang, Northern Qi and Northern Zhou — as he was carried from Jiangling to Chang'an to Ye and back, and distilled his experience into the Family Instructions of the Yan Clan.
summary_zh: 颜之推一生“三为亡国之人”，从江陵被掳至长安，冒险奔齐，又随齐亡入关，晚年写成《颜氏家训》。

steps.text: 531: Born at Jiangling into the Langya Yan clan, his father an aide to the Liang prince Xiao Yi.
steps.text_zh: 531年，生于江陵，出身琅琊颜氏，父颜协为湘东王萧绎属官。

steps.text: 549: Serves the young prince Xiao Fangzhu at Yingzhou; captured when Hou Jing's army takes it in 551.
steps.text_zh: 549年，在郢州辅佐萧方诸；551年侯景军攻陷郢州，被俘。

steps.text: 551: Taken as a prisoner to Jiankang, narrowly escaping execution.
steps.text_zh: 551年，被押往建康，险些被杀。

steps.text: 554: Back at Jiangling collating books for Emperor Yuan, he is captured again when Western Wei sacks the city.
steps.text_zh: 554年，回江陵为梁元帝校书，西魏攻破江陵，再度被俘。

steps.text: 555: Sent north to serve as a secretary at Hongnong.
steps.text_zh: 555年，被押送北上，在弘农掌书记。

steps.text: 556: Escapes with his family by boat down the Yellow River through the Sanmen rapids, hoping to reach the south via Northern Qi.
steps.text_zh: 556年，携家眷乘船顺黄河冒险过砥柱之险，投奔北齐，欲辗转南归。

steps.text: 557: The Liang falls to Chen, so he stays at Ye and serves Northern Qi for twenty years, rising in the Wenlin Academy.
steps.text_zh: 557年，梁为陈所代，南归无望，留仕北齐二十年，曾待诏文林馆。

steps.text: 577: When Northern Zhou conquers Qi he is taken to Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 577年，北周灭北齐，随齐臣入关至长安。

steps.text: c. 591: Serves the Sui, joins the phonology discussions behind the Qieyun, and dies after finishing his Family Instructions.
steps.text_zh: 约591年，入隋任职，参与审定音韵，撰成《颜氏家训》后去世。

title: Emperor Yang of Sui's life
summary: Yang Guang conquered the Chen as a prince, schemed his way to the throne, built Luoyang and the Grand Canal, travelled endlessly, and was killed at Jiangdu as his empire collapsed.
summary_zh: 杨广以晋王身份平陈，夺嫡登基，营建东都、开凿运河，巡游无度，三征高句丽失败，最终在江都被杀。

steps.text: 569: Born in Chang'an, second son of Yang Jian and Dugu Qieluo.
steps.text_zh: 569年，生于长安，为杨坚与独孤伽罗次子。

steps.text: 581: Made Prince of Jin and sent to govern Bingzhou at the age of twelve.
steps.text_zh: 581年，封晋王，年十二出任并州总管，镇晋阳。

steps.text: 589: As commander-in-chief of the Sui armies he takes Jiankang and ends the Chen dynasty.
steps.text_zh: 589年，任行军元帅，攻入建康，灭陈统一天下。

steps.text: 590: Made Viceroy of Yangzhou, he spends ten years winning over the southern elite.
steps.text_zh: 590年，任扬州总管镇江都，十年间笼络江南士族。

steps.text: 600: Displaces his elder brother Yang Yong as crown prince.
steps.text_zh: 600年，构陷兄长杨勇被废，自己被立为太子。

steps.text: 604: His father dies at the Renshou Palace under suspicious circumstances and he takes the throne.
steps.text_zh: 604年，隋文帝崩于仁寿宫，死因成疑，杨广继位。

steps.text: 605: Builds a vast new Eastern Capital at Luoyang and begins the Tongji Canal.
steps.text_zh: 605年，营建东都洛阳，开凿通济渠。

steps.text: 609: Tours the far northwest, receiving envoys of 27 western states at Zhangye.
steps.text_zh: 609年，西巡至张掖，接见西域二十七国使者。

steps.text: 612: Leads over a million men against Goguryeo and besieges Liaodong city in vain.
steps.text_zh: 612年，亲率百万大军征高句丽，久攻辽东城不下。

steps.text: 615: Trapped at Yanmen by the Eastern Turks for a month.
steps.text_zh: 615年，北巡被突厥始毕可汗围困于雁门一月余。

steps.text: 616: With revolts everywhere, he sails off to Jiangdu for the third time and never returns north.
steps.text_zh: 616年，天下大乱，第三次南下江都，不再北返。

steps.text: 618: Strangled by his own guards under Yuwen Huaji.
steps.text_zh: 618年，宇文化及发动兵变，炀帝被缢杀于江都。

title: Li Shimin's campaigns
summary: Li Shimin helped his father seize Chang'an, won the decisive battles that unified the Tang, killed his brothers at the Xuanwu Gate, and ruled as Emperor Taizong.
summary_zh: 李世民助父起兵夺取长安，亲率大军平定群雄，玄武门之变后即位为唐太宗，开创贞观之治。

steps.text: 598: Born at the family estate at Wugong, second son of Li Yuan.
steps.text_zh: 598年，生于武功李氏别馆，为李渊次子。

steps.text: 615: Aged seventeen, joins the army sent to relieve Emperor Yang besieged at Yanmen.
steps.text_zh: 615年，年十七应募，随军解雁门之围。

steps.text: 617: Urges his father to rise against the Sui at Jinyang.
steps.text_zh: 617年，力劝父亲李渊于晋阳起兵反隋。

steps.text: 617: Marches through the Guanzhong plain and helps take Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 617年，率军西进，与诸军攻克长安。

steps.text: 618: Destroys Xue Rengao's army at Qianshuiyuan, securing the west.
steps.text_zh: 618年，在浅水原大破薛仁杲，平定陇右。

steps.text: 621: Crushes Dou Jiande at Hulao, forcing Wang Shichong to surrender Luoyang.
steps.text_zh: 621年，虎牢之战生擒窦建德，迫使王世充献洛阳投降。

steps.text: 626: Ambushes and kills his brothers Jiancheng and Yuanji; two months later he is emperor.
steps.text_zh: 626年，发动玄武门之变，杀兄李建成、弟李元吉，两月后即位。

steps.text: 626: Faces down the Turkic khan Jieli across the Wei River and makes a truce.
steps.text_zh: 626年，突厥颉利可汗兵临渭水，太宗亲至便桥与之订盟退兵。

steps.text: 645: Leads the invasion of Goguryeo himself but fails to take Ansi and withdraws.
steps.text_zh: 645年，亲征高句丽，久攻安市城不下，班师。

steps.place_zh: 终南山翠微宫（今陕西西安）
steps.text: 649: Dies at the Cuiwei Palace in the Zhongnan Mountains; buried at Zhaoling.
steps.text_zh: 649年，崩于终南山翠微宫，葬昭陵。

title: Wu Zetian's life
summary: From an official's daughter raised in the provinces, Wu Zetian rose from palace concubine to empress and then China's only female emperor, ruling from Luoyang.
summary_zh: 武则天自幼随父宦游各地，由宫中才人而为皇后，终于称帝建周，成为中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。

steps.text: 624: Born in Chang'an, daughter of Wu Shihuo, a timber merchant turned Tang official (by some accounts born in Lizhou).
steps.text_zh: 624年，生于长安，父武士彟由木材商起家仕唐（一说生于利州）。

steps.text: c. 628: Spends part of her childhood at Lizhou, where her father is commander-in-chief.
steps.text_zh: 约628年，随任利州都督的父亲在蜀中度过童年。

steps.text: 635: Her father dies in office as commander-in-chief of Jingzhou.
steps.text_zh: 635年，父亲卒于荆州都督任上。

steps.text: 637: Enters Emperor Taizong's palace as a fifth-rank concubine.
steps.text_zh: 637年，入宫为唐太宗才人，赐号“武媚”。

steps.text: 649: After Taizong's death she becomes a nun at Ganye Temple; Emperor Gaozong soon brings her back.
steps.text_zh: 649年，太宗驾崩，出家感业寺为尼，不久被高宗召回宫中。

steps.text: 655: Displaces Empress Wang and becomes Gaozong's empress.
steps.text_zh: 655年，废王皇后，立为皇后。

steps.text: 666: Joins Gaozong in the feng and shan sacrifices at Mount Tai, making the second offering herself.
steps.text_zh: 666年，随高宗封禅泰山，亲任亚献，开皇后参与封禅之先例。

steps.text: 675: The great Vairocana Buddha at Longmen, partly paid for from her cosmetics money, is completed.
steps.text_zh: 675年，她捐助脂粉钱的龙门奉先寺卢舍那大佛落成。

steps.text: 690: Proclaims herself emperor of a new Zhou dynasty, ruling from Luoyang.
steps.text_zh: 690年，在神都洛阳称帝，改国号为周。

steps.text: 696: Performs the feng sacrifice on Mount Song, the Central Peak.
steps.text_zh: 696年，封禅中岳嵩山，改元万岁登封。

steps.text: 705: Forced to abdicate in the Shenlong coup; dies later that year in the Shangyang Palace.
steps.text_zh: 705年，神龙政变后被迫退位，同年冬崩于上阳宫。

title: Princess Wencheng's journey
summary: Princess Wencheng travelled from Chang'an across the Qinghai plateau to marry the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo, and lived out nearly forty years in Lhasa.
summary_zh: 文成公主自长安出发，穿越青藏高原远嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布，在拉萨生活近四十年。

steps.text: 641: A princess of the imperial clan, she leaves Chang'an escorted by Li Daozong to marry Songtsen Gampo.
steps.text_zh: 641年，宗室女文成公主由江夏王李道宗护送，自长安启程远嫁吐蕃。

steps.text: 641: Crossing out of Tang lands — by legend she throws down her mirror of home here.
steps.text_zh: 641年，西出唐境，相传在此摔碎日月宝镜，以绝思乡之念。

steps.place_zh: 柏海（今青海玛多扎陵湖一带）
steps.text: 641: Songtsen Gampo comes to meet her at Bohai near the source of the Yellow River.
steps.text_zh: 641年，松赞干布亲至黄河源头的柏海迎接，行子婿之礼。

steps.text: 641: By local tradition her party rests here and carves Buddhist images; a Wencheng temple stands there today.
steps.text_zh: 641年，相传途经玉树，在贝纳沟刻造佛像，今有文成公主庙。

steps.text: 641: Arrives at the Tibetan capital and is married to Songtsen Gampo.
steps.text_zh: 641年，抵达逻些，与松赞干布成婚。

steps.text: c. 647: By tradition the Ramoche temple is built to house the Jowo Shakyamuni image she brought from Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 约647年，相传为供奉她带来的释迦牟尼佛像而建小昭寺。

steps.text: 680: Widowed in 650, she remains in Tibet for thirty more years and dies there.
steps.text_zh: 680年，650年松赞干布去世后，她继续留居吐蕃三十年，卒于逻些。

title: Yijing's journey
summary: The monk Yijing sailed from Guangzhou to India, studied for a decade at Nalanda, spent years writing in Srivijaya, and returned to translate scriptures in Luoyang and Chang'an.
summary_zh: 义净从广州泛海赴印度，在那烂陀寺求学十年，又在室利佛逝著述多年，归国后在洛阳、长安译经。

steps.text: 635: Born in Qizhou (by some accounts Fanyang); enters a monastery as a boy.
steps.text_zh: 635年，生于齐州（一说范阳），幼年出家。

steps.text: 671: Sets sail on a Persian merchant ship bound for the South Seas.
steps.text_zh: 671年，在广州搭乘波斯商船启程南行。

steps.place_zh: 室利佛逝（今印度尼西亚巨港）
steps.text: 671: Stops six months in Srivijaya to study Sanskrit.
steps.text_zh: 671年，抵室利佛逝，停留半年学习梵语。

steps.place_zh: 耽摩立底（今印度坦姆卢克）
steps.text: 673: Lands in eastern India and spends a year learning Sanskrit there.
steps.text_zh: 673年，抵达东印度耽摩立底，在此学习一年。

steps.place_zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔）
steps.text: 675: After visiting Bodh Gaya, he studies at Nalanda for some ten years.
steps.text_zh: 675年，礼拜菩提伽耶等圣迹后，入那烂陀寺求学约十年。

steps.place_zh: 室利佛逝（今印度尼西亚巨港）
steps.text: 687: Back in Srivijaya, he copies texts and writes his accounts of Buddhist practice and of pilgrim monks.
steps.text_zh: 687年，返至室利佛逝，抄译经典，撰《南海寄归内法传》《大唐西域求法高僧传》。

steps.text: 695: Returns with some 400 texts; Empress Wu herself welcomes him at Luoyang.
steps.text_zh: 695年，携梵本经论约四百部回到洛阳，武则天亲迎于上东门外。

steps.place_zh: 长安荐福寺（今陕西西安）
steps.text: 713: After years translating in Luoyang and at Jianfu Temple in Chang'an, he dies there.
steps.text_zh: 713年，先后在洛阳与长安荐福寺译经，卒于长安。

title: Huineng's life
summary: An illiterate firewood seller from Lingnan, Huineng received the robe of the Fifth Patriarch at Huangmei, hid for years among hunters, and taught at Caoxi as the Sixth Patriarch of Chan.
summary_zh: 慧能本是岭南卖柴的不识字少年，在黄梅得五祖衣钵，隐遁多年后于曹溪弘法，成为禅宗六祖。

steps.text: 638: Born in Xinzhou, where his father, an official from Fanyang, had been exiled.
steps.text_zh: 638年，生于新州，父亲本为范阳人，贬官至此。

steps.text: c. 660: Selling firewood in Nanhai, he hears a man reciting the Diamond Sutra and is awakened.
steps.text_zh: 约660年，在南海卖柴，闻客诵《金刚经》，心有所悟。

steps.text: 661: Works pounding rice at Hongren's monastery; his verse 'Bodhi has no tree' wins him the robe of the Fifth Patriarch.
steps.text_zh: 661年，投五祖弘忍门下舂米，以“菩提本无树”一偈得传衣钵。

steps.text: 662: Hides from jealous rivals among hunters around Sihui and Huaiji for some fifteen years.
steps.text_zh: 662年，为避追夺衣钵者，隐于四会、怀集一带猎人队中约十五年。

steps.text: 676: At Faxing Temple he says 'it is your mind that moves', is recognised, and takes full ordination.
steps.text_zh: 676年，在法性寺道出“仁者心动”，身份得以公开，正式受戒。

steps.place_zh: 曹溪宝林寺（今广东韶关南华寺）
steps.text: 677: Settles at Baolin Temple on the Caoxi, teaching sudden enlightenment for over thirty years.
steps.text_zh: 677年，入曹溪宝林寺，弘扬顿悟法门三十余年。

steps.place_zh: 韶州大梵寺（今广东韶关）
steps.text: c. 690: Invited by Prefect Wei Qu to preach at Dafan Temple; the sermon becomes the core of the Platform Sutra (date uncertain).
steps.text_zh: 约690年，应韶州刺史韦璩之请在大梵寺说法，记录成为《坛经》（时间不详）。

steps.place_zh: 新州国恩寺（今广东新兴）
steps.text: 713: Returns to his birthplace and dies at Guoen Temple; his body is taken back to Caoxi.
steps.text_zh: 713年，回到故乡新州国恩寺圆寂，真身迎回曹溪供奉。

title: Lady Xian's life
summary: A chieftain of the Li people of Lingnan, Lady Xian kept the far south loyal through the Liang, Chen and Sui, putting down rebellions and bringing the region peacefully into a reunited China.
summary_zh: 冼夫人是岭南俚人首领，历经梁、陈、隋三朝，平定叛乱、安抚百越，使岭南平稳归于统一。

steps.text: c. 512: Born into the Xian clan, hereditary chiefs of the Li people of Gaoliang; she later marries the governor Feng Bao.
steps.text_zh: 约512年，生于高凉俚人首领冼氏家族，后嫁高凉太守冯宝。

steps.text: c. 540: Over a thousand Li villages of Hainan submit through her influence, and at her request the Liang sets up Yazhou.
steps.text_zh: 约540年，海南儋耳千余峒归附，经她奏请，梁朝设置崖州。

steps.text: 550: After foiling the rebel Li Qianshi, she meets Chen Baxian at Ganshi and backs him against Hou Jing.
steps.text_zh: 550年，击败图谋叛乱的李迁仕，与陈霸先会于赣石，助其讨伐侯景。

steps.text: 570: When Ouyang He rebels at Guangzhou, she sends troops to help crush him and is honoured by the Chen.
steps.text_zh: 570年，广州刺史欧阳纥叛乱，她发兵助平，受陈朝册封。

steps.text: 590: Hearing that the Chen has fallen, she leads Lingnan to submit to the Sui, then rides with the envoy Pei Ju to pacify over twenty prefectures.
steps.text_zh: 590年，闻陈亡，率岭南归附隋朝，又亲披甲胄护送隋使裴矩巡抚二十余州。

steps.text: 601: Exposes the corrupt governor of Fanzhou, Zhao Na; carrying the emperor's edict, she tours over ten prefectures to calm the tribes.
steps.text_zh: 601年，揭发番州总管赵讷贪虐，亲载诏书巡抚十余州，安定俚僚。

steps.text: 602: Dies, revered across Lingnan as the 'Holy Mother'.
steps.text_zh: 602年，去世，岭南百姓奉为“岭南圣母”。

title: Wang Bo's travels
summary: A child prodigy from Shanxi, Wang Bo was expelled from a prince's court, wandered Sichuan, nearly died for a killing, wrote his famous preface at Nanchang and drowned at sea aged 26.
summary_zh: 王勃少年成名，因文获罪被逐出沛王府，漫游蜀中，又因杀官奴险遭处死；南下省父途中写下《滕王阁序》，终溺海惊悸而亡，年仅二十余岁。

steps.text: 650: Born into a scholarly family at Longmen; grandson of the Sui Confucian Wang Tong.
steps.text_zh: 650年，生于绛州龙门书香世家，祖父为隋末大儒王通。

steps.text: 666: Passes a special examination and joins the household of Li Xian, Prince of Pei, as an editor.
steps.text_zh: 666年，应幽素科及第，入沛王李贤府任修撰。

steps.text: 669: Expelled by Emperor Gaozong over a mock 'cockfight proclamation', he wanders the land of Shu for about three years.
steps.text_zh: 669年，因戏作《檄英王鸡》触怒高宗被逐出王府，入蜀漫游约三年。

steps.text: 672: Made an adjutant in Guozhou; he hides and then kills the runaway slave Cao Da, and is sentenced to death but pardoned (674). His father is demoted to Jiaozhi.
steps.text_zh: 672年，补虢州参军，因匿杀官奴曹达被判死罪，遇赦免死，父亲受累贬为交趾令。

steps.text: 675: On his way south to see his father, writes the 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng' at a banquet (676 by some accounts).
steps.text_zh: 675年，南下省父途经洪州，于滕王阁宴会上作《滕王阁序》（一说676年）。

steps.text: 676: Reaches his father's post in far-off Jiaozhi.
steps.text_zh: 676年，抵达交趾探望父亲。

steps.place: South Sea off Jiaozhi (Gulf of Tonkin)
steps.text: 676: Falls into the sea on the voyage back and dies of the shock, aged about 26.
steps.text_zh: 676年，渡海返程时落水，惊悸而死，年约二十七岁。

title: Chen Zi'ang's travels
summary: From a wealthy Sichuan family, Chen Zi'ang won Empress Wu's notice at Luoyang, twice joined frontier campaigns, and died in a county jail back home.
summary_zh: 陈子昂出身蜀中富家，在洛阳得武则天赏识，两度从军北征，登幽州台慷慨悲歌，最终冤死家乡狱中。

steps.text: 661: Born into a rich landowning family; a youthful swashbuckler, he only turns to study at about 17.
steps.text_zh: 661年，生于射洪豪富之家，少年任侠，约十七岁始折节读书。

steps.text: c. 680: Leaves Sichuan for the capital and studies at the Imperial Academy; fails his first examinations.
steps.text_zh: 约680年，出蜀入京，游太学，初试落第。

steps.text: 684: Passes the jinshi; his bold memorial against carrying Gaozong's coffin back west impresses Empress Wu, who makes him a palace editor.
steps.text_zh: 684年，中进士，上书谏灵驾西迁，得武则天召见，授麟台正字。

steps.place_zh: 居延海（今内蒙古额济纳）
steps.text: 686: Joins Qiao Zhizhi's expedition against the Eastern Turks to the Juyan region of the far northwest.
steps.text_zh: 686年，随乔知之北征突厥，至西北居延海一带。

steps.text: 690: Back at court when Empress Wu proclaims the Zhou dynasty, he presents an ode on her mandate; later serves as Right Remonstrator.
steps.text_zh: 690年，武则天改唐为周，献《大周受命颂》，后迁右拾遗。

steps.text: 697: Serving under Wu Youyi against the Khitan, his advice is ignored and he is demoted; he climbs the Youzhou Terrace and writes his famous lament.
steps.text_zh: 697年，随武攸宜征讨契丹，屡谏不纳反遭降职，作《登幽州台歌》。

steps.text: 698: Resigns to care for his aged father and goes home.
steps.text_zh: 698年，以父老辞官归乡。

steps.text: 702: Framed by the county magistrate Duan Jian (at Wu Sansi's urging, by some accounts), he dies in jail aged 41.
steps.text_zh: 702年，遭县令段简构陷（一说受武三思指使），死于狱中，年四十一。

title: Meng Haoran's travels
summary: A recluse poet of Xiangyang, Meng Haoran failed at Chang'an, toured the lower Yangtze, briefly served Zhang Jiuling at Jingzhou and died at home.
summary_zh: 孟浩然隐居襄阳，四十岁入京求仕不成，漫游吴越，晚年短暂入张九龄幕府，终老故乡。

steps.text: 689: Born at Xiangyang on the Han River.
steps.text_zh: 689年，生于襄阳。

steps.place_zh: 鹿门山（今湖北襄阳东南）
steps.text: c. 715: In his youth lives as a recluse on Mount Lumen, studying and writing poetry.
steps.text_zh: 约715年，早年隐居鹿门山，读书吟诗。

steps.text: 728: At about 40 goes to the capital for the jinshi and fails; befriends Wang Wei and Zhang Jiuling.
steps.text_zh: 728年，年近四十入京应进士举落第，与王维、张九龄结交。

steps.text: c. 730: Li Bai sees him off at the Yellow Crane Tower as he sails for Yangzhou.
steps.text_zh: 约730年，李白在黄鹤楼送他东下广陵。

steps.text: c. 730: Arrives in Yangzhou and begins several years of travel in the Wu and Yue regions.
steps.text_zh: 约730年，抵广陵，开始漫游吴越数年。

steps.text: c. 731: Travelling the rivers of Zhejiang, he writes 'Mooring on the Jiande River'.
steps.text_zh: 约731年，漫游浙江山水，作《宿建德江》。

steps.text: 737: Joins the staff of Zhang Jiuling, recently demoted to Jingzhou — his only official post.
steps.text_zh: 737年，入荆州长史张九龄幕府为从事，是他唯一的仕宦经历。

steps.text: 740: An abscess on his back flares up after feasting with Wang Changling, and he dies at home.
steps.text_zh: 740年，王昌龄来访，宴饮食鲜致背疽复发，卒于家中。

title: Wang Wei's life
summary: Poet, painter and devout Buddhist, Wang Wei rose at Chang'an, served on the northwestern frontier, was captured by An Lushan's rebels, and found peace at his Wangchuan estate.
summary_zh: 王维诗画双绝，笃信佛教。少年成名于长安，曾出使河西边塞，安史之乱中陷贼受伪职，晚年隐居辋川别业。

steps.text: 699: Born into the Taiyuan Wang clan at Qi (701 by other accounts); the family later settles at Puzhou.
steps.text_zh: 699年，生于太原祁县王氏（一说701年），后随家迁居蒲州。

steps.text: 715: Comes to the capital at 15; his poetry and lute-playing win the favour of princes. Writes 'Thinking of my Brothers on the Double Ninth'.
steps.text_zh: 715年，十五岁入长安，以诗才琴艺出入王府，作《九月九日忆山东兄弟》。

steps.text: 721: Passes the jinshi and becomes Assistant Director of Music, but is soon demoted to Jizhou after a forbidden lion dance is performed.
steps.text_zh: 721年，中进士任太乐丞，不久因伶人舞黄狮子受累，贬济州司仓参军。

steps.text: 737: Sent as a censor to the Hexi frontier army, he writes 'On a Mission to the Frontier': 'a lone column of smoke rises straight in the desert'.
steps.text_zh: 737年，以监察御史出使河西节度幕府，作《使至塞上》，“大漠孤烟直”。

steps.text: 740: Travelling south to supervise appointments in Lingnan, he passes Xiangyang and mourns his friend Meng Haoran.
steps.text_zh: 740年，知南选途经襄阳，作诗哭孟浩然。

steps.text: c. 750: Spends much time at his Wangchuan estate, painting and writing the 'Wangchuan Collection' with Pei Di.
steps.text_zh: 约750年，经营辋川别业，与裴迪唱和成《辋川集》，并作《辋川图》。

steps.text: 756: Captured by An Lushan's army, he is taken to Luoyang and forced into office; he writes a secret poem of grief at Ningbi Pond.
steps.text_zh: 756年，为安禄山叛军所俘，押至洛阳，被迫受伪职，作《凝碧池》诗寄哀思。

steps.text: 758: Pardoned thanks to that poem and his brother Wang Jin's plea; rises again to high office.
steps.text_zh: 758年，因《凝碧池》诗及弟王缙求情获宥，复官，后官至尚书右丞。

steps.text: 759: Dies (761 by other accounts) and is buried near his Wangchuan estate.
steps.text_zh: 759年，卒（一说761年），葬于辋川。

title: Wang Changling's travels
summary: The 'master of the quatrain' wrote frontier poems from his own travels, was twice exiled to the far south, and was murdered on his way home during the An Lushan rebellion.
summary_zh: “七绝圣手”王昌龄早年游历西北边塞，写下名篇《出塞》；仕途坎坷，两度贬谪南方，安史乱中归乡途中为人所杀。

steps.text: 698: Born into a poor family in Chang'an (Taiyuan by some accounts).
steps.text_zh: 698年，生于京兆长安贫寒之家（一说太原人）。

steps.text: c. 724: Travels the Hexi and Longyou frontier; the experience feeds his 'Out of the Frontier' and 'Joining the Army' poems.
steps.text_zh: 约724年，游历河陇边塞至玉门一带，写下《出塞》《从军行》等边塞诗。

steps.text: 727: Passes the jinshi and becomes a collator in the Palace Library.
steps.text_zh: 727年，中进士，授秘书省校书郎。

steps.text: 734: Passes a higher examination and is made sheriff of Sishui.
steps.text_zh: 734年，中博学宏词科，任汜水尉。

steps.text: 740: Pardoned from exile in Lingnan (739), he visits Meng Haoran at Xiangyang on the way north.
steps.text_zh: 740年，739年贬岭南后遇赦北归，途经襄阳访孟浩然。

steps.text: 741: Becomes assistant magistrate of Jiangning; nearby at Runzhou he writes 'Farewell to Xin Jian at Hibiscus Tower'.
steps.text_zh: 741年，任江宁丞，人称“王江宁”，在润州作《芙蓉楼送辛渐》。

steps.text: c. 748: Demoted again to sheriff of remote Longbiao; Li Bai sends him a poem of sympathy.
steps.text_zh: 约748年，再贬龙标尉，李白作《闻王昌龄左迁龙标遥有此寄》。

steps.text: 757: Heading home amid the An Lushan rebellion, he is killed by the prefect Lüqiu Xiao.
steps.text_zh: 757年，安史乱中离任归乡，途经亳州为刺史闾丘晓所杀。

title: Gao Shi's life
summary: Poor and unemployed until nearly fifty, Gao Shi wandered the north, joined Geshu Han on the frontier, and then rose fast in the An Lushan wars to govern Sichuan.
summary_zh: 高适半生落拓，游历燕赵梁宋，年近五十才入仕；投身哥舒翰幕府，安史乱中迅速升迁，官至剑南西川节度使，是唐代诗人中仕途最显达者。

steps.text: 704: Born to a declining family of the Bohai Gao clan.
steps.text_zh: 704年，出生于渤海高氏的没落之家。

steps.text: 720: Goes west to Chang'an at about 20 seeking office, without success.
steps.text_zh: 720年，约二十岁西游长安求仕，未果。

steps.text: c. 724: Settles in the Liang-Song region, living by farming and fishing for many years.
steps.text_zh: 约724年，客居梁宋，以渔樵耕读为生多年。

steps.text: c. 732: Travels to the northeastern frontier hoping to join the army; his frontier poems later culminate in 'Song of Yan' (738).
steps.text_zh: 约732年，北上蓟门，欲投军报国未遂，后据此写成《燕歌行》（738年）。

steps.text: 744: Roams the old Liang and Song country with Li Bai and Du Fu, drinking and hunting.
steps.text_zh: 744年，与李白、杜甫同游梁宋，登吹台、猎孟诸。

steps.text: 749: Finally passes an examination and becomes sheriff of Fengqiu, a post he soon resigns in disgust.
steps.text_zh: 749年，举有道科，授封丘尉，不久因不愿“拜迎官长”而辞官。

steps.text: c. 753: Joins the staff of the general Geshu Han as secretary on the Hexi-Longyou frontier.
steps.text_zh: 约753年，入河西、陇右节度使哥舒翰幕府任掌书记。

steps.text: 756: Helps hold Tong Pass; after its fall he rides to Emperor Xuanzong and reports the disaster.
steps.text_zh: 756年，随哥舒翰守潼关，关破后奔赴玄宗行在陈述败因。

steps.text: 757: As military governor of Huainan he helps crush the revolt of Prince Yong, in which Li Bai is caught up.
steps.text_zh: 757年，任淮南节度使，讨平永王李璘之乱（李白因此获罪）。

steps.text: 763: After prefectures in Sichuan, becomes military governor of Western Jiannan at Chengdu, where he helps his old friend Du Fu.
steps.text_zh: 763年，历任彭、蜀二州刺史后，任剑南西川节度使，在成都关照老友杜甫。

steps.text: 765: Recalled as a senior court official and ennobled as Marquis of Bohai, he dies in the capital.
steps.text_zh: 765年，召还任左散骑常侍，封渤海县侯，卒于长安。

title: Cen Shen's travels
summary: Cen Shen served twice in the far western protectorates, writing the greatest Tang poems of snow and desert, and ended his career and life in Sichuan.
summary_zh: 岑参两度出塞，远赴安西、北庭，写下唐代最壮丽的冰雪大漠诗篇；晚年任嘉州刺史，客死成都。

steps.text: 715: Born into a once-eminent family that had produced three chancellors (at Jiangling by some accounts).
steps.text_zh: 715年，生于曾出过三位宰相的没落世家（一说生于江陵）。

steps.text: c. 729: Studies in seclusion at Songyang below Mount Song.
steps.text_zh: 约729年，隐居嵩阳读书。

steps.text: 744: Passes the jinshi and receives a minor military-staff post.
steps.text_zh: 744年，中进士，授右内率府兵曹参军。

steps.text: 749: Goes west to Anxi as secretary to the general Gao Xianzhi.
steps.text_zh: 749年，赴安西，任高仙芝幕府掌书记。

steps.text: 751: Returns east via Wuwei as Gao Xianzhi's army is withdrawn.
steps.text_zh: 751年，随高仙芝东归，客居武威。

steps.text: 754: Back in the west as an official under Feng Changqing at Beiting; writes 'Song of White Snow' and 'Song of Running Horse River'.
steps.text_zh: 754年，再度出塞，任北庭节度使封常清判官，作《白雪歌送武判官归京》《走马川行》。

steps.text: 757: Returns to Emperor Suzong's court at Fengxiang and, on Du Fu's recommendation, is made Right Remonstrator.
steps.text_zh: 757年，东归凤翔行在，经杜甫等推荐任右补阙。

steps.text: 767: After delays caused by unrest in Sichuan, takes up his post as prefect of Jiazhou — hence 'Cen Jiazhou'.
steps.text_zh: 767年，因蜀中战乱延误后赴任嘉州刺史，世称“岑嘉州”。

steps.text: 770: Dismissed and unable to get home, he dies in an inn at Chengdu.
steps.text_zh: 770年，罢官后东归受阻，客死成都旅舍。

title: Yan Zhenqing's life
summary: The great calligrapher held Pingyuan against An Lushan, served in many prefectures, and was killed by the rebel Li Xilie rather than betray the Tang.
summary_zh: 书法大家颜真卿在安史之乱中坚守平原，宦海沉浮历任多州，晚年奉命宣慰叛将李希烈，坚贞不屈，遇害于蔡州。

steps.text: 709: Born into the learned Yan family of Langya; his father dies when he is small.
steps.text_zh: 709年，生于长安琅琊颜氏，幼年丧父，家贫苦学。

steps.text: c. 743: Seeks out the 'mad cursive' master Zhang Xu at Luoyang to learn the secrets of the brush.
steps.text_zh: 约743年，赴洛阳向“草圣”张旭求教笔法。

steps.text: 753: Made governor of Pingyuan; foreseeing An Lushan's revolt he fortifies the city, and in 755 leads Hebei's resistance.
steps.text_zh: 753年，出任平原太守，预料安禄山必反而修城备战，755年起兵抗贼，河北响应。

steps.text: 757: Breaks through to Emperor Suzong's court at Fengxiang and is made Minister of Justice.
steps.text_zh: 757年，辗转投奔凤翔行在，授宪部尚书。

steps.text: 758: As prefect of Puzhou writes the 'Draft Eulogy for My Nephew', killed with his father Yan Gaoqing by the rebels.
steps.text_zh: 758年，任蒲州刺史，写下祭奠侄子颜季明的《祭侄文稿》。

steps.text: 768: Demoted to the south after offending the powerful; as prefect of Fuzhou he later writes the 'Magu Altar' stele.
steps.text_zh: 768年，因得罪权臣外放，任抚州刺史，后书《麻姑仙坛记》。

steps.text: 773: Prefect of Huzhou, where he compiles a great rhyme dictionary with Lu Yu and the monk Jiaoran.
steps.text_zh: 773年，任湖州刺史，与陆羽、皎然等编纂《韵海镜源》。

steps.text: 777: Recalled to court as Minister of Justice after the fall of Yuan Zai.
steps.text_zh: 777年，元载伏诛后召还长安，任刑部尚书。

steps.text: 783: Sent by the chancellor Lu Qi to talk the rebel Li Xilie into submission, he is detained.
steps.text_zh: 783年，遭宰相卢杞排挤，奉命宣慰叛将李希烈，被扣留。

steps.text: 785: Refusing to serve the rebel, he is strangled at Caizhou, aged 76.
steps.text_zh: 785年，坚拒李希烈招降，在蔡州被缢杀，终年七十七岁。

title: Liu Zongyuan's travels
summary: A reformer of 805, Liu Zongyuan spent his last fourteen years in southern exile, where he wrote his finest landscape essays.
summary_zh: 柳宗元参与永贞革新失败后，被贬永州、柳州十四年，在贬所写下《永州八记》等名篇，卒于柳州。

steps.text: 773: Born into the Liu clan of Hedong, raised in Chang'an.
steps.text_zh: 773年，生于长安，祖籍河东。

steps.text: 801: After passing the jinshi (793), serves as sheriff of Lantian.
steps.text_zh: 801年，进士及第（793年）后，任蓝田尉。

steps.text: 805: Joins Wang Shuwen's Yongzhen reform as a vice-director; it collapses within months.
steps.text_zh: 805年，任礼部员外郎，参与王叔文永贞革新，数月即告失败。

steps.text: 805: Exiled as marshal of Yongzhou; over ten years there he writes the 'Eight Records of Yongzhou'.
steps.text_zh: 805年，贬永州司马，居十年，写下《永州八记》《捕蛇者说》。

steps.text: 815: Recalled to the capital — only to be sent away again.
steps.text_zh: 815年，奉诏回京，旋即再贬。

steps.text: 815: Parts from his fellow exile Liu Yuxi at Hengyang, each heading to a remote prefecture.
steps.text_zh: 815年，与刘禹锡同路南下，在衡阳分别，作诗赠别。

steps.text: 815: Becomes prefect of Liuzhou; he frees bonded servants, digs wells and plants trees.
steps.text_zh: 815年，任柳州刺史，释放奴婢，凿井植树，兴办学堂。

steps.text: 819: Dies at Liuzhou aged 46; remembered as 'Liu Liuzhou'.
steps.text_zh: 819年，卒于柳州，年四十七，世称“柳柳州”。

title: Liu Yuxi's travels
summary: The 'hero of poetry' spent over twenty years in exile and provincial posts after the failed reform of 805, ending his days in Luoyang.
summary_zh: “诗豪”刘禹锡因永贞革新失败被贬，“二十三年弃置身”，辗转朗、连、夔、和等州，晚年分司东都，卒于洛阳。

steps.text: 772: Born at Jiaxing in the lower Yangtze, where his family had moved.
steps.text_zh: 772年，生于江南嘉兴。

steps.text: 793: Passes the jinshi in the same year as Liu Zongyuan.
steps.text_zh: 793年，与柳宗元同榜中进士。

steps.text: c. 800: Secretary to Du You, military governor of Huainan.
steps.text_zh: 约800年，入淮南节度使杜佑幕府任掌书记。

steps.text: 805: A key member of the Yongzhen reform group; after its failure he is exiled.
steps.text_zh: 805年，任屯田员外郎，参与永贞革新，失败后被贬。

steps.text: 805: Spends ten years as marshal of Langzhou.
steps.text_zh: 805年，贬朗州司马，一住十年。

steps.text: 815: Recalled, but a sarcastic poem on the peach trees of the Xuandu Temple offends the court.
steps.text_zh: 815年，奉召回京，作《玄都观看花》诗讽刺新贵，再遭贬斥。

steps.text: 815: Sent as prefect to remote Lianzhou.
steps.text_zh: 815年，出任连州刺史。

steps.text: 822: Prefect of Kuizhou in the Three Gorges, where he adapts local folk songs into his 'Bamboo Branch Songs'.
steps.text_zh: 822年，任夔州刺史，采民歌作《竹枝词》。
